title: Tilkaldevikar søges til Opholdsstedet SAFE
description:
Opholdsstedet SAFE søger engagerede og fagligt kompetente tilkaldevikarer til arbejdet med børn og unge i alderen 9–17 år.

SAFE er et privat børn- og ungehjem, hvor vi tilbyder en tryg, struktureret og udviklingsstøttende hverdag for børn og unge, som blandt andet kan have erfaringer med omsorgssvigt, traumer, skolevægring, social kontrol, relationsvanskeligheder eller andre belastende livsomstændigheder.

Vores mål er at skabe stabile og forudsigelige rammer, hvor børnene og de unge mødes med respekt, nærvær og tydelighed, og hvor deres ressourcer, udviklingsmuligheder og individuelle behov er i centrum.

Vi arbejder ud fra et fælles fagligt fundament med blandt andet mentalisering, anerkendende relationsarbejde, LØFT og ADL. I hverdagen arbejder vi målrettet med relationer, struktur, skolegang, fritid, selvstændighed, følelsesmæssig udvikling og sociale kompetencer.

Vores børn og unge er som udgangspunkt ikke kendetegnet ved udadreagerende adfærd, men flere har behov for voksne, som kan være rolige, stabile og vedholdende i relationen. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du kan være en tydelig og omsorgsfuld voksen, som kan skabe tryghed uden at presse, og som kan bevare overblik i forskellige situationer.

Om arbejdet

Som tilkaldevikar bliver du en del af den daglige pædagogiske indsats og vil blandt andet skulle:

  • skabe trygge og stabile relationer til børnene og de unge

  • støtte den enkelte i hverdagsstruktur, skole, fritid og sociale relationer

  • arbejde målrettet med individuelle mål og delmål

  • deltage i aktiviteter, måltider og praktiske opgaver i huset

  • støtte børnene og de unge i ADL og udvikling af selvstændighed

  • arbejde mentaliserende og anerkendende i kontakten

  • dokumentere fagligt og præcist i vores journalsystem

  • samarbejde tæt med kolleger og ledelse

  • følge husets faglige procedurer og pædagogiske retningslinjer.

Arbejdstiden kan ligge på både hverdage, aftener, nætter, weekender og helligdage. Der kan forekomme længere vagter afhængigt af husets behov.

Hvem søger vi?

Det er vigtigt for os, at du har en relevant faglig baggrund. Vi søger derfor primært dig, som er uddannet eller under uddannelse inden for det pædagogiske eller socialfaglige område, eksempelvis som:

  • pædagog

  • pædagogisk assistent

  • socialrådgiver

  • anden relevant socialfaglig uddannelse.

Vi lægger desuden vægt på, at du har erfaring med eller kendskab til børn og unge, som har været udsat for omsorgssvigt, traumer eller andre sociale belastninger.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • kan arbejde relationsorienteret og professionelt

  • har ro, tålmodighed og tydelighed

  • kan arbejde struktureret og ansvarligt

  • kan følge aftaler, handleplaner og procedurer

  • kan indgå i et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde

  • kan dokumentere fagligt og reflekteret

  • er fleksibel i forhold til vagter.

Introduktion og SAFE Akademiet

Som ny medarbejder eller vikar bliver du tilbudt et struktureret introduktions- og kompetenceforløb gennem vores eget SAFE Akademi.

SAFE Akademiet består af 8 faglige moduler, som skal sikre, at alle medarbejdere arbejder ud fra et fælles fagligt grundlag og har kendskab til vores målgruppe, metoder, dokumentationskrav og arbejdsgange.

Inden din første introduktionsvagt skal du have gennemført og bestået de første to moduler. Herefter starter du med introduktions- og følgevagter, hvor du bliver introduceret til huset, børnene og de unge samt vores daglige pædagogiske praksis.

De resterende moduler skal gennemføres inden for en fastsat tidsfrist efter ansættelsen.

Den tid, du bruger på at gennemføre SAFE Akademiet, er betalt arbejdstid.

Vi tilbyder

Hos SAFE får du:

  • et meningsfuldt arbejde med børn og unge

  • en grundig introduktion til målgruppen og huset

  • kompetenceudvikling gennem SAFE Akademiet

  • betalt tid til gennemførelse af de faglige moduler

  • mulighed for løbende vagter

  • et fagligt miljø med fokus på udvikling, refleksion og samarbejde

  • mulighed for at gøre en konkret forskel i børn og unges hverdag.

Ansættelsesproces

Vi indkalder løbende relevante kandidater til samtale, og stillingerne besættes, når vi har fundet de rette profiler.

Som led i ansættelsesprocessen indhenter Opholdsstedet SAFE straffeattest og børneattest for alle medarbejdere, inden ansættelsen kan gennemføres.

Send gerne dit CV og en kort motiveret ansøgning, hvor du beskriver din uddannelsesbaggrund, relevante erfaring og motivation for at arbejde med vores målgruppe.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: Anæstesisygeplejerske til elektiv kirurgi – primært i dagtimerne
description:
Vil du bruge din anæstesifaglighed i et elektivt hospital med korte patientforløb, tæt tværfagligt samarbejde og primært arbejde i dagtimerne?

Capio Privathospital Odense søger en anæstesisygeplejerske til en fast stilling på 28–32 timer om ugen.

 

En arbejdsdag med anæstesi og opvågning

Du bliver en del af vores anæstesiteam og arbejder cirka 75 % med anæstesi og 25 % i opvågningen. Vi varetager elektiv kirurgi inden for blandt andet ortopædkirurgi, rygkirurgi og mave-tarmkirurgi.

Arbejdet ligger mandag til fredag, primært i dagtimerne og med enkelte vagter frem til kl. 20.00.

Hos os arbejder læger, sygeplejersker og øvrige faggrupper tæt sammen om sikre, effektive og trygge patientforløb. Vi er et mindre hospital med korte beslutningsveje, hvor der er mulighed for at få indflydelse på både hverdagen og den fortsatte udvikling af området.

Vi tilbyder

  • En fast stilling på 28–32 timer om ugen

  • Primært arbejde i dagtimerne på hverdage

  • Cirka 75 % anæstesi og 25 % opvågning

  • Elektive og veltilrettelagte patientforløb

  • Et fagligt stærkt og tværfagligt miljø

  • Grundig introduktion til hospitalet og vores arbejdsgange

  • Synlig ledelse og korte beslutningsveje

  • Løn efter DSR-overenskomst samt sundhedsforsikring

  • Personaleparkering under hospitalet

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Er uddannet anæstesisygeplejerske

  • Arbejder fagligt sikkert og selvstændigt

  • Trives med både anæstesi og opgaver i opvågningen

  • Bidrager til et godt samarbejde og hjælper, når dagens program kræver fleksibilitet

  • Møder patienter og kolleger med respekt, ro og hjælpsomhed

  • Har lyst til at bidrage til udviklingen af vores faglige praksis

Er du forholdsvis ny i specialet, hører vi også gerne fra dig. Det vigtigste er, at du har et sikkert fagligt fundament og lyst til at blive en del af vores team.

Om Capio Odense

Capio Privathospital Odense er et elektivt hospital med fokus på patientsikkerhed, høj faglig kvalitet og gode patientoplevelser.

Vi arbejder ud fra værdierne ansvar, respekt, hjælpsomhed og fleksibilitet. For os handler en god kultur om, hvordan vi samarbejder i hverdagen og løser opgaven sammen omkring patienten.

Har du lyst til at høre mere?

Du behøver ikke skrive en lang ansøgning. Send dit CV og nogle få ord om, hvorfor stillingen interesserer dig.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kollega.

Ved ansættelse indhenter vi børneattest og straffeattest.

title: Vi søger Servicemedarbejder til rengøring i Helsingør
description:
Ansøgningsfrist: 23. oktober 2026

 

Er du serviceminded, ansvarsbevidst og kan du lide at arbejde selvstændigt? Vi søger lige nu servicemedarbejder til rengøring hos to af vores kunder i Helsingør.

 

Som vores nye kollega vil dine primære arbejdsopgaver være kontorrengøring og øvrige faciliteter. Erfaring med rengøring er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du har en positiv indstilling, er omhyggelig og ønsker at levere en god service.

Din oplæring vil bestå af sidemandsoplæring, hvor du grundigt bliver introduceret til arbejdsopgaverne og de enkelte lokationer. Efter oplæringsperioden vil du arbejde selvstændigt med ansvar for dine daglige opgaver.

 

Arbejdstider

På den ene lokation udføres rengøringen uden for kundens normale arbejdstid. Arbejdet skal derfor enten være afsluttet inden kl. 08.00 eller påbegyndes efter kl. 16.00.

  • 4,75 timer ugentligt

  • Fleksibel arbejdstid inden for de angivne rammer

Den anden lokation er døgnåben, og rengøringen kan udføres på det tidspunkt, der passer bedst. Der er afsat 30 minutter dagligt, svarende til 2,5 timer ugentligt.

For at kunne arbejde på lokationen er det et krav, at du gennemfører kurset "Pas på banen". Kurset kan gennemføres på én dag og kræver, at du kan forstå dansk eller engelsk.

Kurset består af:

  • En online del på cirka 1 time

  • En fysisk undervisningsdag hos Banedanmark i Ringsted

 

Skab værdi med din service

Vi ønsker at levere den bedste service til vores kunder. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du er imødekommende, ansvarsfuld og fokuseret på kvalitet i dit arbejde.

Derudover ser vi gerne, at du:

  • Har erfaring med rengøring, gerne kontorrengøring, men det er ikke et krav

  • Er serviceminded, hjælpsom og positiv

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for egne opgaver

  • Er fleksibel og løsningsorienteret

  • Har sans for detaljen og leverer et højt kvalitetsniveau

  • Kan kommunikere på dansk eller engelsk

  • Er villig til at gennemføre "Pas på banen"-kurset

 

Vi tilbyder

  • Grundig oplæring og introduktion til opgaverne

  • Selvstændigt arbejde med fleksible arbejdstider

  • Arbejdstøj og nødvendige arbejdsredskaber

  • Mulighed for relevante kurser og kompetenceudvikling

  • En arbejdsplads med fokus på kvalitet, samarbejde og god service

 

Ansøgning

Send dit CV og eventuelt en kort ansøgning hurtigst muligt via linket "Ansøg nu" senest d. 23. oktober 2026. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Service Manager Nedzhati Nizamiev Hasanov på mail: nedzhati.hasanov@dk.issworld.com 

 

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

title: Faglært/ufaglært smed/maskinoperatør til kørsel med transportsneglemaskine
description:
Faglært/ufaglært smed/maskinoperatør søges til opstilling og kørsel med transportsneglemaskine.
Der findes kun én maskine til dette formål i Nordeuropa og du skal lære at betjene, opstille og fremstille sneglespiraler til vores egen produktion og salg.

Du vil blive oplært af folk med flere års erfaring og undervejs lære at svejse, bruge skærebrænder, vinkelsliber og flere andre smedemæssige opgaver. Det tager ca. 1-2 år at bliver rigtig dygtigt til at betjene maskinen og der vil være meget manuelt smede- og opstilling og vedligeholdelses arbejde, hvor du bliver sort på hænderne.

Hvem er du?

  • Du har tålmodighed og gåpåmod også selvom arbejdet driller og ikke lykkedes første gang. (Vigtigt!)

  • Du er ansvarsbevidst, struktureret og har en positiv indstilling til teamwork.

  • Du er klar på at arbejde i et lille sammensluttet team med erfarne og gode kollegaer, hvor der er mulighed for at få råd, hjælp og vejledning i forhold til dine opgaver og udarbejdelse af transportsnegle.

  • Arbejdet kan til tider kræve god fysik.

  • Hvad tilbyder vi?

  • Mulighed for at lære en helt speciel niché inden for smedefaget som kun få i verden er gode til.

  • Mulighed for gode lønvilkår som ufaglært.

  • En fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen med fast arbejdstid.

  • Løn der matcher dine kvalifikationer og erfaring.

  • En arbejdsplads, der vægter samarbejde og godt kollegaskab højt.

  • Mulighed for faglig udvikling og specialisering inden for transportsnegle.

  • Mulighed for at deltage i spændende fremtidige projekter og udvikling af maskiner inden for udarbejdelse af snegle.

Arbejdstider:
Mandag til onsdag kl. 7.00-15.30, torsdag 7.00-14.45, fredag 07.00-14.30

Om Arni Maskinfabrik.

Lille familievirksomhed med 8 ansatte placeret ved Eskilstrup på Falster. 
Vores speciale er Transportsnegle, udarbejdelse af sneglevindinger og profilvalsning.
Besøg gerne vores hjemmeside eller Facebook for at se eksempler på vores projekter.
https://arni.dk/
https://www.facebook.com/ArniMaskinfabrik

Virksomheden fyldte 90 år i 2025 og gennemgår i disse år en opdatering hvad angår lokaler og maskiner.

Ansøgning:

title: Servicetekniker - Hele Danmark
description:
Hvad kan du forvente?

Tesla søger serviceteknikere til vores lokationer i Aalborg, Aarhus, Greve, Hillerød, København-Kastrup, Køge, Odense, Ribe og Søborg.

Arbejd på verdens mest avancerede bil. Få praktisk erfaring med banebrydende elbiler og teknologi, der er med til at forme fremtidens transport.

Stillinger til forskellige erfaringsniveauer – vi finder den rette rolle til dig. Uanset om du er en erfaren tekniker eller er i starten af din karriere, matcher vi dig med en stilling, der passer til dine kompetencer og dine udviklingsmål.

Samarbejde frem for individuelle mål. Vi er ét team med en fælles vision. Succes skabes gennem samarbejde – ikke konkurrence.

Det, du ser ovenfor, er kun begyndelsen!

Er du nysgerrig efter at vide mere? Her er et indblik i, hvad der ellers venter:

  • Invester i din udvikling: 3 ugers intensiv oplæring samt 13 dages årlig efteruddannelse. Vi giver dig de bedste forudsætninger for succes fra første dag og tilbyder løbende uddannelse, så du på sigt kan blive Tesla Master Technician.

  • Forudsigelige arbejdstider: Faste arbejdstider uden forventning om overarbejde.

  • Rene og moderne værksteder: Fuldt udstyrede arbejdsområder med alt det værktøj, du har brug for.

  • Rejsemuligheder: Udbyg dine kompetencer ved at støtte Teslas globale mission.

  • Værktøj: Alt specialiseret Tesla-udstyr stilles til rådighed.

  • Bliv en del af vores succes: Modtag RSU'er (Restricted Stock Units/begrænsede aktieenheder) som belønning for dit bidrag.

Er du klar til at dykke endnu dybere?

Dine arbejdsopgaver

  • Diagnosticere og reparere den nyeste teknologi: Arbejd med de nyeste elbiler og softwaresystemer – ingen arbejdsdage er ens.

  • Samarbejde med forskellige teams: Arbejd tæt sammen med mobile teknikere, virtuelle supportteams, feltspecialister og øvrige supportfunktioner for at sikre, at alle køretøjer fungerer optimalt.

  • Lær gennem praksis: Udvikl dine kompetencer gennem løbende uddannelse og praktisk erfaring med verdens mest avancerede biler.

  • Støt Teslas mission: Spil en vigtig rolle i at holde vores biler på vejene og hjælpe kunderne med at opleve fremtidens transport.

  • Kundekontakt: Opbyg gode relationer ved at forklare reparationer, besvare spørgsmål og sikre en god kundeoplevelse.

  • Vær på forkant med udviklingen: Få tidlig adgang til nye funktioner, værktøjer og opdateringer, efterhånden som Tesla fortsætter med at udvikle sig.

Kvalifikationer

  • Gode kommunikationsevner: Du kan kommunikere klart og professionelt med både kunder og kolleger om mange forskellige emner.

  • Holdspiller: Du brænder for samarbejde og kontinuerlig forbedring.

  • Gyldigt kørekort: Du skal have et gyldigt kørekort i det land, hvor du søger stillingen.

  • Arbejdstilladelse: Du skal have ret til at arbejde i Danmark.

Lige muligheder og tilgængelighed

Tesla er en arbejdsplads med lige muligheder for alle. Alle kvalificerede ansøgere vil blive vurderet uden hensyn til forhold som f.eks. veteranstatus eller handicap eller andre forhold, der er beskyttet af gældende national eller lokal lovgivning.

Tesla er desuden forpligtet til at tilbyde rimelige tilpasninger til personer med handicap. Hvis du har behov for særlige hensyn på noget tidspunkt under ansættelsesprocessen, bedes du informere din rekrutteringsansvarlige.

Hvis du har behov for en skærmlæser eller anden tilgængelighedsteknologi, kan du hente en gratis kompatibel skærmlæser via Teslas hjemmeside, hvor der også findes en trinvis vejledning. Har du spørgsmål om tilgængelighed eller behov for særlige tilpasninger, kan du kontakte Tesla via den angivne ADA-kontaktadresse.

Beskyttelse af personoplysninger

Beskyttelse af persondata har høj prioritet hos Tesla. Vi indbygger databeskyttelse i vores produkter og betragter det som en central del af vores forretning. Hvis du vil vide mere om, hvordan Tesla indsamler og behandler dine personoplysninger i forbindelse med din ansøgning, kan du læse Teslas erklæring om beskyttelse af personoplysninger for jobansøgere (Tesla Talent Privacy Notice).

title: Chef / Cook – Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar, Kalundborg
description:
Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar is looking for skilled and motivated Chefs / Cooks to join our established restaurant in Kalundborg, Denmark.

Our restaurant in Kalundborg is a well-run, busy operation with a proven concept, experienced ownership and a clear direction. Located right in the middle of Kalundborg's main pedestrian street, we are a lively, pulsing part of the town and a gathering place for its residents. Our purpose is to create a vibrant place for the people of Kalundborg, built on quality ingredients and good food. We are now strengthening our kitchen team and are looking for chefs who want to become part of a structured, professional kitchen and contribute to consistent, high-quality service every day.

Our concept is based on modern Danish cuisine with a Nordic twist, combined with well executed brasserie classics and a varied à la carte menu. We focus on quality ingredients, solid craftsmanship and seasonal cooking, with dishes that combine flavour, comfort and consistency. Our menu includes both classic meat dishes, such as pepper steak, pasta dishes and other popular brasserie favourites.

Alongside our à la carte service, we have a private dining and events room, which you will also be part of. It brings welcome variety to the daily kitchen work, with menus that differ from the standard à la carte and the chance to cook for parties, celebrations and special occasions.

You will be joining a business with an already proven concept, an organised kitchen and a strong operational foundation. The setup is stable and well prepared, giving you a secure framework in which to do great work and develop your craft. Here you also get the freedom to bring your own ideas to life. We are not a place where everything is dictated from above — our chefs and kitchen staff are given the room to develop dishes, contribute to the menu and put their own mark on the food.

We are a serious but friendly workplace with respectful leadership, an organised kitchen environment and a no-drama culture. We believe strong kitchens are built on structure, teamwork and professionalism.

We are looking for chefs / cooks who:
• Have experience working in a professional kitchen
• Can handle prep, mise en place and service in a structured way
• Have experience with à la carte service
• Care about quality, teamwork and consistency
• Thrive in a busy restaurant environment
• Can work independently and take responsibility during service

We offer:
• Full-time employment
• A fixed work schedule
• Weekend work is part of the position
• Salary of approximately DKK 30,000–35,000 gross per month, depending on qualifications and experience
• Five weeks of paid holiday
• Company apartment / accommodation available
• Help with relocation and settling in Denmark
• Possibility of support with moving costs and/or paid accommodation in the first month, by agreement
• Good working conditions in a structured and professional environment
• Staff meals
• Work clothing provided
• Staff discounts
• A stable, established restaurant with a proven concept and an organised kitchen
• The freedom to develop your own ideas and contribute to the menu
• A workplace where English can be used in daily communication

Location
The position is based in Kalundborg, Denmark, in the heart of the city's main pedestrian street. Kalundborg offers a local Danish atmosphere, a charming town centre and a good quality of life.

Language
English is required. Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Start date
As soon as possible / by agreement.

How to apply
Please send
• Your CV
• A short introduction about yourself
• Your earliest possible start date

For applications and questions, please contact:
Esbern Snare ApS
Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar
Phone: +45 25 14 44 00
Email: job@esbern-snare.dk

We look forward to hearing from motivated chefs who want to become part of a strong, established kitchen team in Denmark.

Please note that you must already have the right to work in Denmark, either as an EU/EEA or Swiss citizen or by holding a valid Danish work permit that allows you to take this position.

title: Baker – Bakery Production – Maribo, Lolland, Denmark

Den Gamle Bagergaard in Maribo is looking for a baker. You do not need a formal qualification if you have practical experience working in a bakery.

We are a family-run business with three bakers and a pastry chef in production. Two packing staff and a driver help get our bread ready and delivered to our shops.

Your work

You will take part in the daily production at the bakery. We are looking for someone who knows their way around a bakery, takes responsibility for their work and enjoys working with colleagues. You must be able to communicate in Danish or understandable English.

You must already have the legal right to work in Denmark, for example through EU/EEA or Swiss citizenship or a valid Danish residence and work permit. We cannot offer visa or work permit sponsorship.

What we offer

The planned working hours start at 01:30 on Mondays and 05:00 from Tuesday to Thursday. You will also work every other weekend. During the night shifts on Mondays and every other weekend, you will bake bread, Danish pastries and other baked goods. title: Chef to join our international kitchen team
description:
CHEF WANTED FOR STAFF RESTAURANT IN COPENHAGEN, DENMARK

Looking for a chef position in Copenhagen with great working hours, professional cooking and weekends mostly free?

We are looking for a skilled and motivated chef to join our international kitchen team in Copenhagen, Denmark.

Your main workplace will be The Staff Restaurant at Abacus Medicine, located at Kalvebod Brygge in central Copenhagen.

This is a full-time position with working hours primarily Monday to Friday from 06:30 to 14:30 – giving you the opportunity to work in an ambitious professional kitchen while still having your afternoons, evenings and most weekends free.

Occasional evening and weekend events may occur.

THE JOB

You will become part of a professional kitchen team responsible for the daily production and service at our staff restaurant.

We cook from scratch and care about good ingredients, seasonality, flavour and proper craftsmanship.

You will work primarily with hot kitchen production and take responsibility for your own preparation and tasks while working closely with the rest of the team.

Our kitchen is busy, so we are looking for someone who works efficiently and in an organised manner without compromising quality.

Just as importantly, we are looking for a good colleague.

We believe a professional kitchen should be a place where people communicate respectfully, help each other and enjoy coming to work.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

You may already be living in Denmark, or you may be considering moving to Copenhagen from another EU/EEA country.

We would like to hear from you if you:

  • are a trained chef or have equivalent professional kitchen experience

  • have experience from à la carte restaurants, quality staff restaurants, hotels or similar professional kitchens

  • have solid experience in the hot kitchen

  • have a genuine interest in food, ingredients and good craftsmanship

  • can organise your own work and maintain a good pace throughout the day

  • are reliable and comfortable starting work early

  • enjoy working as part of a team

  • communicate in a positive and respectful way

  • can maintain an overview when the kitchen gets busy.

A background in classic French or Mediterranean cuisine would be particularly relevant to our kitchen.

However, we are also interested in chefs who bring their own culinary background and experience. Whether your inspiration comes from France, Spain, Italy, Portugal, Greece, North or South America, Asia or somewhere else, we would like to see what you can bring to the team.

We want to taste what you are passionate about.

WHAT WE OFFER

We offer a full-time chef position in central Copenhagen with a working schedule that is unusual in the restaurant industry:

Monday–Friday
Primarily 06:30–14:30
Most evenings and weekends free

You will join a friendly and international workplace with experienced colleagues, high professional standards and room to contribute your own knowledge and ideas.

We value professional pride, teamwork, reliability and a positive working environment.

Our goal is simple: good food, good ingredients, good craftsmanship and a kitchen team that works well together.

MORE THAN A STAFF RESTAURANT

Your daily workplace will be:

The Staff Restaurant at Abacus Medicine
Kalvebod Brygge 35
1560 Copenhagen V
Denmark

Our kitchen also produces food for our small Copenhagen wine bar, Sankt Annæ 8, located in Christianshavn.

Within the same ownership group, we operate several Copenhagen restaurants, including Le Métier, La Propina and Ma Cuisine.

You will therefore become part of a wider restaurant family with different concepts and opportunities for future professional development.

PRACTICAL INFORMATION

Position: Chef
Employment: Full-time
Working hours: Primarily Monday–Friday, 06:30–14:30
Workplace: Copenhagen, Denmark
Starting date: As soon as possible / by agreement
Salary: Based on qualifications and experience and agreed individually
Evening/weekend work: Occasional events only

INTERESTED?

Send us your CV and a short application in English to:

job@willworkforfood.dk

Please write “CHEF FOR ABACUS” in the subject line.

Tell us a little about yourself, your kitchen experience, what kind of food you enjoy cooking and when you would be available to start.

Applications are reviewed continuously, and suitable candidates will be invited for an interview.

If you are currently living outside Denmark, please mention your current location and when you would potentially be available to relocate to Copenhagen.

We look forward to meeting you for a coffee and a conversation about food, ambitions and your future in Copenhagen.

The Staff Restaurant at Abacus Medicine
Copenhagen, Denmark

title: PhD scholarship at the Danish Institute for International Studies
description:
PhD scholarship at the Danish Institute for International Studies, Military Artificial Intelligence, Peace and International Security

The Danish Institute for International Studies (DIIS) is recruiting a PhD candidate to research military applications of artificial intelligence and their implications for peace and international security. We are especially interested in projects that examine how the development and use of AI-based military capabilities affect established practices of decision-making, human control, and accountability. The project should connect a nuanced understanding of the dynamics of technological change to wider questions of arms control and international regulation. 

The position is based at the DIIS Centre for Peace Research and will thematically be placed under one of the three pillars of the Centre, namely Arms control in a time of arms races and war. One of the questions that the Centre focuses on is how Nordic countries, including Denmark, can navigate a situation where the development of new technologies (e.g. AI and drones), along with increasing great power rivalry and competition in space, entail new types of security risks that traditional arms control models and treaties do not effectively regulate.

The successful candidate will develop an independent PhD project that speaks to the overall focus of the center and produces research relevant to Nordic and international debates on security and peace.

About the position 
AI is changing how military organizations collect information, assess threats, select targets and coordinate operations. These capabilities are currently developed faster than military doctrine, legal interpretation and oversight arrangements intended to govern their use. This raises questions about who exercises control, how responsibility is assigned, and how other states interpret capabilities whose operation is difficult to observe. Within this overall frame relevant proposals may examine:

  • The relationship between the adoption of AI and the development of military doctrine

  • The effects of AI-enabled decision support on military decision-making and the human role therein

  • The impact of uncertainty and opacity around the current state of AI integration among militaries on escalation dynamics and arms-race dynamics

  • Regulation of AI through multilateral governance mechanisms in and beyond the UN

  • Human judgement and accountability in military applications of AI

About DIIS and the position
The successful candidate will be employed by DIIS in a three-year, full-time PhD position, expected to commence on 1 February 2027. The candidate will be enrolled in the PhD School at the Faculty of Social Sciences at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU), while their primary place of work will be the Centre for Peace Research at DIIS.

The PhD project will be jointly supervised by a senior researcher at DIIS and Professor Ingvild Bode at SDU.

At DIIS, the PhD candidate will join an inspiring and ambitious research environment committed to advancing multidisciplinary scholarship. The successful candidate is expected to engage actively in cross-disciplinary collaboration and to value insights from colleagues working with different theoretical and methodological approaches. Such exchanges across disciplinary boundaries are central to the research environment at DIIS.

We expect the candidate to:

  • have obtained a master’s degree in a relevant field

  • have at least received the grade of 10 (or equivalent) for the master’s thesis according to the Danish 7-point grading scale and a high weighted grade point average 

  • meet the general requirements for being accepted for enrolment as a PhD candidate (see below)

  • live up to the DIIS entry criteria for PhD positions https://www.diis.dk/files/media/document/diis-entry-criteria-rev-okt-24.pdf 

  • communicate clearly in written and spoken English, and proficiency in Danish is an advantage.

DIIS as a workplace
We offer an attractive and inclusive workplace where our employees can develop. We consider knowledge sharing and feedback essential to creating a dynamic workplace. We expect you to participate proactively in the common efforts of the institute. We prioritize a high degree of presence but want our employees to have a good work-life balance. Therefore, we offer flexible working hours and some possibility of working from home. We are located very close to Copenhagen’s city center with excellent public transportation options.

DIIS is a diverse workplace, and we encourage all qualified candidates to apply for this position regardless of their personal background. DIIS is also a workplace where we consider the environmental consequences of our activities and strive to adopt more environmentally sustainable practices both in relation to our daily business at DIIS and our global travel activities.

In the assessment, consideration will be given to the following criteria:

  • The applicant has a relevant master’s degree or equivalent qualifications (corresponding to the 3 + 2 Bologna process), cf. the Danish qualifications framework for higher education

  • Quality and relevance of the project description

    • Quality and relevance of the methodical and theoretical choices

    • Consistency and coherence between the research problem and the choice of method and theory

    • The realistic and feasible scope of the PhD project

  • Relevance of the project for the DIIS Centre for Peace Research and DIIS in general

Contract and remuneration
The position as PhD candidate starts on 1 February 2027 and is a 3-year full-time position. Remuneration and other job conditions follow the general agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC) and the Danish Ministry of Finance, local collective agreements at DIIS as well as the 28 June 2019 Danish state protocol on PhD candidates. 

The standard starting salary for a PhD candidate at DIIS is 379,702,61 DKK per year excl. pensions – this may be increased depending on prior work experience after the acquisition of the master’s degree. A pension contribution of 18,07% is added to the above-mentioned salary.

Do you want to know more?
Visit http://www.diis.dk/jobs to learn more about DIIS as a workplace. Questions regarding employment and renumeration can be sent to hr@diis.dk. If you have inquiries regarding the professional focus of the position, you can contact Senior Researcher and Head of Research Unit, Mona Kanwal Sheikh at mosh@diis.dk  

The application
Deadline for applying is 23 October 2026, at 12.00 pm CET. 

Please note that we only accept applications through DIIS’ electronic recruitment system. 

Your application must include all the following documents:

  1. A motivational letter

  2. Curriculum Vitae 

  3. Master’s diploma including grades. If you hold a master’s degree which is not within the ECTS-framework, please also provide:

    • Your bachelor diploma and bachelor grades

    • A statement clarifying the subject and length (in years) of the master’s degree

    • An English translation of your diplomas 

  4. PhD project proposal (max 5 pages)

  5. Publication list

DIIS is an independent public research institution for international studies. We conduct and communicate multidisciplinary research on globalisation, security, development and foreign policy and within these areas we aim to be agenda-setting in research, policy and public debate.

DIIS participates in academic networks and publish in high-ranking academic journals, always striving to excel in academic scholarship.

We continuously assess Denmark's foreign and political situation and inform the Danish media, politicians and the public about our work

title: Postdoc in intestinal regeneration and mucosal immunology
description:
A full-time (100%) postdoctoral position is available in the lab of Dr. Srustidhar Das, at the Department of Clinical Research and at the Research Unit of Inflammation Research, Department of Molecular Medicine, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. The position is limited to two years, with the possibility of extension subject to funding.

Research tasks

The position comprises research, teaching, professional development and supervision within intestinal tissue regeneration, epithelial biology, mucosal immunology and inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). The postdoc will join a translational research programme that investigates how inflammation reshapes the intestinal epithelium and its surrounding tissue niche, and how these changes can be targeted to promote safe and durable mucosal healing.

The successful candidate will combine patient-derived organoid and co-culture models with molecular biology, functional assays, and computational analysis of single-cell and spatial datasets. The position is particularly suited to a researcher who can connect experimental biology with bioinformatics and clinically relevant questions.

Research environment

The postdoc will be embedded in a dynamic and highly collaborative research environment spanning the Department of Clinical Research and the Department of Molecular Medicine at SDU. The project benefits from close interaction among basic scientists, clinicians, bioinformaticians and translational researchers, with strong links to Odense University Hospital and access to patient-derived material, advanced disease models and state-of-the-art molecular technologies.

The environment provides excellent opportunities to develop an independent research profile, contribute to clinically relevant discoveries in IBD and tissue regeneration, and build collaborations across experimental, computational and clinical disciplines.

Research project

The project investigates how inflammatory history establishes persistent epithelial and niche memory, shapes epithelial plasticity and influences intestinal regeneration in IBD. Using patient-derived biopsies, intestinal organoids, fibroblasts and immune-cell co-cultures, we will determine how epithelial memory and injury-induced cell-state transitions influence regenerative capacity and distinguish effective from impaired mucosal healing.

Functional experiments will be integrated with single-cell RNA sequencing, chromatin-accessibility analysis, spatial transcriptomics and spatial epigenomics. CRISPR-engineered patient-derived organoids, including lineage reporters and targeted genetic perturbations, will be used to trace epithelial cell states and validate candidate mechanisms. Selected organoids will also be tested in engraftment models to determine whether regenerative phenotypes translate into improved tissue integration and repair in vivo.

Key responsibilities

  • Establish and manipulate patient-derived intestinal organoids and fibroblast–immune-cell co-cultures to investigate epithelial plasticity, cell-state transitions, regeneration, inflammatory responses and barrier function.

  • Generate and validate CRISPR-engineered organoids, including reporter lines and targeted genetic perturbations, and perform engraftment studies to assess regenerative potential in vivo.

  • Analyse and integrate scRNA-seq, scATAC-seq, spatial transcriptomic and spatial epigenomic datasets using reproducible workflows for quality control, differential analysis, cell-state annotation, trajectory analysis and multimodal integration.

  • Apply molecular and cellular methods, including qPCR, immunostaining, advanced microscopy, flow cytometry and ELISA-based assays, and validate candidate pathways using pharmacological and CRISPR-based perturbations where appropriate.

  • Collaborate with clinicians, experimental scientists and bioinformaticians to analyse and interpret patient-derived samples and data.

  • Maintain accurate and reproducible records, present findings, prepare manuscripts and conference contributions, and contribute to grant applications, teaching and supervision where relevant.

Expectations of qualifications

The successful applicant must hold a PhD in molecular biology, cell biology, immunology, bioinformatics, computational biology, regenerative medicine, biomedicine or a closely related discipline, with documented research experience relevant to the project.

Essential qualifications

  • Documented experience in organoid biology, preferably involving intestinal or other tissue-derived epithelial organoids, and in designing mechanistic studies of epithelial plasticity and regeneration.

  • A strong background in tissue regeneration, epithelial biology, mucosal immunology, inflammatory disease or a closely related field.

  • Demonstrated expertise in analysing single-cell or spatial-omics data, with proficiency in R and/or Python and experience developing reproducible computational workflows.

  • Hands-on experience in molecular and cell biology, with the ability to design, perform, troubleshoot and interpret experiments using a structured and careful approach to data analysis, documentation and responsible research practice.

  • A strong publication record appropriate to career stage; excellent written and spoken English; and the ability to drive projects independently while collaborating effectively in a multidisciplinary and international environment.

Desirable qualifications

  • Experience with intestinal organoids, patient-derived material, fibroblast or immune-cell culture, or epithelial–stromal–immune co-culture models.

  • Experience integrating scRNA-seq, scATAC-seq, spatial transcriptomic, spatial epigenomic or other multimodal datasets.

  • Familiarity with advanced imaging, quantitative image analysis, flow cytometry, organoid phenotyping or high-content screening.

  • Demonstrated experience generating and validating CRISPR-engineered organoids, including knock-in reporters or targeted gene perturbations, and with intestinal organoid engraftment or transplantation and in vivo assessment of epithelial regeneration is highly preferred.

  • An interest in supervising junior researchers and contributing to collaborative teaching and research activities.

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision –We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future – it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research – with people at the centre; strong research environments – as drivers of development; and the research journey – from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Further information 

For further information, please contact Dr. Srustidhar Das, Department of Clinical Research and Department of Molecular Medicine, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), tel.: +45 71504339, e-mail: srudas@health.sdu.dk

Application deadline

November 1, 2026 at 23.59 hrs. (CET).

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Postdoc is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed postdoc allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated.

The work location will be at Campusvej 55, 5230 Odense M, Denmark.

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • a motivation letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (inclusive of Ph.D.-diploma)

  • a complete and numbered list of publications

  • 3 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file.

    • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file.

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • a detailed description of research experience

  • an explanation of other qualifications relevant to the position

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.  

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

title: Chefs/ Souschefs - Job opportunities at LOCA – Copenhagen

We value respect, collaboration, responsibility and the desire to keep improving.

A modern Nordic restaurant with more than 15 years of history. The restaurant focuses on organic and seasonal ingredients, local producers, vegetables and fish from Nordic waters.LOCA also operates
Kilden i Haven in Tivoli and several canteens.

What we offer

  • An international and diverse working environment.

  • Passionate and dedicated colleagues.

  • Opportunities for professional and personal development.

  • Responsibility and influence in your daily work.

  • Opportunities for further training and development within LOCA.

You become part of a community where we share knowledge, support each other and work together to create great meals and great workplaces.We believe Every Meal Matters – and that the choices we make today help create a better world tomorrow.Practical information

title: Postdoc in Veterinary Microbiology
description:
Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences
University of Copenhagen



We are looking for an experienced and highly motivated veterinary microbiologist for a 2-year part-time postdoc position starting around 1st January 2027. The new postdoc is expected to contribute to the scientific and teaching activities of the research group One Health Antimicrobial Resistance (OHAR) within the section of Veterinary Clinical Microbiology. Additionally, the postdoc will be responsible for defined scientific and management activities within the project SOA36 - Designing best veterinary practices to reduce antimicrobial and antiparasitic use (BEST-VET), funded by the European Partnership on Animal Health and Welfare (EUPAHW). These responsibilities include supporting the project Chair in the day-to-day coordination and management of the consortium, as well as planning and conducting research aimed at reducing antimicrobial use in pigs through improved diagnostic and treatment protocols for key endemic bacterial diseases, and active involvement in the development of clinical guidelines for prudent antimicrobial use in pig medicine, with a particular focus on developing evidence-based guidelines using the GRADE approach. Through these activities, the postdoc will contribute to strengthening antimicrobial stewardship and promoting evidence-based best practices in veterinary medicine.

Information on the department and the section can be found at: https://ivh.ku.dk/.

Our research
The postdoc will be part of the OHAR research group led by Prof. Luca Guardabassi. Our research is characterized by two focus areas:

  • Development of diagnostic tests and methods to reduce and rationalize antimicrobial use in animals.
  • Optimization of veterinary antimicrobial use to minimize selection and spread of antimicrobial resistance.
For more information, please check the OHAR homepage One Health Antimicrobial Resistance (OHAR) – University of Copenhagen

Your job
You are a highly qualified veterinary microbiologist with the ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team. You will be required to be physically present in the laboratory to contribute to ongoing research projects and oversee experiments conducted by PhD, MSc, and BSc students. As part of the EU project BEST-VET, you will contribute to selected work packages and expert groups, including WP1 (Reduction of drug use in pigs), WP7 (Environmental impact of antimicrobial/antiparasitic drugs and phage therapy), Expert Group 1 (Phages and their environmental impact), Expert Group 3 (Standardization of sampling, metagenomics & analytical methods) and Expert Group 5 (Clinical guidance). You will be responsible for coordinating and following up on SOA36 activities related to these work packages and expert groups. You will also act as a key point of contact between the project management, work package leaders and expert groups. Your project management responsibilities will further include supporting the organisation of Management Board meetings, following up on project activities and deadlines, and maintaining the SOA36 SharePoint and associated project documentation. As part of the position, you will undertake a one-year training programme in evidence-based guideline development using the GRADE approach and subsequently contribute to the development of evidence-based clinical guidelines for veterinary medicine.

Profile
We are seeking a highly qualified scientist with a strong track record of independent research in veterinary bacteriology and experience in international collaborative research project coordination, as well as in the supervision and teaching of veterinary and postgraduate students.

Essential experience and skills:

  • A MSc degree in Veterinary Medicine
  • A PhD in Veterinary Microbiology or a closely related field
  • Previous postdoctoral experience
  • Outstanding publication record in relation to career stage
  • Excellent scientific writing and oral communication skills
  • Experience in supervising PhD, MSc, and BSc students
  • Experience in the coordination and management of collaborative research projects
  • Experience with bacterial whole-genome sequencing and genomic data analysis
  • Knowledge of key concepts in antimicrobial stewardship
Desirable experience and skills:

  • Research experience in antimicrobial resistance
  • Experience in metagenomics
  • Experience in routine bacteriological and mycological diagnostics
  • Experience in preparing research proposals and applications for external funding
Place of employment
The place of employment is at the Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, University of Copenhagen. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in a dynamic and international research environment. Our research facilities include modern laboratories that are fully equipped to perform traditional and molecular microbiology, including omics.

Terms of employment
The average weekly working hours are 37 per week.

The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

Terms of appointment and payment accord to the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State.

Negotiation for salary supplement is possible.

You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

The application, in English, must be submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below.

When you will be affiliated with the University of Copenhagen or otherwise have access to their research, you may be required to undergo a background screening. The purpose is to protect the security and research integrity of the University of Copenhagen.

Questions
For further information please contact Luca Guardabassi (lg@sund.ku.dk).

Foreign applicants may find this link useful: www.ism.ku.dk (International Staff Mobility).

Please include

  • Curriculum vitae
  • Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)
  • Research plan – description of current and future research plans
  • Complete publication list
  • Separate reprints of 3 particularly relevant papers
After the expiry date or applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee.

You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.

Application deadline: 15 October 2026, 23.59 CEST.

Interviews are expected to be held in weeks 44-45 (26th October – 5th November 2026).

The University of Copenhagen wish to reflect the diversity of society and welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender, nationality, race, religion or sexual orientation. Appointment will be based on merit alone.

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt

  • Kan følge en fast rute og arbejdsplan

  • Er grundig og kvalitetsbevidst

  • Er komfortabel med, at en stor del af arbejdsdagen foregår bag rattet

  • Fast arbejde hver lørdag og søndag

  • Firmabil til al kørsel i forbindelse med arbejdet

title: Sales Executive  - Ready to turn Software/ERP expertise into closed deals? Interform HQ Birkerød, DK or Remote
description:
The role

Interform builds InterformNG2, an Output Management platform that sits next to the ERP and handles the documents a business runs on: invoices, labels, delivery notes, e-invoicing. When output fails, shipments stop and invoices get rejected. Our customers buy certainty that this never happens.

You will sell InterformNG2 to new customers across Europe - with our core markets in the Nordics, Germany and Austria, Benelux and the UK - typically manufacturing, logistics and distribution companies running ERPs such as Infor, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or IBM i. You own the full sales cycle from first conversation to signed agreement.

There is no BDR team here, but you are not starting from a blank sheet either. We identify the most relevant accounts together, backed by an AI-driven engine that tracks buying signals across our markets. Your job is what happens next: the outreach, the conversations, the proposals and the close.

What you will do

  • Turn qualified target accounts into meetings, pipeline and closed deals across your European territory.

  • Open doors through direct outreach and your own network of ERP consultants, partners and IT decision-makers.

  • Run full sales cycles - qualification, demo coordination, proposal, negotiation, close - in close collaboration with the rest of the commercial team.

  • Work with our partner ecosystem around Infor, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, IBM i and other ERP platforms as a second route to market.

  • Feed what you learn in the market back into how we position and price.

Who you are

  • Driven. You show up every day ready to do your best, and you keep that standard through long sales cycles.

  • Connected in the ERP ecosystem. Ecosystem knowledge is essential in this role: you know at least one major ERP ecosystem in real depth - the partners and implementation consultants in it, how they influence a deal and when to bring them in - and you bring a working network you can call on from day one.

  • Self-starting. You plan your own work, execute without being chased, and deliver.

  • Accountable. You own your number and you follow up - customers can trust that you are always a step ahead.

  • At home in the ERP world. You have sold software or services into environments running Infor, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, IBM i or comparable ERP platforms, and you speak the language of IT managers and operations directors.

  • AI-forward. You already use AI in your daily sales work - research, preparation, follow-up - and want a company that works the same way.

  • A closer. You have proven you can turn outreach into pipeline and pipeline into signed deals - not just manage inbound.

  • Languages: fluent English is required. German, Danish or Dutch on top is a strong advantage - ideally you cover one of our core markets natively.

What we offer

  • A place in a solid company: profitable, in strong growth, and with a large market still ahead of us.

  • A product that is easy to stand behind: more than 4,500 installations worldwide, and customers who stay.

  • A defined category - Output Management - where we compete on depth, not noise.

  • Short decision paths and direct access to management.

  • An AI-driven account-based marketing engine that shows you which companies are in the market - so your time goes to conversations, not list-building.

  • A competitive package that rewards what you close.

About Interform A/S

Interform has built Output Management software since 1987 from our headquarters in Birkerød, Denmark. Our platform, InterformNG2, works with any ERP, any format and any environment - customers change or upgrade their ERP and keep their output running. Our first customer from 1987 is still with us today. Our customer base is international - companies across the Nordics, Germany and Austria, Benelux, the UK and further afield - and our own team works across borders in the same way, with colleagues based in Denmark and Germany. We are a profitable, solidly run company in strong growth, and investment backing supports continued development of the platform.

Practical details

  • Location: our office in Birkerød, Denmark, or remote from anywhere in our European markets - we already have employees working outside Denmark, so a distributed setup is nothing new to us.

  • Travel: limited. Most sales work runs remotely, with occasional customer, partner and event travel.

  • Reports to: our Chief Commercial Officer - you will work alongside the rest of the commercial team.

  • Start: as soon as possible. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

How to apply

Upload your CV and cover letter, including the deals you are most proud of.

Birkerød I Remote

title: KS3 and IGCSE English Teacher (Year 7 – Year 11)
description:
International School Ikast-Brande (ISIB) is looking for a qualified Cambridge English teacher with experience teaching English to students from Year 7 – Year 11. Preference will be given to candidates who have experience teaching IGCSE First Language English and are native speakers. Interviews will be arranged immediately as the Leadership Team would like to recruit as soon as possible.  

This is a full-time, permanent & pensionable position starting as soon as possible. As an inclusive school, we encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. 

We value the richness that diverse perspectives and lived experiences bring to our community, and we are committed to fostering a culture of belonging where every individual feels respected and supported.  

 

The School: 

International School Ikast-Brande is located in the heart of Denmark and has approximately 200 students across Early Years, Primary and Secondary sections, with one class per year group. Our students are highly motivated and speak very positively about the school. We are committed to providing high-quality international education to families relocating to Denmark, as well as to local families seeking a rigorous international curriculum for their children.  

Our student body is wonderfully diverse, representing a wide range of nationalities and cultural backgrounds. We encourage our students to balance academic achievement with a well-rounded, healthy lifestyle. From an early age, we instil in them a strong sense of right and wrong, empowering them to make thoughtful and responsible decisions. As a result, we enjoy a positive school climate with very few behavioural issues.  

Our teaching team is as vibrant and international as our student body. You will often hear laughter coming from our staffroom and in the corridors. Our team meets regularly to collaborate on educational and operational matters, fostering a collegial and supportive environment.  

 

Requirements: 

In line with the school’s overarching policies and procedures, the successful candidate will be expected to: 

  • Plan and develop engaging & high-quality lessons, tailored to our learners’ needs; 

  • Maintain a student-focused, positive approach to teaching and learning; 

  • Deliver dynamic, stimulating and culturally engaging lessons;  

  • Promote student wellbeing through an understanding of each child’s individuality;  

  • Assess and report on students’ progress effectively;  

  • Manage student behaviour in a positive and constructive manner;  

  • Participate actively in whole-school activities and events;  

  • Employ a solutions-focused mindset;  

  • Maintain a great sense of humour and contribute to a positive work environment;  

  • Be internationally minded and a collaborative team player. 

 

What We Can Offer: 

  • A competitive salary and excellent pension scheme, in line with collective agreements; 

  • A genuine and sustainable work-life balance; 

  • State-of-the-art, modern teaching and learning facilities; 

  • Small class sizes with engaged, capable and curious students; 

  • A calm and respectful learning environment, with motivated and well-disciplined pupils; 

  • A flexible working culture, built on mutual trust and professional autonomy; 

  • A supportive and visible Senior Leadership Team, deeply committed to staff and community wellbeing; 

  • A leadership approach that values collaboration, open dialogue and teacher voice - ensuring staff feel heard, empowered and appreciated; 

  • A culturally diverse, inclusive and welcoming team of professionals; 

  • Strong, constructive partnerships with engaged and supportive parents; 

  • Ongoing professional learning, development opportunities and team-building events. 

 

What Denmark Can Offer: 

Living and working in Denmark offers a unique opportunity to enjoy one of the world’s highest standards of living. Teachers benefit from: 

  • An excellent work-life balance supported by a strong social welfare system; 

  • A safe, clean and well-organised society with low levels of crime; 

  • High-quality, publicly funded healthcare and childcare services; 

  • A focus on family life, personal wellbeing and professional respect; 

  • Beautiful natural surroundings; 

  • Easy access to travel across Denmark, Europe and further afield; 

  • An international community that welcomes newcomers and supports integration; 

  • A strong commitment to sustainability and environmental responsibility. 

 

Salary: 

Salary and pension are determined in accordance with the collective agreement and union contract established between the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Teachers’ Central Organisation. 

Please note that both local and international teachers are employed under the same pay scales and working conditions. 

While the school does not offer formal relocation packages, we are committed to supporting new staff and work closely with individuals to find practical and helpful solutions throughout their transition. To further assist international staff with their move, initial relocation support is provided during the first year of employment. 

 

Application: 

If you are a skilled, adaptable and solutions-oriented educator, we warmly invite you to apply by sending your CV and a cover letter outlining your experience to job@isib.dk. Letters of recommendation are also welcomed. All offers of employment are subject to satisfactory police security checks.   

The Senior Leadership Team intends to appoint as soon as a suitable candidate is identified to ensure a smooth transition to our school; therefore, interviews will take place on a rolling basis, and the school reserves the right to make an appointment before the advertised closing date.

title: Frederik på 8 år i Farum mangler sin voksenven. Så søger du et deltidsarbejde, hvor hyggelige cykelture er i højsædet så se her!
description:
Måske er du uddannet socialpædagog, pædagog eller har masser af erfaring med børn med særlige behov. Og kan du betegne dig selv som værende moden, med en mental robusthed, og trives med en fast struktur så se her!

Om Frederik                                             

Frederik er 8 år gammel men grundet hans kognitive udfordringer er han sammenligning med et barn på 1,5. Han har diagnoserne infantil autisme og mental retardering i sværere grad. Derudover har Frederik ADHD og har ikke et talesprog. Frederik er en sød og kærlig dreng som hurtigt viser tillid til de personer han omgås. Kvag hans diagnoser er Frederik meget afhængig af en fast struktur, rutiner og forudsigelighed, så det er et krav at du som hjælper har erfaring indenfor området og kan bidrage til en struktureret og forudsigelig dag. 

 

Om opgaven 

Opgaven går ud på at aflaste forældrene i eftermiddagstimerne, hvor en stor del af dette er, at hjælpe Frederik ud på sin faste daglige tur ud af huset, på en fast rute i det naturskønne område omkring familiens hjem. Til turen som varer ca. en time, har familien en el dreven ladcykel til formålet. 

Derudover holder Frederik også af at hoppe på familiens trampolin i haven, så du skal som hjælper også bruge tid på trampolinen, sammen med ham. Det er vigtigt at du er klar på at Frederik skal overvåges hele tiden og have hjælp til det meste i løbet af dagen, inklusiv eventuel hjælp til bleskift.. Familien vil stå for grundig oplæring af alle opgaver omkring Frederik, da det er vigtigt for dem at du som hjælper føler dig tryg og du vil derfor blive budt indenfor i et kærligt og omsorgsfuldt hjem. 

Hvem er du?

Du skal være i stand til at skabe de trygge rammer og forudsigelighed som Frederik har behov for. Have et kærligt sind, let til smil og sidst men ikke mindst, lyst til at være fysisk aktiv på de daglige cykelture året rundt som jobbet kræver. Kan du sige ja til disse ting, vil du blive budt indenfor hos en kærlig, rummelig familie hvor du vil gøre en kæmpe forskel.

Timerne

title: Teamlead Reliability Engineers (m/w/d) (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
description:
Operations and technicians

Teamlead Reliability Engineers

Imagine a future where you lead an international engineering team that improves the safety, reliability, and performance of our wind farms.Join us in this role where you’ll provide people and technical leadership to the Continental Europe Reliability Engineering team. You’ll set priorities, develop capabilities, and enable consistent, high-quality reliability support across our wind farms. Through data-driven decisions and close collaboration, you’ll help address technical risks, improve asset performance, and strengthen the way we work across sites and turbine platforms. Welcome to Generation CE You’ll be part of WTG Engineering where you, together with your colleagues, will support our operational sites by identifying and addressing technical risks, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, and improvement opportunities. You’ll connect Reliability Engineers, site teams, CE Engineering, Technical Support, and other specialist functions to coordinate effective corrective and preventive actions. As a team, we share knowledge, support one another, and turn technical insight into practical improvements. We succeed as one by building trust across sites, giving our experts the context and space to make decisions, and keeping safety at the heart of our work. You’ll play an important role in: leading, motivating, and developing an international team of Reliability Engineers through clear objectives, coaching, competence planning, and development conversations translating Generation, CE Engineering, and site priorities into an aligned reliability engineering plan with clear ownership, milestones, and outcomes ensuring structured analysis of reliability performance, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, technical risks, and emerging trends overseeing root-cause analyses, technical assessments, corrective and preventive actions, and prioritised reliability improvement initiatives strengthening consistent reliability practices, knowledge sharing, and collaboration across operational sites, engineering functions, suppliers, and technical support teams promoting a proactive safety culture and ensuring compliance with asset integrity, HSE, governance, and applicable technical requirements. To succeed in the role, you: have a relevant technical or engineering qualification within mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, reliability, asset management, wind energy, or a comparable field, or equivalent experience bring leadership experience that enables you to develop people, set priorities, allocate resources, and create clarity across an international or multi-site team understand wind turbine operations, reliability engineering, technical support, maintenance engineering, asset integrity, or another high-reliability industry have strong knowledge of reliability and continuous-improvement methods, such as root-cause analysis, trend analysis, failure-mode analysis, reliability-centred maintenance, risk assessment, and corrective-action management can interpret technical and operational performance data and turn your findings into clear priorities, decisions, and measurable improvement actions communicate complex technical matters clearly, build trusted stakeholder relationships, and work professionally in English. Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply. Shape the future with us Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate. As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com (accommodation@orsted.com) . Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position. Position salary range: For this role, the base pay will be determined according to the relevant pay structure for the location where the position is filled. Actual pay will be based on skills, experience, and the expected role fulfilment to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package. Pay details specific to your location will be provided during the interview process.Pre-employment background checks:For certain positions, a background check may be required as part of the hiring process. Because we recruit across multiple countries, the specific checks performed will depend on the role and the legal requirements in the location where the position is filled. If a background check is relevant for the role you are being considered for, you will be informed during the recruitment process. All background checks are carried out by an external provider and always in accordance with applicable local laws and regulations.

Rolling and longitudinal seam welding

About the position

We are looking for a reliable and motivated Production Operator to join our production team. You will work with rolling of metal components and operation of an automatic longitudinal seam welding machine. You do not need to be a qualified welder or have a formal vocational education. The most important things are a good technical understanding, a willingness to learn, attention to quality and the ability to work safely and responsibly.

Your main responsibilities

Ø  Operate rolling machines and production equipment.

Ø  Operate and monitor an automatic longitudinal seam welding machine.

Ø  Set up and make minor adjustments to machines and equipment.

Ø  Monitor the production process and ensure stable production.

Ø  Carry out basic dimensional and visual quality checks.

Ø  Identify deviations and report problems to the team leader or supervisor.

Ø  Keep your workplace clean, organized and safe.

-              At hjælpe med praktiske opgaver i hjemmet og skabe struktur i hverdagen

-              At yde personlig støtte og hjælp efter behov

-              At ledsage og støtte ved indkøb, gåture og andre daglige aktiviteter

-              At være med til at skabe tryghed og sikkerhed i hjemmet

-              At være opmærksom på hendes behov og kommunikere tydeligt og respektfuldt

-              At bidrage til en hyggelig positiv hverdag

Vi forventer at du:

-              Har en relevant uddannelse eller erfaring inden for pleje og omsorg

-              Er tålmodig, empatisk og omsorgsfuld

-              Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar

-              Er mødestabil og fleksibel

-              Har forståelse for de udfordringer, der kan være forbundet med nedsat syn

-              Er god til at kommunikere og skabe tryg relation

-              Har en positiv indstilling og lyst til at gøre en forskel

-              Kan tale persisk (farsi) eller armensk

Det er vigtigt, at du møder klienten med respekt og nærvær og har lyst til at blive en stabil og tryg del af hendes hverdag. Borgerens selvbestemmelse skal til enhver tid respekteres.

Vi tilbyder:

title: 1.assistent til SMP - Fyn
description:
Vi søger en erfaren 1.assistent til Fyn

Er du serviceminded og kan lide et job med meget kørsel?

SMP Rengøringsservice er i rivende udvikling og søger derfor en erfaren medarbejder på fuldtid (37t), til vores i forvejen stærke team på Fyn.

Som 1.assistent er dit ansvar at sikre afviklingen af den daglige rengøring i samarbejde med din Serviceinspektør

Andre opgaver kan også forekomme.

Du vil have direkte reference til din Serviceinspektør hos SMP rengøringsservice. Jobbet indebærer b.la. følgende arbejdsområder:

•   Skal stå for rengøring af egne pladser og øvrig bemanding iht. rengøringskalenderen

•   Skabe god relation til kunderne

•   Være behjælpelig med afløsning ved. ferie/sygdom

•   Hjælpe ved opstart af nye kunder og opgaver sammen med Serviceinspektør

•   Forefaldne opgaver i samarbejde med din Serviceinspektør

 

Det skal forventes, at timer kan ligge både tidlig morgen, eftermiddag og aften.

 

Hvem er du?

 

Vi søger dig, som trives i en omskiftelig hverdag, hvor opgaverne og dagene aldrig er ens.

Det er ikke vigtigt for dig, at du har faste rammer mandag-fredag fra 8-16, men tværtimod trives du med en flydende hverdag, hvor arbejdsugen kan variere med forskellige tidspunkter på dagen.

Som person kan du nikke genkendende til, at du:

•   Har erfaring med erhvervsrengøring

•   Trives i en til tider hektisk hverdag

•   Står til rådighed for rengøring af egne pladser

•   deler telefonvagt efter forudgående aftale

     står for sidemandsoplæring af rengøringspersonale

•   Kan håndtere og omgås forskellige kulturer

•   Behersker dansk og engelsk i skrift og tale på et rimeligt niveau

•   Har kørekort

•   Kan fremvise straffeattest

Du får stillet en firmabil til rådighed, samt firmatelefon- iPad, og arbejdsbeklædning.

Vi glæder os meget til at lære dig at kende - så hvis du kan se dig selv i denne stilling, bedes du sende din ansøgning til: job@smpservice.dk  - husk at mærke ansøgningen ” 1.assistent Fyn”

 

Samtaler bliver holdt løbende.

 

Har du ikke hørt fra os inden den 04.10.2026, skal du betragte jobbet som besat til anden side.

 

SMP er en velrenommeret virksomhed i rengøringsbranchen, - og det vil vi gerne blive ved med at være

Vi beskæftiger i dag mere end 300 medarbejdere med kunder i en stor del af Danmark. Vi har landsdækkende og lokale aftaler inden for kontor, produktion, skoler, slagterier, bagerier, butikker, supermarkeder mv.

title: Pædagog, ergoterapeut eller social- og sundhedsassistent søges til Naturly – 37 timer
description:
Vil du være med til at gøre en forskel for unge – også når dagen ikke går helt efter planen?

Naturly søger en pædagog, ergoterapeut eller social- og sundhedsassistent til en fast stilling på 37 timer ugentligt på vores børne- og ungehjem.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan skabe ro, struktur, relation og udvikling omkring unge, som har brug for voksne, der både kan stå fast og være nysgerrige på det, der ligger bag en adfærd.

Hvem er vi?

Naturly er et mindre, privat børne- og ungehjem med 5 pladser efter Barnets Lov § 43 samt 1 fleksibel plads efter Servicelovens § 107.

Vores målgruppe er unge i alderen 12–22 år, som blandt andet kan have ADHD/opmærksomhedsforstyrrelser, angst, stressbelastning, tilknytningsvanskeligheder og erfaringer med omsorgssvigt.

Vi arbejder med KRAP som pædagogisk metode samt en mentaliserende og strukturpædagogisk tilgang.

Hos os skal faglighed ikke kun stå i en metodebeskrivelse. Den skal kunne ses i hverdagen, i relationen til den unge, i vores refleksioner og i vores dokumentation.

Vi søger dig, der

er uddannet pædagog, ergoterapeut eller social- og sundhedsassistent, og som har lyst til at arbejde tæt sammen med unge, kolleger og ledelse.

Du må gerne have erfaring fra døgnområdet eller med vores målgruppe, men det vigtigste er, at du er nysgerrig, stabil, ansvarlig og fagligt reflekterende.

Du skal kunne bevare roen, når en ung har svært ved det, være nysgerrig på det, der ligger bag adfærden, og samtidig være tydelig omkring de rammer, der skaber tryghed og forudsigelighed.

Vi prioriterer din faglige udvikling

På Naturly skal man ikke stå alene med de faglige udfordringer. Vi prioriterer tid til refleksion, sparring og udvikling af vores fælles praksis.

Hos os får du blandt andet:

• Løbende supervision
• Faglig sparring med kolleger og ledelse
• Faste faglige drøftelser
• Mulighed for relevante kurser og kompetenceudvikling
• En arbejdsplads med korte beslutningsveje og tæt kontakt til ledelsen
• Mulighed for at være med til at præge og udvikle vores faglige praksis
• Et tværfagligt kollegialt fællesskab med fokus på en fælles faglig retning

Arbejdet foregår i døgnregi, og vagterne vil derfor også omfatte aften, weekend og døgnvagter.

Det vigtigste for os er ikke, om der står pædagog, ergoterapeut eller social- og sundhedsassistent på dit eksamensbevis. Det vigtigste er, hvad du bringer med dig ind ad døren – fagligt og menneskeligt.

Stillingen: Fastansættelse, 37 timer ugentligt.
Tiltrædelse: Snarest muligt eller efter aftale.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette.

Har du lyst til at høre mere om stillingen eller Naturly, hører vi meget gerne fra dig.

Naturly – et lille sted med plads til udvikling.
