title: PRODUKTIONSTEKNISK SUPPORTER TIL MAYEKAWA NORDIC A/S
description:
Bliv en del af en helt ny afdeling, og hold styr på systemer og processer

For english version, click here.

Til Mayekawa Nordic A/S, søger vi en Produktionsteknisk Supporter med fokus på at holde systemerne kørende og få tingene gjort færdige.

Mayekawa Nordic A/S har endnu engang bedt os om at finde den rette person til en vigtig funktion. De søger en Produktionsteknisk Supporter, der kan skabe/fastholde struktur, understøtte udvikling og være et vigtigt bindeled i den tekniske hverdag.

Mayekawa Nordic A/S har deres domicil i Middelfart og fungerer som nordisk udviklingscenter for den japanske koncern Mayekawa. Virksomheden udvikler industrielle køleanlæg og varmepumper og er særligt kendt for mCHILLER-serien, der bruger det naturlige kølemiddel ammoniak og på den måde opnår høj energieffektivitet og bæredygtighed.

Afdelingen du kommer ind i findes ikke endnu. Den skal bygges op fra bunden, og du bliver en af de to første på plads, nemlig en leder og dig. Lederen sætter retning og bygger rammerne, og sammen bærer I det daglige arbejde i systemerne og holder dem kørende. Du er rigtig god til værktøjerne, og du trives med det. Og fordi afdelingen er så ny, er du med til at forme den, mens den bliver til.

Da der vil være behov for at besøge produktionsenheden i Serbien, skal du forvente op til 25 rejsedage om året.

Ansvarsområder
Du holder styr på det, der skal være i orden, for at resten kan fungere. Ansvaret er dit:

  • Færdiggøre og justere 3D modeller med henblik på produktion.

  • Styre tegningspakker og -lister.

  • Struktureret organisering af emner og koder.

  • Opbygning og vedligehold af styklister og BOM-lister.

  • Vedligeholdelse af produktmanualer.

  • Arbejdet i ERP- og PDM-systemerne.

  • Beskrivelse af delelementer, så de er til at forstå for produktionen.

Arbejdsopgaver
Meget af dit ansvar og arbejde ligger på det udførende plan, tæt på tegningerne og værktøjerne:

  • CAD-automatisering og workflows i praksis.

  • Oprette, opdatere og frigive tegninger.

  • Fra prototype til produktionsmodel, frem til sidste test inden overlevering.

  • Leverandørkontakt og indkøbsspecifikationer.

Faglige kompetencer
Du har sikkert en baggrund som maskinmester, produktions teknolog eller noget, der ligner. Du har arbejdet med konstruktion før, og har du haft fingrene i produktionssiden også, er det et klart plus.

Afdelingen skal samlet mestre en række tekniske områder, og du kommer til at bære en god del af det håndværksmæssige. Det gælder Vault og Inventor, herunder automatisering og workflows, mekanisk design og montageprocesser, kendskab til produktionsteknologi og erfaring med ERP- og PDM-systemer. Viden om svejsning, pladebearbejdning, rør og fittings er en fordel.

Personlige kompetencer
Du er struktureret og fokuseret, og du får tingene færdige frem for at kaste dig over det næste. Du tager selv initiativ, når der skal findes en løsning, og du venter ikke på, at nogen beder dig om det.

Du kan arbejde selvstændigt og er samtidig en holdspiller. Ja, det er en klassiker, men her betyder den noget. I er kun to i afdelingen, så I skal kunne stå på egne ben hver især og samtidig trække på samme hammel, når det gælder.

Og så kan du finde vej i en organisation, der endnu ikke er struktureret. For det er præcis det, du kommer til: at være med til at skabe strukturen, der ikke er der endnu.

Det vil være en fordel for dig, hvis du har interesse i eller erfaring med, at arbejde i et internationalt miljø, med relationer og kontakter uden for landets grænser. Derfor er det også væsentligt, at du taler engelsk på et højere niveau.

Mayekawa Nordic tilbyder

  • Et spændende og selvstændigt job med stor frihed i udførelsen af opgaverne og gode muligheder for både personlig og faglig udvikling.

  • Du vil være en del af et dynamisk og engageret team, hvor der er en uformel tone og en god atmosfære.

  • En attraktiv lønpakke, inklusive pensionsordning og sundhedsforsikring.

  • Fleksible arbejdstider, der matcher dine rejseaktiviteter.

  • Mulighed for hjemmearbejde.

Din primære arbejdsplads vil være på kontoret i Middelfart.

Er det dig, der skal holde det hele kørende?
Kan du se dig selv i systemerne til daglig, med ansvaret for at data, koder og styklister er i orden, og med hænderne i tegningerne hele vejen fra idé til overlevering? Så vil vi gerne høre fra dig.

Praktiske forhold
Den optimale tiltrædelse er 1. december 2026, men den rigtige kandidat betyder mere end datoen, så vi venter gerne. Der er ingen fast ansøgningsfrist.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og afslutter processen, når vi har fundet den rette. Så vil du med, er det med at sende ansøgningen af sted.

Kontakt
Hvis du har spørgsmål, der vedrører stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte John Pagaard på +45 2090 4970.

Vigtigt: Ansøgning og CV skal sendes via Ansøgningslinket, så vi får dit materiale ind i vores rekrutteringssystem (GDPR).

xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx

Om Mayekawa
Mayekawa er en familieejet virksomhed, grundlagt af Kisaku Maekawa i 1924. Siden da er den vokset til at være en af verdens førende inden for industriel køling med mere end 4.500 medarbejdere fordelt over hele kloden.

Den første stempelkompressor kom i 1934. Siden har Mayekawa arbejdet videre med MYCOM kompressorteknologien, og i dag står MYCOM som det stærkeste navn i branchen.

Naturlige kølemidler har været omdrejningspunktet fra begyndelsen, fordi hensynet til miljøet vejer tungt hos Mayekawa. Industriel køling er stadig kerneforretningen, men virksomheden arbejder også med udstyr til kødforarbejdning og med robotteknologi.

Om Mayekawa Nordic A/S
Mayekawa Nordic A/S er udviklingscenter for standard chillers og varmepumper under Mayekawa Europe. Det er her mCHILLER Series bliver udviklet. I 2021 kom mCHILLER FUGU, en vandkølet ammoniak chiller, og i oktober 2022 fulgte mCHILLER TAKA, som er luftkølet.

Organisationen er flad. Man spørger, når man er i tvivl, og man hjælper både sit team og sin leder med at få tingene til at lykkes.

Som ny kollega kommer du ind i en virksomhed, der ligger helt fremme i branchen, og som ser på hele mennesket. Der er balance mellem arbejde og privatliv.

Mayekawa prioriterer arbejdsmiljøet og bakker det op med sociale aktiviteter og en fri og ærlig omgangstone, hvor der er plads til sjov og til at være den, man er, blandt kolleger der bliver hængende. De værdier skal gerne passe til dine egne.

Arbejdsadresse

Mayekawa Nordic A/S
Damgårdvej 6,
5500 Middelfart

www.mayekawa.dk

title: Creative Lead at NAKED Copenhagen
description:
Join NAKED Copenhagen as our new Creative Lead

Do you see visuals before they exist? Do you know how to turn brand identity into campaigns, designs, content, and experiences that people remember?

Then you might be the Creative Lead we’re looking for at NAKED Copenhagen.

This is not just a design role. It’s a key creative position at the heart of our Marketing & Creative Team, someone who’s shaping how NAKED Copenhagen looks, feels, and communicates across every touchpoint.


About the Role

As our new Creative Lead, you’ll take ownership of our visual direction and help bring our brand universe to life across digital, physical, and social platforms.

Working closely with Stine, our Founder & CEO, you’ll play a key role in translating NAKED Copenhagen’s vision into creative concepts, campaigns, and experiences that resonate with our colleagues, partners, community, and customers.

You’ll collaborate closely with various professionals in the Marketing & Creative Team, as well as E-Commerce, Retail, Buying & Merchandising, and external partners, to develop ideas and execute content that strengthens our brand presence.

From campaign editorials and website experiences to social media, collaborations, and product design, you’ll be a central part of shaping, maintaining, and evolving the NAKED Copenhagen identity.


What You’ll Do

•          Owning and evolving the brand's creative direction and visual identity across all customer touchpoints.

•          Developing creative concepts and leading the visual execution of campaigns, content and brand experiences.

•          Design and deliver exciting, engaging graphics across web pages, newsletters, logos, signs, advertisements, instore window layouts and other communication materials.

•          Leading art direction for photo, video and content productions while ensuring a consistently high creative standard.

•          Overseeing the visual expression across digital platforms, retail, events and all brand communication.

•          Collaborating closely with Marketing, Ecommerce and other key teams to translate business objectives into compelling creative solutions.

•          Leading selected collaborations, special projects and brand activations that strengthen the brand's visual identity and positioning.

 

Who You Are

•          A confident creative thinker with a strong eye for aesthetics, detail, and visual storytelling.

•          5+ years of experience within the fashion and lifestyle industry, with a scope including execution on design processes, graphic design, and campaign development.

•          Experience with developing visual concepts from idea to final execution.

•          Passionate about fashion, sneakers, culture, and contemporary brand building.

•          Comfortable balancing creativity with ambitious commercial goals and deadlines.

•          Able to work independently while collaborating closely with different teams while translating the creative agenda and vision.

•          Structured, proactive, and able to manage multiple projects at once as we always operate with an ambitious marketing calendar.

•          Strong understanding of digital platforms, social media trends, and content creation.

•          Communicate confidently in English, written and spoken.

•          Have experience from a similar creative, design, or brand-focused role.

About the Marketing & Creative Team

You’ll join our Marketing & Creative Team led by Simon, our Buying & Marketing Director. Together, the team shapes and executes everything from campaigns and launches to shoots, social content, events, and brand collaborations.

What We Offer

•          A fast-moving and creative work environment.

•          A role where your ideas directly shape the NAKED Copenhagen brand.

•          Creative ownership and responsibility from day one.

•          Close collaboration with a passionate team across marketing, e-commerce, retail, and buying.

•          Hands-on involvement in campaigns, launches, collaborations, and brand experiences.

•          A workplace where creativity, energy, and teamwork matter.

•          A job that goes beyond the desk.

Interested?

Please send your CV and application in English or Danish to job@nakedcph.com with “Creative Lead” in the subject line.

We’re looking forward to meeting you.

On behalf of,
Simon, Marketing & Creative Department
& the rest of the NAKED Copenhagen Team

title: Fleet Koordinator med flair for IT – er du vores nye problemknuser?
description:
Hans Jensen & Koldkur Transport er moderne transportvirksomheder indenfor tank- og silotransport, er aktive indenfor både- Fødevare- foder- tekniske samt ADR-produkter. Vi har bæredygtighed som en kerneværdi, og vi stræber efter at gøre tingene ordentligt, samt sætter en ære i at yde den bedste service i branchen.

Vi er ISO9001, ISO22000, ISO14001, GMP+, samt SQAS certificeret.

 Vores piloter bruger Transics, Volvo Connect og deres mobiltelefon mange gange hver eneste dag.
Når noget driller, skal de have én person på kontoret, de kan ringe til. En der tager telefonen, tager ejerskab og løser problemet. Det er dig. Vi har oprettet en ny stilling som fleet koordinator med flair for IT.


Du bliver bindeleddet mellem piloter, disponenter og administration, og du griber de opgaver, der i dag falder ned mellem stolene. Du er ikke IT-ansvarlig, og vi forventer ikke, at du kan programmere, men du er typen, der ikke giver op før tingene virker.

Du refererer til vores Business Improvement Manager. Tilsammen råder vi over ca. 150 lastbiler og ca. 200 trailere og en hel flåde af piloter, der regner med, at udstyret fungerer.

 

Dit ansvar og dine opgaver:

·         Ejerskab for de systemer piloterne bruger hver dag: Transics, Volvo Connect og mobiltelefoner, opsætning, drift, vedligehold og fejlretning.

·         Fast kontaktperson for piloterne når IT driller. Du tager opkaldet, finder løsningen og følger op, til det virker.

·         Oplæring af nye piloter i den daglige brug af Transics, Volvo Connect og telefon.

·         IT-kyndig til kolleger på kontoret i Onsild og Fårbæk, kontakt til eksterne IT-leverandører samt IT-indkøb af telefoner og udstyr.

·         Kontrol af følgesedler, logbøger og scanninger på udførte transporter, så ordrerne er klar til fakturering.

·         Registrering af afvigelser og uregelmæssigheder og forslag til, hvordan vi undgår dem næste gang.

·         Rapportering på brændstofforbrug og dieseloptimering som en del af vores "fit for fight"-strategi.

·         Problemknuser på de opgaver, der falder mellem afdelingerne. Du tager bolden i stedet for at sende den videre.

·         Være med til at digitalisere og forenkle vores arbejdsgange, bl.a. i forbindelse med opgraderingen af vores ERP-system.

·         Din arbejdsplads vil være både i Onsild og Faarbæk dér hvor der er brug for dig.

 

Vi forestiller os, at du:

·         Har flair for IT og nyder at finde ud af, hvordan tingene hænger sammen. En IT-uddannelse er ikke et krav.

·         Har erfaring en supportfunktion.

·         Er vant til administrativt arbejde og er øvet i Excel.

·         Er serviceminded og tålmodig og kan forklare teknik, så alle forstår det.

·         Tager ejerskab og træffer beslutninger. Når du siger "det klarer jeg", så sker det.

·         Trives med mange bolde i luften og en hverdag, hvor ikke to dage er ens.

·         Kan begå dig på engelsk og gerne tysk.

·         Har lyst til at lære nyt og dele din viden med kolleger.

·         Har godt humør og et udadvendt væsen.

 

Vi tilbyder:

·         En ny stilling, som du selv er med til at forme.

·         Stor indflydelse og kort vej til beslutninger.

·         Et uformelt miljø med dedikerede kolleger og piloter, der sætter stor pris på én, der løser problemerne.

·         Mulighed for at udvikle dig i takt med vores digitalisering.

 

Om os:

Vores forretning er designet til at gøre transport enkel, pålidelig, bæredygtig og digitalt. Vores kunder kalder vi for samarbejdspartnere, og flere af dem har vi samarbejdet med i årtier. Vi arbejder ud fra to lokationer, Onsild ved Hobro og Faarbæk ved Karup.  

Du kan læse mere om os på www.hansjensen.eu  - www.koldkur.dk

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Hvis stillingen lyder som noget for dig, så send din ansøgning og CV til Jonas Stegger, Business Improvement Manager på jos@hansjensen.eu hurtigst muligt. Vi ønsker stillingen besat snarest muligt.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen er du velkommen til at kontakte Jonas på telefon 52 13 19 89.

title: Kitchen workers to a catering company close to Copenhagen Airport
description:
Kitchen worker - Copenhagen

Mission

Summary:

This individual works in the Production department performing a variety of possible tasks that involve everything with salads, fruits, vegetables, sandwiches, desserts, and other food items that require to be in cold temperatures to remain fresh. This may entail preparing and setting up the airline trays with the appropriate sandwiches, fruits, salads, etc. This person may also be involved with slicing and cutting fruits, vegetables, and other foods. Although the individual may not do all the responsibilities mentioned below, employees must be willing and able to perform the tasks below as assignments change frequently and without notice.

Essential tasks:

· Load carts and trolleys with platters, dishes, utensils, and containers.

· Collect serving trays and arrange plates in trays by following the instructions and guidelines.

· When loading trays into the trolleys, ensure they are placed appropriately within the frame of the rack.

· Assist in setting up and packaging special meals and ingredients.

· Complete defined packaging schedule as assigned by supervisor or manager.

· Edit and organize labels outside and inside for the scheduled production of the day.

· Perform proper food packaging and storing based on safety requirements and customer's instructions.

· Tag every rack, tray, and trolley according to company's standards and processes.

· Ensure that left-over ingredients and packaging material are properly labeled and returned in the dry storage,        cooler or packaging material storage.

· Follow all process control documentation.

· Bring trays and packaging material from the warehouse and waiting area.

· Ensure proper and timely recording of activities.

· Report any unsanitary practice and/or unsafe condition.

· Make sure trolleys are properly identified, secured and moved away from chemicals and hazardous substances.

· Follow all food safety, health and safety, company rules and standards.

· Regular and timely attendance is expected for the position.

· Perform other duties as assigned.

Education/experience requirements: 

· No experience required, but any experience in fast-paced environments is helpful.

Qualifications:

·          Must be comfortable working in a cold environment – occasionally.

·          Ability to read and follow specifications and instructions in English

·          Ability to work quickly and safely

·          Ability to show flexibility in working in various areas of the department

·          Ability to know how one's performance affects the areas before and after you

·          Ability to read and speak to understand instructions from supervisors and co-workers.

·          Speak Danish or English

·          Be a Danish or Swedish residence (mandatory).

Physical environment

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential responsibilities of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential responsibilities.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee will be exposed to occasionally cold temperature environment. The individual is required to stand or walk for the entire shift (there are breaks however).

Working hours and others:

This is a full-time position, but the specific weekly working hours depend on the shift. You will have to work weekends. You must have permission to work in Denmark and be able to complete a security check, which among other things, require a clean criminal record.

We are located in Dragør, next to Copenhagen Airport.

If you have any questions, please contact Deputy Production Manager Morten Degn on m.degn@newrest.eu

If you haven't heard from us no later than 14 days after applying, we have moved on with other candidates.

title: (Senior) Solution Architect
employer: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
description:
Do you want to design and evolve modern organisation-wide architecture that enables investments, from climate and health to food systems worldwide? And are you ready to take a pivotal role in one of the most ambitious digital transformations in Danish development finance?

At Impact Fund Denmark, you join a mission-driven organisation with a clear purpose — to finance projects that bring sustainable development to life, from forestry in Paraguay to solar energy in Brazil and diagnostics in Bangladesh.

Here is what you get with us:

  • A leading role in shaping our holistic organisation‑wide solution architecture

  • Collaboration with highly skilled IT professionals in a friendly and inclusive culture

  • Access to the full suite of Microsoft enterprise tools in a modern and tech-driven environment

Global impact, strong IT culture and meaningful teamwork

Impact Fund Denmark is Denmark’s development finance institution, investing in sustainable solutions that create measurable impact in developing countries. While headquartered in Copenhagen, our work extends across more than 45 countries, supported by six regional offices and unite 24 nationalities under one purpose.

You will be part of the Technology & Operations team, which is expanding to 26 professionals, including specialists in processes, architecture, data, and IT Security. Here, you will join a team of experienced and collaborative professionals who are eager to share knowledge and support each other across disciplines.

You shape our digital backbone and architectural direction

We are looking for an Solution Architect, to take the lead in designing, maintaining, and governing the company wide architecture that underpins our global impact. You ensure coherence across platforms, promote future‑ready solutions, and translate business needs into secure, scalable, and well‑governed technologies. Along the way, you will work closely with our subject matter experts, and various business stakeholders.

You will, for example:

  • Design and maintain the end‑to‑end organisation-wide architecture for our technology stack, which includes Dynamics 365 CE and F&O, Power Platform, Fabric, Copilot and related SaaS systems.

  • Co-own and enforce best practices for deployment, release management, and technical documentation

  • Define and create Architecture Principles for our entire technology stack e.g. integration principles and patterns that govern how applications and data interconnect

  • Drive a forward‑looking technology perspective, monitoring trends and identifying improvements

  • Drive technology selection to evaluate and assess new applications or technology requests to improve our internal value generation and efficiency.

You bring technical insights and architectural understanding

With your background in architectural areas like, Solution Architecture, application/system architecture, Software Architecture or transferable roles), you understand how to turn technical complexity into structured, long-term solutions.

We imagine that you:

  • Hold a relevant degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field

  • Have strong experience with solution architecture and how applications and platforms integrate

  • Understand IT governance, data protection, and compliance

  • Communicate clearly with both engineers and business stakeholders

  • Desirably have experience from the financial sector

Our current technology stack is among others based:

  • Dynamics CE

  • Dynamics F&O

  • M365

  • Microsoft Fabric

  • Microsoft Dataverse

  • and several fit for purpose SaaS solutions/applications

Ready to build the digital foundation for global impact?

As part of the recruitment process, we need your targeted CV, preferably with a brief motivational statement at the top. We will be conducting interviews on an ongoing basis, so do not wait too long to apply.

CVs not submitted via the platform will not be considered. The start date is as soon as possible, but we are ready to wait for the right candidate.

We look forward to hearing from you!

About Impact Fund Denmark

Impact Fund Denmark (IFU – the Investment Fund for Developing Countries) is a Danish impact investor contributing to green, just and inclusive societies as well as supporting the Sustainable Development Goals. Impact Fund Denmark provides risk capital to companies operating in developing countries across Africa, Asia, Latin America and parts of Europe. Investments are made on commercial terms in the form of equity, loans and guarantees. Impact Fund Denmark has co-invested in over 1,300 companies in more than 100 developing countries and emerging markets. Contracted investments total EUR 31 billion, of which Impact Fund Denmark has contributed EUR 3.4 billion. Capital under management will be growing from EUR 2.1 billion to EUR 5.0 billion over the next few years. Read more at Impact Fund Denmark.

title: Sagsbehandler søges til Det Specialiserede Voksenområde
description:
Socialafdelingens Enhed for Længerevarende Indsatser søger pr. 1. december 2026 eller hurtigst muligt en erfaren kollega, som har lyst til at arbejde med mennesker med en varig fysisk og eller psykisk funktionsnedsættelse og deres pårørende og netværk. 

Myndighedsafdelingen i Socialafdelingen er organiseret i tre enheder. Enheden for Forebyggelse og Afklaring, Enheden for Midlertidige Indsatser og Enheden for Længerevarende Indsatser.

I Enheden for Længerevarende Indsatser har vi ansvaret for de borgere, som har brug for en indsats fra Socialafdelingen hele deres liv, herunder for eksempel et længerevarende botilbud og et dagtilbud.

Vi har fokus på at indgå i et inddragende og virkningsfuldt samarbejde med borgerne og deres netværk. Vi er optagede af, om vores indsatser virker efter hensigten, og vi arbejder målrettet mod størst mulig selvhjulpenhed og (re)habilitering for vores borgere. 

Vi udreder alle borgere efter voksenudredningsmetoden. Vi har et tæt og godt samarbejde med kommunens bo- og dagtilbud på voksenområdet, borgerne og deres pårørende samt en række eksterne samarbejdspartnere på området.

Som afdeling lægger vi vægt på, at der er plads til sparring, vidensdeling og til at hjælpe hinanden i hverdagen. Vi har travlt, men vi har også plads til humor og god omgangstone, og vi lægger vægt på et godt arbejdsmiljø.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil være

  • rådgivning og vejledning af voksne med nedsat funktionsevne og deres pårørende
  • sagsbehandling inden for voksenområdet efter Servicelovens bestemmelser for voksne, herunder voksenudredninger og indstilling til hjælp
  • udarbejdelse af afgørelser og handleplaner
  • opfølgnings- og afklaringssamtaler med borgere, pårørende og samarbejdspartnere 
  • udarbejdelse af værgemåls- og flytteindstillinger til Familieretshuset

Vi forventer at du

  • er uddannet socialrådgiver, socialformidler eller har anden relevant uddannelse
  • har erfaring med eller interesse for det specialiserede voksenområde
  • har kendskab til voksenudredningsmetoden og arbejder systematisk med ansøgnings- og opfølgningssager
  • har et højt refleksionsniveau og er i stand til at reflektere over egen rolle i arbejdet
  • er serviceorienteret, fleksibel og har et godt humør samt gode samarbejdsevner

Vi tilbyder

  • en arbejdsplads, hvor der er plads til sparring og vidensdeling med kolleger, faglige konsulenter og ledelse
  • varierede arbejdsopgaver med stor kompleksitet
  • fokus på medarbejdertrivsel og høj faglighed
  • en arbejdsplads på Frederiksberg Rådhus – centralt i Hovedstaden med let adgang til både bus og metro

Vil du vide mere?

Så er du velkommen til at ringe til Enhedsleder Hanne Frøsig på 28 98 31 81.

Løn og ansættelsesforhold

Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst med Dansk Socialrådgiverforening, Frederiksberg Kommune Kommunal Forening eller anden forhandlingsberettiget organisation. Lønnen forhandles efter principperne om Ny løn.

Arbejdstiden er 37 timer om ugen med flekstidsordning.

Ansøgning

Ansøgningen sendes via Frederiksberg Kommunes hjemmeside, hvor du bedes ansøge om den ledige stilling fra selve stillingsopslaget. Vedlæg CV og kopi af eksamenspapirer.

Ansøgningsfristen er torsdag den 22. oktober kl. 12.00, og vi forventer at afholde samtaler mandag den 26. oktober og tirsdag den 27. oktober.


Frederiksberg er en levende by med et dynamisk bysamfund. Byens sjæl bygger på vores historie og klassiske arv og er med til at præge den spændende udvikling af Frederiksberg som en grøn, sund og pulserende del af Hovedstaden.
Vi er en moderne kommune, der betjener 104.305 borgere. Frederiksberg Kommune ønsker at fremme ligestillingen og opfordrer derfor alle kvalificerede til at søge uanset alder, handicap, race, hudfarve, religion eller tro, politisk anskuelse, seksuel orientering, kønsidentitet, kønsudtryk eller kønskarakteristika eller national, social eller etnisk oprindelse.

title: Chef / Cook – Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar, Kalundborg
description:
Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar is looking for skilled and motivated Chefs / Cooks to join our established restaurant in Kalundborg, Denmark.

Our restaurant in Kalundborg is a well-run, busy operation with a proven concept, experienced ownership and a clear direction. Located right in the middle of Kalundborg's main pedestrian street, we are a lively, pulsing part of the town and a gathering place for its residents. Our purpose is to create a vibrant place for the people of Kalundborg, built on quality ingredients and good food. We are now strengthening our kitchen team and are looking for chefs who want to become part of a structured, professional kitchen and contribute to consistent, high-quality service every day.

Our concept is based on modern Danish cuisine with a Nordic twist, combined with well executed brasserie classics and a varied à la carte menu. We focus on quality ingredients, solid craftsmanship and seasonal cooking, with dishes that combine flavour, comfort and consistency. Our menu includes both classic meat dishes, such as pepper steak, pasta dishes and other popular brasserie favourites.

Alongside our à la carte service, we have a private dining and events room, which you will also be part of. It brings welcome variety to the daily kitchen work, with menus that differ from the standard à la carte and the chance to cook for parties, celebrations and special occasions.

You will be joining a business with an already proven concept, an organised kitchen and a strong operational foundation. The setup is stable and well prepared, giving you a secure framework in which to do great work and develop your craft. Here you also get the freedom to bring your own ideas to life. We are not a place where everything is dictated from above — our chefs and kitchen staff are given the room to develop dishes, contribute to the menu and put their own mark on the food.

We are a serious but friendly workplace with respectful leadership, an organised kitchen environment and a no-drama culture. We believe strong kitchens are built on structure, teamwork and professionalism.

We are looking for chefs / cooks who:
• Have experience working in a professional kitchen
• Can handle prep, mise en place and service in a structured way
• Have experience with à la carte service
• Care about quality, teamwork and consistency
• Thrive in a busy restaurant environment
• Can work independently and take responsibility during service

We offer:
• Full-time employment
• A fixed work schedule
• Weekend work is part of the position
• Salary of approximately DKK 30,000–35,000 gross per month, depending on qualifications and experience
• Five weeks of paid holiday
• Company apartment / accommodation available
• Help with relocation and settling in Denmark
• Possibility of support with moving costs and/or paid accommodation in the first month, by agreement
• Good working conditions in a structured and professional environment
• Staff meals
• Work clothing provided
• Staff discounts
• A stable, established restaurant with a proven concept and an organised kitchen
• The freedom to develop your own ideas and contribute to the menu
• A workplace where English can be used in daily communication

Location
The position is based in Kalundborg, Denmark, in the heart of the city's main pedestrian street. Kalundborg offers a local Danish atmosphere, a charming town centre and a good quality of life.

Language
English is required. Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Start date
As soon as possible / by agreement.

How to apply
Please send
• Your CV
• A short introduction about yourself
• Your earliest possible start date

For applications and questions, please contact:
Esbern Snare ApS
Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar
Phone: +45 25 14 44 00
Email: job@esbern-snare.dk

We look forward to hearing from motivated chefs who want to become part of a strong, established kitchen team in Denmark.

Please note that you must already have the right to work in Denmark, either as an EU/EEA or Swiss citizen or by holding a valid Danish work permit that allows you to take this position.

title: ARE YOU THE CHEF WHO CAN TAKE CHARGE OF THE KITCHEN?
description:
SKILLED CHEF WANTED – CAFÉ KRÆMMERHUSET, EBELTOFT

We are not just looking for someone who can cook great food.

We are looking for a skilled and independent chef who can take responsibility for the day’s kitchen production, stay organised and keep the kitchen running smoothly – even when things get busy.

With us, you will have responsibility, trust and freedom in your daily work.

You should be able to come in, assess what needs to be done and independently make sure that preparation, production and service all work together smoothly.

We are looking for someone who:

• is a skilled chef with experience from a professional kitchen
• works independently and in a structured way
• can plan and take responsibility for the day’s production
• has an eye for quality, ingredients, portion sizes and costs
• stays calm and focused during busy periods
• contributes to a clean, organised and well-run kitchen
• is a good colleague who takes responsibility for the bigger picture

In return, we offer:

• a high degree of freedom and responsibility
• real influence on the daily running of the kitchen
• great colleagues and an informal working environment
• proper and reliable working conditions
• a kitchen where quality and good craftsmanship matter
• a workplace in the heart of beautiful Ebeltoft

Café Kræmmerhuset has been part of Ebeltoft since 1982.

We welcome both local regulars and visitors, and our kitchen serves everything from classic café and lunch dishes to grilled dishes, steaks and evening meals.

For us, the most important thing is not a perfect CV.

What matters is that you know your craft, can work independently and are ready to take responsibility.

Could this be you – or do you know the right person?

We would love to hear from you.

Café Kræmmerhuset – Ebeltoft
Great food. Great guests. And room to take responsibility.

title: Strategy & Business Development Analyst
employer: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
description:
Are you motivated by turning analysis into strategic decisions and supporting products that mobilise capital for impact? 

 

The job

As an Analyst in Strategy & Business Development (S&BD) at Impact Fund Denmark, you will support strategy implementation and management-initiated projects through structured analysis, research and preparation of high-quality presentation material. In parallel, you will facilitate Impact Fund Denmark’s collaboration with our owner, the Danish Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

Key responsibilities will include:

  • Support strategy implementation initiatives through analyses, presentations and structured decision material for senior leadership. 

  • Produce insights and fact-based recommendations based on research and analysis. 

  • Facilitate good collaboration with the Danish Ministry of Foreign Affairs by producing meeting materials, and supporting development of new public investment mandates.

  • Support Impact Fund Denmark’s work on stakeholder relations by facilitating internal coordination, producing relevant insights and analysis, and engaging directly with stakeholders.

  • Run and support internal projects in Strategy and Business Development and across the organisation.

 

The team

 

You will join the Strategy & Business Development team and work closely with colleagues in across the organisation. The S&BD team supports senior leadership with strategy development, implementation of priority initiatives, corporate planning and preparation of fact-based decision material.

 

Your qualifications & experience

The ideal candidate will have demonstrated strong analytical capabilities and a structured approach to problem solving. 

  • A relevant Master’s degree with strong academic results. 

  • 1 to 2 years of full-time work experience from relevant positions (e.g. strategy, analytics, consulting, investing or corporate finance)

  • Strong analytical and problem-structuring skills, with the ability to translate analysis into clear messages and presentations. 

  • Strong PowerPoint skills and solid Excel skills. 

  • Fluency in English, written and spoken. 

  • Ability to read and write in Danish in an advantage.

  • A collaborative mindset and motivation to work across strategy, product development and investor relations. 

 

Working and learning at Impact Fund Denmark

Impact Fund Denmark’s learning culture provides the tools and organisation for individual development. Learning is an important element of working in Impact Fund Denmark, and we will support your personal development through training, sparring and by ensuring that you get exciting and challenging tasks and new opportunities for growth. When joining Impact Fund Denmark, you will take part in our extensive onboarding program to get the best possible start in your new role.

Impact Fund Denmark offers a hybrid workplace, allowing you to manage your own time effectively. We have a diverse and inclusive working environment with more than 150 talented individuals from 20+ different nationalities. We work seamlessly together with colleagues around the corner, cross the organization and between offices in Asia, Africa, LATAM and Europe.

About Impact Fund Denmark

Impact Fund Denmark is a Danish impact investor contributing to green, just and inclusive societies as well as supporting the Sustainable Development Goals. Impact Fund Denmark provides risk capital to companies operating in developing countries across Africa, Asia, Latin America and parts of Europe. Investments are made on commercial terms in the form of equity, loans and guarantees. Impact Fund Denmark has co-invested in over 1,300 companies in more than 100 developing countries and emerging markets. Contracted investments total EUR 31 billion, of which Impact Fund Denmark has contributed EUR 3.4 billion. Capital under management will be growing from EUR 2.1 billion to EUR 5.0 billion over the next few years. Read more at www.impactfund.dk.

title: Baker – Bakery Production – Maribo, Lolland, Denmark
description:
Dansk version længere nede

Den Gamle Bagergaard in Maribo is looking for a baker. You do not need a formal qualification if you have practical experience working in a bakery.

We are a family-run business with three bakers and a pastry chef in production. Two packing staff and a driver help get our bread ready and delivered to our shops.

Your work

You will take part in the daily production at the bakery. We are looking for someone who knows their way around a bakery, takes responsibility for their work and enjoys working with colleagues. You must be able to communicate in Danish or understandable English.

You must already have the legal right to work in Denmark, for example through EU/EEA or Swiss citizenship or a valid Danish residence and work permit. We cannot offer visa or work permit sponsorship.

What we offer

  • Gross monthly salary: Based on qualifications and experience. For a qualified baker, the salary starts at approximately DKK 26,000.

  • Permanent, full-time employment

  • Pension scheme

  • 5 weeks of vacation

  • Flexible benefits account

  • Additional pay for applicable night and Sunday work

  • The employer can support you in finding accommodation in the area

The planned working hours start at 01:30 on Mondays and 05:00 from Tuesday to Thursday. You will also work every other weekend. During the night shifts on Mondays and every other weekend, you will bake bread, Danish pastries and other baked goods. We will agree on the schedule together, and working night shifts only is also an option.

The expected start date is 1 November 2026.

Recruitment process

The first interview can be held online if needed. Selected candidates may be invited to visit the bakery before a final employment agreement is made.

We review applications as they arrive, so please apply as soon as possible.

How to apply

Send your application and CV to rekruttering@lolland.dk with “Baker – Maribo” in the subject line.

If you have questions, contact Martin Hansen, Business Consultant and EURES Adviser at Lolland Municipality, on +45 21 47 73 43 or maha@lolland.dk.

We kindly ask recruitment agencies and intermediaries to refrain from contacting us regarding this position. Applications will only be considered if submitted directly by candidates.

About Lolland and relocation support

Lolland is in southern Denmark and offers easy access to nature, beaches and open countryside, along with affordable housing and short commuting distances. The region is developing rapidly, partly due to the Femern Belt Fixed Link between Denmark and Germany.

If you are moving from abroad, Lolland Municipality’s Newcomers Service can help with practical questions about relocation, registration, housing, a partner’s job search and settling in Denmark. Read more at newcomers.lolland.dk. You can also find information about working in Denmark at workindenmark.dk.

___________________________________________________

Den Gamle Bagergaard i Maribo søger en bager. Du behøver ikke at have svendebrev, hvis du har praktisk erfaring fra et bageri.

Vi er en familievirksomhed med tre bagere og en konditor i produktionen. Derudover har vi to pakkere og en chauffør, som kører brød ud til vores udsalg.

Jobbet

Du bliver en del af den daglige produktion i bageriet. Vi søger dig, der kender arbejdet i et bageri, tager ansvar for dine opgaver og trives med at arbejde sammen med andre. Du skal kunne kommunikere på dansk eller forståeligt engelsk.

Det tilbyder vi

  • Løn: Aftales efter kvalifikationer og erfaring i henhold til overenskomsten.

  • Fast fuldtidsstilling

  • Pension, feriepenge og fritvalgskonto

  • Relevante tillæg for nat- og søndagsarbejde

  • Hjælp til at finde en bolig i området, hvis du skal flytte hertil

Arbejdstiden er som udgangspunkt fra kl. 01.30 om mandagen og kl. 05.00 tirsdag til torsdag samt hver anden weekend. Når du møder ind om natten, bager du blandt andet brød og wienerbrød. Vi aftaler den nærmere plan sammen, og det er også muligt kun at arbejde om natten.

Forventet start er 1. november 2026.

Ansættelsesforløb

Den første samtale kan holdes online, hvis der er behov for det. Vi gennemgår ansøgninger løbende, så send gerne din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

Søg jobbet

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til rekruttering@lolland.dk, og skriv “Bager – Maribo” i emnefeltet.

Har du spørgsmål, kan du kontakte virksomhedskonsulent Martin Hansen på 21 47 73 43 eller maha@lolland.dk.

title: Skilled Chef with strong knowledge of Ukrainian cuisine

  • Can communicate in English or Danish

  • Enjoys being part of a hands-on and supportive kitchen team

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Preparing, cooking and portioning Ukrainian dishes

  • Maintaining and standardising recipes

  • Ensuring consistent taste and quality

What we offer

  • A supportive and informal working environment

Location: Best Western Plus Park Globetrotter Copenhagen Airport

title: Sundhedsfaglig medarbejder til fast stilling i primær aftenvagt.
description:
Vil du være en del af Kløverbakkens udvikling?

Vi søger 2 sundhedsfaglige medarbejdere til faste stillinger i primær aftenvagt

På Kløverbakken Friplejehjem står vi foran en spændende udvikling. I starten af december åbner vi 6 nye plejeboliger, og vores hjem vokser fra 24 til 30 boliger. Derfor søger vi nu to sundhedsfaglige medarbejdere til faste stillinger i primær aftenvagt.

På Kløverbakken er beboerne altid i centrum. Vi arbejder ud fra den enkeltes ønsker, behov og livshistorie og lægger stor vægt på tryghed, respekt, værdighed og medbestemmelse.

Vi er en engageret medarbejdergruppe med høj faglighed og et stærkt sammenhold. Hos os hjælper vi hinanden, løfter i fællesskab og tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes gennem tillid, respekt og anerkendelse.

Vi forestiller os, at du er social- og sundhedshjælper, social- og sundhedsassistent eller har en anden relevant sundhedsfaglig baggrund. Du sætter beboeren først, arbejder selvstændigt og trives samtidig i et tæt samarbejde med dine kollegaer.

Hos os ved vi, at livskvalitet ofte skabes gennem de små ting i hverdagen. Den gode samtale, et smil, nærvær, aktiviteter og fællesskab betyder meget for vores beboere.

Vi tilbyder

·        To faste stillinger på 30-34 timer ugentligt i primær aftenvagt.

·        En arbejdsplads med høj faglighed og engagerede kollegaer.

·        En hverdag præget af nærvær, humor og fællesskab.

·        Grundig oplæring og støtte fra erfarne kollegaer.

·        Mulighed for sundhedsforsikring gennem vores medarbejderordning.

·        Mulighed for at blive en del af Kløverbakkens spændende udvikling.

Hvem er vi?

Kløverbakken er et friplejehjem, hvor hjemlighed, nærvær og relationer er omdrejningspunktet for hverdagen. Her er plads til grin, forskelligheder og nye idéer.

Ansøgningsfrist: 16. oktober,

Samtaler: Afholdes løbende, så hold dig ikke tilbage med at sende din ansøgning.

Ansættelse: Ønskes hurtigst muligt eller senest den 1. januar 2027.

Vil du vide mere?

Kontakt Camilla Dahl Christensen på 98 54 18 00 eller cadc@klejtrup-friplejehjem.dk.

Kløverbakken – et hjem med liv, varme og fællesskab

Camilla Dahl Christensen
Forstander
Kløverbakken Friplejehjem

We offer

title: Chef to join our international kitchen team
description:
CHEF WANTED FOR STAFF RESTAURANT IN COPENHAGEN, DENMARK

Looking for a chef position in Copenhagen with great working hours, professional cooking and weekends mostly free?

We are looking for a skilled and motivated chef to join our international kitchen team in Copenhagen, Denmark.

Your main workplace will be The Staff Restaurant at Abacus Medicine, located at Kalvebod Brygge in central Copenhagen.

This is a full-time position with working hours primarily Monday to Friday from 06:30 to 14:30 – giving you the opportunity to work in an ambitious professional kitchen while still having your afternoons, evenings and most weekends free.

Occasional evening and weekend events may occur.

THE JOB

You will become part of a professional kitchen team responsible for the daily production and service at our staff restaurant.

We cook from scratch and care about good ingredients, seasonality, flavour and proper craftsmanship.

You will work primarily with hot kitchen production and take responsibility for your own preparation and tasks while working closely with the rest of the team.

Our kitchen is busy, so we are looking for someone who works efficiently and in an organised manner without compromising quality.

Just as importantly, we are looking for a good colleague.

We believe a professional kitchen should be a place where people communicate respectfully, help each other and enjoy coming to work.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

You may already be living in Denmark, or you may be considering moving to Copenhagen from another EU/EEA country.

We would like to hear from you if you:

  • are a trained chef or have equivalent professional kitchen experience

  • have experience from à la carte restaurants, quality staff restaurants, hotels or similar professional kitchens

  • have solid experience in the hot kitchen

  • have a genuine interest in food, ingredients and good craftsmanship

  • can organise your own work and maintain a good pace throughout the day

  • are reliable and comfortable starting work early

  • enjoy working as part of a team

  • communicate in a positive and respectful way

  • can maintain an overview when the kitchen gets busy.

A background in classic French or Mediterranean cuisine would be particularly relevant to our kitchen.

However, we are also interested in chefs who bring their own culinary background and experience. Whether your inspiration comes from France, Spain, Italy, Portugal, Greece, North or South America, Asia or somewhere else, we would like to see what you can bring to the team.

We want to taste what you are passionate about.

WHAT WE OFFER

We offer a full-time chef position in central Copenhagen with a working schedule that is unusual in the restaurant industry:

Monday–Friday
Primarily 06:30–14:30
Most evenings and weekends free

You will join a friendly and international workplace with experienced colleagues, high professional standards and room to contribute your own knowledge and ideas.

We value professional pride, teamwork, reliability and a positive working environment.

Our goal is simple: good food, good ingredients, good craftsmanship and a kitchen team that works well together.

MORE THAN A STAFF RESTAURANT

Your daily workplace will be:

The Staff Restaurant at Abacus Medicine
Kalvebod Brygge 35
1560 Copenhagen V
Denmark

Our kitchen also produces food for our small Copenhagen wine bar, Sankt Annæ 8, located in Christianshavn.

Within the same ownership group, we operate several Copenhagen restaurants, including Le Métier, La Propina and Ma Cuisine.

You will therefore become part of a wider restaurant family with different concepts and opportunities for future professional development.

PRACTICAL INFORMATION

Position: Chef
Employment: Full-time
Working hours: Primarily Monday–Friday, 06:30–14:30
Workplace: Copenhagen, Denmark
Starting date: As soon as possible / by agreement
Salary: Based on qualifications and experience and agreed individually
Evening/weekend work: Occasional events only

INTERESTED?

Send us your CV and a short application in English to:

job@willworkforfood.dk

Please write “CHEF FOR ABACUS” in the subject line.

Tell us a little about yourself, your kitchen experience, what kind of food you enjoy cooking and when you would be available to start.

Applications are reviewed continuously, and suitable candidates will be invited for an interview.

If you are currently living outside Denmark, please mention your current location and when you would potentially be available to relocate to Copenhagen.

We look forward to meeting you for a coffee and a conversation about food, ambitions and your future in Copenhagen.

The Staff Restaurant at Abacus Medicine
Copenhagen, Denmark

title: Natportier på fuld tid – vær med til at etablere Danmarks første Citybox-hotel
description:
Er du serviceminded, ansvarsbevidst og god til at bevare overblikket – også når resten af byen sover?

Motiveres du samtidig af udvikling, forandring og muligheden for at blive en del af noget nyt?

Så har du nu en spændende mulighed for at blive en vigtig del af transformationen af Best Western Plus Airport Hotel Copenhagen til Danmarks første Citybox-hotel.

Pr. 1. januar 2027 bliver Best Western Plus Airport Hotel Copenhagen en del af Citybox-kæden. Vi søger derfor en fuldtidsnatportier, som både kan sikre en professionel og tryg drift i nattetimerne og bidrage positivt til overgangen til et nyt og moderne hotelkoncept.

Om Citybox

Citybox er en nordisk hotelkæde med hoteller i flere europæiske lande og et koncept bygget på enkelhed, høj kvalitet og smarte digitale løsninger. Målet er at gøre hoteloplevelsen nem, effektiv og tilgængelig – uden at gå på kompromis med kvaliteten.

Som natportier bliver du en del af etableringen af Citybox i Danmark og får mulighed for at være med i overgangen fra et traditionelt hotelsetup til et moderne hotelkoncept med fokus på effektiv drift, teknologi og stærke gæsteoplevelser.

Om stillingen

Som natportier er du hotellets ansvarlige vært i nattetimerne. Du sikrer, at vores gæster føler sig trygge, velkomne og godt hjulpet gennem hele natten.

Hotellets placering tæt på Københavns Lufthavn betyder, at der er aktivitet på alle tider af døgnet. Nattevagterne er derfor ofte travle med ankomster, afgange og gæster, der har brug for hjælp. Det er vigtigt, at du trives i et aktivt arbejdsmiljø, kan håndtere flere opgaver samtidig og bevarer roen, overblikket og den gode gæsteservice.

Stillingen kræver, at du trives med selvstændigt ansvar, samtidig med at du bidrager aktivt til samarbejdet med receptionen og hotellets øvrige afdelinger.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver

  • Sikre en professionel og imødekommende gæsteoplevelse i nattetimerne.

  • Tage imod gæster samt håndtere check-in og check-out.

  • Hjælpe gæster med spørgsmål, ønsker og eventuelle udfordringer.

  • Besvare telefoniske og skriftlige henvendelser.

  • Håndtere reservationer, betalinger og gæsteoplysninger.

  • Gennemføre night audit, afstemninger og øvrige administrative natteopgaver.

  • Klargøre rapporter og sikre en grundig overlevering til morgenholdet.

  • Foretage sikkerheds- og kontrolrunder på hotellet.

  • Håndtere driftsmæssige eller akutte situationer roligt og professionelt.

  • Samarbejde med hotellets øvrige afdelinger for at sikre en sammenhængende gæsteoplevelse.

  • Bidrage aktivt til implementeringen af Citybox-konceptet og tage nye systemer, digitale løsninger og arbejdsgange i brug.

  • Sikre, at hotellets procedurer, kvalitetsstandarder og sikkerhedskrav overholdes.

Arbejdet ligger primært om natten og omfatter vagter på hverdage, i weekender og på helligdage.

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Har erfaring fra hotel, reception, service eller en anden relevant branche.

  • Trives med at arbejde om natten og kan arbejde selvstændigt.

  • Er stabil, ansvarsbevidst og møder til tiden.

  • Er serviceminded, imødekommende og professionel i din fremtoning.

  • Bevarer roen og overblikket, når der opstår uforudsete situationer.

  • Kan træffe selvstændige beslutninger og tage ansvar for hotellets drift om natten.

  • Har gode administrative evner og er fortrolig med IT og digitale løsninger.

  • Gerne har erfaring med bookingsystemer – erfaring med Opera er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

  • Trives i et miljø præget af udvikling og forandring og er åben over for nye systemer, procedurer og måder at arbejde på.

  • Kan håndtere gæsteklager og konflikter på en konstruktiv og løsningsorienteret måde.

  • Taler og skriver dansk eller et andet skandinavisk sprog samt engelsk.

  • Er en god kollega, som bidrager positivt til samarbejdet og hotellets kultur.

Det er vigtigt, at du er tryg ved at arbejde alene i dele af vagten, og at du forstår det ansvar, der følger med at være hotellets primære kontaktperson i nattetimerne.

Vi tilbyder

  • En fuldtidsstilling med selvstændigt ansvar og varierede arbejdsopgaver.

  • En unik mulighed for at være med til etableringen af Danmarks første Citybox-hotel.

  • Mulighed for at følge og bidrage til en spændende transformation.

  • Indflydelse på nye arbejdsgange, processer og gæsteoplevelser.

  • Et internationalt arbejdsmiljø med engagerede kolleger.

  • Grundig oplæring i hotellets systemer, procedurer og sikkerhedsforhold.

  • Faglig og personlig udvikling.

  • Gode ansættelsesvilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst.

  • Personalegoder, sundhedsforsikring og sociale arrangementer.

Stillingen ønskes besat snarest muligt.

Ansættelse snarest muligt. Interviews afholdes løbende, så skynd dig, at sende din ansøgning

Hvis du motiveres af gæsteservice, selvstændigt ansvar og muligheden for at blive en del af transformationen til Danmarks første Citybox-hotel, glæder vi os til at modtage din ansøgning og dit CV.

title: Vi søger en souschef der vil tage ansvar for et køkken ved havet
description:
Vi søger en souschef der vil tage ansvar for et køkken ved havet

Ikke en støtterolle. Du er nummer to i køkkenet og har reel indflydelse på hvad der sker — på tallerkenen og i teamet.

Stedet

Charlottenlund Fort er bygget i 1886 som kystforsvar nord for København. I dag er det en restaurant med 180° udsigt over Øresund, plads til 140 gæster indendørs. Vi laver à la carte til daglige gæster og selskaber op til høj gastronomi — bryllupper, firmafester, private events. Maden er fransk-nordisk og sæsonbaseret.

Det er en destination. Folk tager aktivt herud. Det giver en anden stemning end en byrestaurant — og en anden stolthed over arbejdspladsen.

Hvad du laver

Du arbejder tæt på køkkenchefen og er ansvarlig for køkkenet når han ikke er der. Du holder overblik over daglig produktion, selskaber og personalet i køkkenet. Du er med til at udvikle menuer og sæsonretter, og du sætter standarden for kvalitet og tempo i hverdagen.

Vi leder efter en der

–    Er uddannet kok med solid erfaring fra seriøst køkken

–    Har prøvet at lede og koordinere andre i et travlt køkken

–    Tager ejerskab — også på en svær aften

–    Kommunikerer klart og skaber ro i køkkenet under pres

–    Har ambitioner uden at det går ud over teamet

–    Trives med variation: selskaber, à la carte, sæsonmenuer

 

DET PRAKTISKE

Løn

Fra 35.000 kr./md.

Lønnen afhænger af

Erfaring og niveau

Vagter

Typisk 3-4 vagter/uge, primært 10-22

Fast fri

Mandage + hver anden weekend

Arbejdssted

Charlottenlund Fort, Strandvejen 150

Ansættelse

Snarest muligt

Hvad du ikke får

Vi lover ikke Michelin-drømme eller "en plads i en familie". Vi tilbyder et seriøst køkken, en usædvanlig arbejdsplads og en reel lederrolle. Hvis du er klar til at tage ansvar og vil arbejde et sted der faktisk giver noget at arbejde med, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

 

Send ansøgning og CV til

gustav@charlottenlundfortet.dk

Skriv "Souschef til køkkenet" i emnefeltet.

Vi holder samtaler løbende.

description:
Vi søger en kok der kan lide at arbejde med udsigt til havet

Ikke en metafor. Vores køkken ligger på et historisk fort direkte ud til Øresund. Hvis du er træt af kældre i byen, er det her måske det modsatte.

Stedet

Charlottenlund Fort er bygget i 1886 som kystforsvar nord for København. I dag er det en restaurant med 180° udsigt over Øresund, plads til 160 gæster indendørs og 200+ på terrassen. Vi laver à la carte til daglige gæster og selskaber op til høj gastronomi — bryllupper, firmafester, private events. Maden er fransk-nordisk og sæsonbaseret.

Det er en destination. Folk tager aktivt herud. Det giver en anden stemning end en byrestaurant — og en anden stolthed over arbejdspladsen.

Hvad du laver

Du er en del af et køkken der producerer til to spor: daglig service og selskaber. Det kræver en kok der kan holde overblik, arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for kvaliteten — ikke kun for sin egen station. Du arbejder med friske råvarer, skiftende menuer og har reelt mulighed for at præge køkkenet, hvis du har idéer og viljen til at gennemføre dem.

Vi leder efter en der

–    Er uddannet kok med erfaring fra seriøst køkken

–    Tager faglig stolthed alvorligt — også når det er travlt

–    Kan kommunikere klart og arbejde respektfuldt med kollegerne

–    Trives med variation: selskaber, à la carte, sæsonmenuer

–    Ikke har brug for at blive holdt i hånden

 

DET PRAKTISKE

Løn

Fra 30.000 kr./md.

Lønnen afhænger af

Erfaring og niveau

Vagter

Typisk 3-4 vagter/uge, primært 10-22

Fast fri

Mandage + hver anden weekend

Arbejdssted

Charlottenlund Fort, Strandvejen 150

Ansættelse

Snarest muligt

Hvad du ikke får

Vi lover ikke Michelin-drømme eller "en plads i en familie". Vi tilbyder et seriøst køkken, gode kolleger, en usædvanlig arbejdsplads og ordentlige vilkår. Hvis det matcher hvad du leder efter, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

 

Send ansøgning og CV til

gustav@charlottenlundfortet.dk

Skriv "Kok til køkkenet" i emnefeltet.

Vi holder samtaler løbende.

title: Kitchen workers to a catering company close to Copenhagen Airport
description:
Kitchen worker - Copenhagen

Mission

Summary:

This individual works in the Production department performing a variety of possible tasks that involve everything with salads, fruits, vegetables, sandwiches, desserts, and other food items that require to be in cold temperatures to remain fresh. This may entail preparing and setting up the airline trays with the appropriate sandwiches, fruits, salads, etc. This person may also be involved with slicing and cutting fruits, vegetables, and other foods. Although the individual may not do all the responsibilities mentioned below, employees must be willing and able to perform the tasks below as assignments change frequently and without notice.

Essential tasks:

· Load carts and trolleys with platters, dishes, utensils, and containers.

· Collect serving trays and arrange plates in trays by following the instructions and guidelines.

· When loading trays into the trolleys, ensure they are placed appropriately within the frame of the rack.

· Assist in setting up and packaging special meals and ingredients.

· Complete defined packaging schedule as assigned by supervisor or manager.

· Edit and organize labels outside and inside for the scheduled production of the day.

· Perform proper food packaging and storing based on safety requirements and customer's instructions.

· Tag every rack, tray, and trolley according to company's standards and processes.

· Ensure that left-over ingredients and packaging material are properly labeled and returned in the dry storage,        cooler or packaging material storage.

· Follow all process control documentation.

· Bring trays and packaging material from the warehouse and waiting area.

· Ensure proper and timely recording of activities.

· Report any unsanitary practice and/or unsafe condition.

· Make sure trolleys are properly identified, secured and moved away from chemicals and hazardous substances.

· Follow all food safety, health and safety, company rules and standards.

· Regular and timely attendance is expected for the position.

· Perform other duties as assigned.

Education/experience requirements: 

· No experience required, but any experience in fast-paced environments is helpful.

Qualifications:

·          Must be comfortable working in a cold environment – occasionally.

·          Ability to read and follow specifications and instructions in English

·          Ability to work quickly and safely

·          Ability to show flexibility in working in various areas of the department

·          Ability to know how one's performance affects the areas before and after you

·          Ability to read and speak to understand instructions from supervisors and co-workers.

·          Speak Danish or English

·          Be a Danish or Swedish residence (mandatory).

Physical environment

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential responsibilities of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential responsibilities.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee will be exposed to occasionally cold temperature environment. The individual is required to stand or walk for the entire shift (there are breaks however).

Working hours and others:

This is a full-time position, but the specific weekly working hours depend on the shift. You will have to work weekends. You must have permission to work in Denmark and be able to complete a security check, which among other things, require a clean criminal record.

We are located in Dragør, next to Copenhagen Airport.

If you have any questions, please contact Deputy Production Manager Morten Degn on m.degn@newrest.eu

If you haven't heard from us no later than 14 days after applying, we have moved on with other candidates.

title: (Senior) Solution Architect
employer: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
description:
Do you want to design and evolve modern organisation-wide architecture that enables investments, from climate and health to food systems worldwide? And are you ready to take a pivotal role in one of the most ambitious digital transformations in Danish development finance?

At Impact Fund Denmark, you join a mission-driven organisation with a clear purpose — to finance projects that bring sustainable development to life, from forestry in Paraguay to solar energy in Brazil and diagnostics in Bangladesh.

Here is what you get with us:

  • A leading role in shaping our holistic organisation‑wide solution architecture

  • Collaboration with highly skilled IT professionals in a friendly and inclusive culture

  • Access to the full suite of Microsoft enterprise tools in a modern and tech-driven environment

Global impact, strong IT culture and meaningful teamwork

Impact Fund Denmark is Denmark’s development finance institution, investing in sustainable solutions that create measurable impact in developing countries. While headquartered in Copenhagen, our work extends across more than 45 countries, supported by six regional offices and unite 24 nationalities under one purpose.

You will be part of the Technology & Operations team, which is expanding to 26 professionals, including specialists in processes, architecture, data, and IT Security. Here, you will join a team of experienced and collaborative professionals who are eager to share knowledge and support each other across disciplines.

You shape our digital backbone and architectural direction

We are looking for an Solution Architect, to take the lead in designing, maintaining, and governing the company wide architecture that underpins our global impact. You ensure coherence across platforms, promote future‑ready solutions, and translate business needs into secure, scalable, and well‑governed technologies. Along the way, you will work closely with our subject matter experts, and various business stakeholders.

You will, for example:

  • Design and maintain the end‑to‑end organisation-wide architecture for our technology stack, which includes Dynamics 365 CE and F&O, Power Platform, Fabric, Copilot and related SaaS systems.

  • Co-own and enforce best practices for deployment, release management, and technical documentation

  • Define and create Architecture Principles for our entire technology stack e.g. integration principles and patterns that govern how applications and data interconnect

  • Drive a forward‑looking technology perspective, monitoring trends and identifying improvements

  • Drive technology selection to evaluate and assess new applications or technology requests to improve our internal value generation and efficiency.

You bring technical insights and architectural understanding

With your background in architectural areas like, Solution Architecture, application/system architecture, Software Architecture or transferable roles), you understand how to turn technical complexity into structured, long-term solutions.

We imagine that you:

  • Hold a relevant degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field

  • Have strong experience with solution architecture and how applications and platforms integrate

  • Understand IT governance, data protection, and compliance

  • Communicate clearly with both engineers and business stakeholders

  • Desirably have experience from the financial sector

Our current technology stack is among others based:

  • Dynamics CE

  • Dynamics F&O

  • M365

  • Microsoft Fabric

  • Microsoft Dataverse

  • and several fit for purpose SaaS solutions/applications

Ready to build the digital foundation for global impact?

As part of the recruitment process, we need your targeted CV, preferably with a brief motivational statement at the top. We will be conducting interviews on an ongoing basis, so do not wait too long to apply.

CVs not submitted via the platform will not be considered. The start date is as soon as possible, but we are ready to wait for the right candidate.

We look forward to hearing from you!

About Impact Fund Denmark

Impact Fund Denmark (IFU – the Investment Fund for Developing Countries) is a Danish impact investor contributing to green, just and inclusive societies as well as supporting the Sustainable Development Goals. Impact Fund Denmark provides risk capital to companies operating in developing countries across Africa, Asia, Latin America and parts of Europe. Investments are made on commercial terms in the form of equity, loans and guarantees. Impact Fund Denmark has co-invested in over 1,300 companies in more than 100 developing countries and emerging markets. Contracted investments total EUR 31 billion, of which Impact Fund Denmark has contributed EUR 3.4 billion. Capital under management will be growing from EUR 2.1 billion to EUR 5.0 billion over the next few years. Read more at Impact Fund Denmark.

title: Chef / Cook – Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar, Kalundborg
description:
Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar is looking for skilled and motivated Chefs / Cooks to join our established restaurant in Kalundborg, Denmark.

Our restaurant in Kalundborg is a well-run, busy operation with a proven concept, experienced ownership and a clear direction. Located right in the middle of Kalundborg's main pedestrian street, we are a lively, pulsing part of the town and a gathering place for its residents. Our purpose is to create a vibrant place for the people of Kalundborg, built on quality ingredients and good food. We are now strengthening our kitchen team and are looking for chefs who want to become part of a structured, professional kitchen and contribute to consistent, high-quality service every day.

Our concept is based on modern Danish cuisine with a Nordic twist, combined with well executed brasserie classics and a varied à la carte menu. We focus on quality ingredients, solid craftsmanship and seasonal cooking, with dishes that combine flavour, comfort and consistency. Our menu includes both classic meat dishes, such as pepper steak, pasta dishes and other popular brasserie favourites.

Alongside our à la carte service, we have a private dining and events room, which you will also be part of. It brings welcome variety to the daily kitchen work, with menus that differ from the standard à la carte and the chance to cook for parties, celebrations and special occasions.

You will be joining a business with an already proven concept, an organised kitchen and a strong operational foundation. The setup is stable and well prepared, giving you a secure framework in which to do great work and develop your craft. Here you also get the freedom to bring your own ideas to life. We are not a place where everything is dictated from above — our chefs and kitchen staff are given the room to develop dishes, contribute to the menu and put their own mark on the food.

We are a serious but friendly workplace with respectful leadership, an organised kitchen environment and a no-drama culture. We believe strong kitchens are built on structure, teamwork and professionalism.

We are looking for chefs / cooks who:
• Have experience working in a professional kitchen
• Can handle prep, mise en place and service in a structured way
• Have experience with à la carte service
• Care about quality, teamwork and consistency
• Thrive in a busy restaurant environment
• Can work independently and take responsibility during service

We offer:
• Full-time employment
• A fixed work schedule
• Weekend work is part of the position
• Salary of approximately DKK 30,000–35,000 gross per month, depending on qualifications and experience
• Five weeks of paid holiday
• Company apartment / accommodation available
• Help with relocation and settling in Denmark
• Possibility of support with moving costs and/or paid accommodation in the first month, by agreement
• Good working conditions in a structured and professional environment
• Staff meals
• Work clothing provided
• Staff discounts
• A stable, established restaurant with a proven concept and an organised kitchen
• The freedom to develop your own ideas and contribute to the menu
• A workplace where English can be used in daily communication

Location
The position is based in Kalundborg, Denmark, in the heart of the city's main pedestrian street. Kalundborg offers a local Danish atmosphere, a charming town centre and a good quality of life.

Language
English is required. Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Start date
As soon as possible / by agreement.

How to apply
Please send
• Your CV
• A short introduction about yourself
• Your earliest possible start date

For applications and questions, please contact:
Esbern Snare ApS
Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar
Phone: +45 25 14 44 00
Email: job@esbern-snare.dk

We look forward to hearing from motivated chefs who want to become part of a strong, established kitchen team in Denmark.

Please note that you must already have the right to work in Denmark, either as an EU/EEA or Swiss citizen or by holding a valid Danish work permit that allows you to take this position.

title: Strategy & Business Development Analyst
employer: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
description:
Are you motivated by turning analysis into strategic decisions and supporting products that mobilise capital for impact? 

 

The job

As an Analyst in Strategy & Business Development (S&BD) at Impact Fund Denmark, you will support strategy implementation and management-initiated projects through structured analysis, research and preparation of high-quality presentation material. In parallel, you will facilitate Impact Fund Denmark’s collaboration with our owner, the Danish Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

Key responsibilities will include:

  • Support strategy implementation initiatives through analyses, presentations and structured decision material for senior leadership. 

  • Produce insights and fact-based recommendations based on research and analysis. 

  • Facilitate good collaboration with the Danish Ministry of Foreign Affairs by producing meeting materials, and supporting development of new public investment mandates.

  • Support Impact Fund Denmark’s work on stakeholder relations by facilitating internal coordination, producing relevant insights and analysis, and engaging directly with stakeholders.

  • Run and support internal projects in Strategy and Business Development and across the organisation.

 

The team

 

You will join the Strategy & Business Development team and work closely with colleagues in across the organisation. The S&BD team supports senior leadership with strategy development, implementation of priority initiatives, corporate planning and preparation of fact-based decision material.

 

Your qualifications & experience

The ideal candidate will have demonstrated strong analytical capabilities and a structured approach to problem solving. 

  • A relevant Master’s degree with strong academic results. 

  • 1 to 2 years of full-time work experience from relevant positions (e.g. strategy, analytics, consulting, investing or corporate finance)

  • Strong analytical and problem-structuring skills, with the ability to translate analysis into clear messages and presentations. 

  • Strong PowerPoint skills and solid Excel skills. 

  • Fluency in English, written and spoken. 

  • Ability to read and write in Danish in an advantage.

  • A collaborative mindset and motivation to work across strategy, product development and investor relations. 

 

Working and learning at Impact Fund Denmark

Impact Fund Denmark’s learning culture provides the tools and organisation for individual development. Learning is an important element of working in Impact Fund Denmark, and we will support your personal development through training, sparring and by ensuring that you get exciting and challenging tasks and new opportunities for growth. When joining Impact Fund Denmark, you will take part in our extensive onboarding program to get the best possible start in your new role.

Impact Fund Denmark offers a hybrid workplace, allowing you to manage your own time effectively. We have a diverse and inclusive working environment with more than 150 talented individuals from 20+ different nationalities. We work seamlessly together with colleagues around the corner, cross the organization and between offices in Asia, Africa, LATAM and Europe.

Investments are made on commercial terms in the form of equity, loans and guarantees. Impact Fund Denmark has co-invested in over 1,300 companies in more than 100 developing countries and emerging markets. Contracted investments total EUR 31 billion, of which Impact Fund Denmark has contributed EUR 3.4 billion. Capital under management will be growing from EUR 2.1 billion to EUR 5.0 billion over the next few years. Read more at www.impactfund.dk.

title: Baker – Bakery Production – Maribo, Lolland, Denmark
description:
Dansk version længere nede

Den Gamle Bagergaard in Maribo is looking for a baker. You do not need a formal qualification if you have practical experience working in a bakery.

We are a family-run business with three bakers and a pastry chef in production. Two packing staff and a driver help get our bread ready and delivered to our shops.

Your work

You will take part in the daily production at the bakery. We are looking for someone who knows their way around a bakery, takes responsibility for their work and enjoys working with colleagues. You must be able to communicate in Danish or understandable English.

You must already have the legal right to work in Denmark, for example through EU/EEA or Swiss citizenship or a valid Danish residence and work permit. We cannot offer visa or work permit sponsorship.

What we offer

  • Gross monthly salary: Based on qualifications and experience. For a qualified baker, the salary starts at approximately DKK 26,000.

  • Permanent, full-time employment

  • Pension scheme

  • 5 weeks of vacation

  • Flexible benefits account

  • Additional pay for applicable night and Sunday work

  • The employer can support you in finding accommodation in the area

The planned working hours start at 01:30 on Mondays and 05:00 from Tuesday to Thursday. You will also work every other weekend. During the night shifts on Mondays and every other weekend, you will bake bread, Danish pastries and other baked goods. The expected start date is 1 November 2026.

Recruitment process

We review applications as they arrive, so please apply as soon as possible.

Send your application and CV to rekruttering@lolland.dk with “Baker – Maribo” in the subject line.

Lolland is in southern Denmark and offers easy access to nature, beaches and open countryside, along with affordable housing and short commuting distances. The region is developing rapidly, partly due to the Femern Belt Fixed Link between Denmark and Germany.
