- We will support you in developing yourself and your career growth opportunities: 1.000 € Educational Budget, Language Courses, Parental Support and access to the Udemy Business platform to explore a variety of online courses.
- Get moving and release those wonderful, mind-boosting endorphins: Health Checkups, Meditation & Gym.
- Cash. Dough. Cheddar. Whatever you call it, we’ll help you with it: Employee Share Purchase Plan, Sabbatical Bank, Public Transportation Ticket Discount, Life & Accident Insurance, Corporate Pension Plan
- The power of getting together over some food is unrivaled. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers and Food Vouchers.
- Wondering what relocating to Berlin is like? In this article, we’ve put together10 things you should know about moving to Berlin (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/blogmoving-to-berlin-guide?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullet+text&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and how Delivery Hero can support you. You can also visit our relocation hub (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/relocation-hub?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and check out more information about moving to Berlin.
- Ready to prepare for your interview? Check out the list of the 5 most common interview questions and answers (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/the-5-most-common-interview-questions-and-how-to-answer-them?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) created in collaboration with our recruiters.

Ready to join our team? (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/howwehire) If you’re excited to grow, collaborate and be part of the world’s leading delivery platform, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today!

title: Senior Expert Global Compensation & Benefits (m/f/d) (Personalreferent/in)
description:

Our people are our success. At Exyte, you will be part of a global community of challenge seekers who are ambitious and passionate about innovation. Discover your exciting role

The role develops scalable, market-competitive, and compliant solutions that balance global consistency with local market and regulatory requirements. Working globally, this position partners with HR, Finance, Legal, business leaders, and external advisors to strengthen global job architecture, pay structures, incentive programs, benefits governance, and annual reward processes that support attraction, retention, engagement, and internal equity.

Explore your tasks and responsibilities

- Global Reward Strategy & Program Design: Partner with the VP Compensation, Benefits & Global Mobility to develop and implement global compensation and benefits strategies, frameworks, and governance models that balance enterprise-wide consistency with local market, legal, and business requirements.
- Global Process Ownership & Execution: Lead and optimize global compensation and benefits processes, including annual salary reviews, bonus planning, pay decisions, budgeting, and benefits harmonization across multiple countries and regions.
- Global Analytics, Benchmarking & Technology: Drive global market benchmarking, reward analytics, pay equity assessments, workforce cost forecasting, and data-driven reporting to support strategic reward and workforce decisions.
- Governance, Compliance & Risk Management: Establish and maintain robust global compensation and benefits policies, governance structures, and compliance frameworks while ensuring adherence to evolving regulatory and reporting requirements.
- Global Stakeholder Advisory & Change Enablement: Serve as a trusted advisor to HR, Finance, Legal, Talent Acquisition, and business leaders, leading global change initiatives, policy transformations, and reward program implementations.
- Vendor & External Partner Management: Own the global vendor strategy for Compensation & Benefits, including provider selection, contract management, service quality oversight, and cost optimization initiatives.
- Global Scope: Operate effectively across international regions, cultures, and time zones, fostering collaboration within a global environment and supporting business needs through occasional international travel.
- Program & Project Leadership: Lead complex global reward projects, including M&A integrations, job architecture initiatives, compensation technology implementations, pay transparency programs, benefits harmonization, and organizational change activities.

Show your expertise

- Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.
- Multiple years of professional experience, including significant experience in global or multi-country compensation and benefits roles
- Deep expertise in global compensation and benefits strategy, job architecture, market benchmarking, salary structures, incentive design, and annual reward processes.
- Strong knowledge of global governance and the ability to translate enterprise principles into practical, locally compliant solutions.
- Experience working across multiple countries and regions within a complex, matrixed multinational organization.
- Advanced analytical, financial-modeling, and data-visualization capability, including expert-level Excel skills and experience with HRIS and reporting tools.
- Demonstrated ability to influence executives and align diverse global and regional stakeholders without direct authority.
- Strong project, change, and vendor-management skills, with the ability to manage concurrent global initiatives.
- Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and cross-cultural communication skills; professional fluency in English.

What we offer you

You want to be part of the Exyte team? We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Junior Controller Product Costing & Inventory Valuation (m/f/d) - Hybrid Option GER (Buchhalter/in)
description:
WELCOME TO BASF

In Global Business Services, we support BASF's divisions with a cross-functional network and offer modern solutions tailored to the needs of the business. As a specialized service unit we ensure a high level of customer orientation and we design our services to be cooperative, efficient and future-oriented.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT
Are you interested in accounting, controlling, manufacturing processes and understanding how product costs are built up? Then join our Product Costing & Inventory Valuation team. In this role, you develop expertise in Cost Accounting, Inventory Valuation and SAP S/4HANA processes while working closely with finance, controlling and operational teams worldwide.

- You analyze, validate and monitor standard and actual product costs in SAP, including the execution of product costing runs.
- Besides that, you investigate cost deviations, perform root cause analyses and collaborate with manufacturing, accounting and controlling teams to ensure accurate product cost calculations.

- bachelor's or master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics or a related field
- first experience in accounting, cost accounting, inventory accounting, manufacturing finance or controlling, gained through internships, working student positions or initial professional roles
- good understanding of accounting principles, financial closing processes, cost accounting and inventory valuation, with a strong interest in manufacturing environments
- experience with SAP ERP, SAP CO, Product Costing, Material Ledger or SAP S/4HANA is an advantage
- structured and analytical way of working, strong attention to detail, and fluent English communication skills, additional European languages are a plus

WHAT WE OFFER

- Gross annual salary (full-time): 40.000 - 46.000 €, depending on qualifications and professional experience - In addition, you can expect a bonus dependent on the company's success

title: Plant Manager - Marl (Werkleiter/in)
description:
Der Plant Manager ist für die Gesamtleitung von zwei Produktionsstandorten in Marl verantwortlich. Der Schwerpunkt der Position liegt auf Arbeitssicherheit, Produktion, operativer Effizienz sowie der Koordination der Logistik.

Die Position umfasst die Steuerung des täglichen Betriebs und stellt gleichzeitig die Einhaltung der EHS-Vorschriften, Qualitätsstandards, gesetzlichen Anforderungen und Unternehmensrichtlinien sicher. Der Site Manager führt das Standortteam und treibt die kontinuierliche Verbesserung in den Bereichen Produktion, Qualität, Kosten und operative Leistungsfähigkeit voran.

Verantwortlichkeiten:

- Sicherstellung der Einhaltung aller geltenden EHS-Gesetze und -Vorschriften sowie der internen Group-Richtlinien an den Produktionsstandorten.
- Verantwortung für Produktionsleistung, Produktqualität, Durchsatz und termingerechte Lieferungen.
- Planung und Überwachung der operativen Budgets sowie Sicherstellung einer effektiven Kostenkontrolle.
- Kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Produktionsprozesse unter Anwendung von Lean-Manufacturing-Prinzipien.
- Sicherstellung der Einhaltung aller lokalen und unternehmensinternen EHS-Anforderungen, einschließlich Gefährdungsbeurteilungen und arbeitsmedizinischer bzw. arbeitshygienischer Programme.
- Sicherstellung der Einhaltung gesetzlicher Anforderungen hinsichtlich des sicheren Betriebs und der Instandhaltung von Produktionsanlagen und Maschinen.
- Abstimmung der Produktionskapazitäten und Personalplanung mit den Anforderungen der Logistik.
- Sicherstellung der Einhaltung der Anforderungen und Ziele gemäß ISO 9001, ISO 14001 und ISO 50001.
- Verbesserung von Qualität, Ausbeute, Durchsatz, Anlagenverfügbarkeit und Kosten durch kontinuierliche Verbesserungsmaßnahmen und OPEX-Projekte.
- Identifizierung von Investitionsmöglichkeiten zur Verbesserung der Anlageneffizienz und Ausbeute.
- Sicherstellung, dass die Produktionskosten innerhalb der genehmigten Budgets bleiben.
- Erstellung regelmäßiger Betriebs- und Leistungsberichte für den zuständigen Vorgesetzten, einschließlich: - Operative Leistungskennzahlen
- Qualität der Fertigprodukte in Zusammenarbeit mit der Qualitätsabteilung
- Wesentliche Produktions- und Kostenkennzahlen
- Sicherstellung einer effektiven Instandhaltung zur Minimierung von Stillstandszeiten und Maximierung der Anlagenverfügbarkeit.
- Führung, Entwicklung, Coaching und Motivation des Standortteams.
- Bearbeitung von Leistungs- und Verhaltensangelegenheiten bei Bedarf.
- Organisation und Überwachung der vierteljährlichen und jährlichen Bestandsaufnahmen.
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Abteilungen Logistik, Qualität, Instandhaltung, EHS, Finanzen und HR.
- Nationale und internationale Reisetätigkeit nach Bedarf (ca. 5 %).

Anforderungen:

- Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Ingenieurwesen, z. B. Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Maschinenbau, Verfahrenstechnik, Bergbau oder einer verwandten Fachrichtung bzw. eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
- Fundierte praktische Erfahrung in einem produzierenden, industriellen, bergbaulichen oder vergleichbaren Produktionsumfeld.
- Gute Kenntnisse im Bereich der Betriebs- und Produktionsabläufe, einschließlich Arbeitssicherheit, Produktion, Qualität, Prozesse, Instandhaltung und Investitionsprojekte (CapEx).
- Erfahrung in der Führung von Teams sowie im operativen Management.
- Ausgeprägte Führungs-, Entscheidungs- und Problemlösungskompetenz.
- Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten in einem dynamischen und schnelllebigen Umfeld zu steuern.
- Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit.
- Ausgeprägter Fokus auf Sicherheit, Qualität, operative Exzellenz und Kundenanforderungen.
- Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

title: Hero Support Specialist (Assistent/in - Personalwesen)
description:
Company Description

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

Job Description

We are on the lookout for a Specialist, Hero Support to join the People & Culture team on our journey to always deliver amazing experiences.

- Your Role: As a Specialist in Hero Support, you will play a key role in managing HR operations, optimizing employee lifecycle workflows, and ensuring smooth service delivery across DHSE Central. You'll bring a blend of strong operational expertise and a continuous improvement mindset to keep our processes efficient, compliant, and candidate- and employee-friendly.
- Operations & Case Management: Act as a primary operational contact for employee and manager queries via Jira, Slack, and email, independently resolving mixed-complexity tickets per month while maintaining >90% SLA adherence.
- End-to-End Lifecycle Operations: Execute employee lifecycle processes including employment contracts, amendments, probation management, transfers, and terminations, supporting a wide range of teams across the organization.
- Data Integrity & Compensation Administration: Maintain accurate employee records in Workday and support pre-payroll data reconciliation, one-time payments, and compensation updates with 95% accuracy and strong attention to compliance.
- Stakeholder Collaboration & Advisory: Apply working knowledge of German labor law and company policies to partner effectively with Talent Acquisition, Payroll, Legal, and People Partners, serving as a trusted consultative advisor to managers and stakeholders across the business.
- Process Improvement & Automation: Identify operational bottlenecks and drive workflow enhancements in Workday and Jira, implementing process improvements per quarter to continuously elevate the employee experience.
- Knowledge Management: Maintain clear documentation, SOPs, and self-service Knowledge Base resources for employees and managers.
- Projects & Operational Excellence: Support cross-functional initiatives across HR compliance, process digitization, and audit readiness to enhance scalability and service quality.

Qualifications

- 1–3+ years of hands-on experience in HR Operations or People Operations, managing end-to-end employee lifecycle processes in a fast-paced environment.
- Solid understanding of German labor law, social security regulations, and general HR administrative compliance.
- Strong proficiency with modern HR systems, particularly Workday and ticketing platforms like Jira or ServiceNow.
- A customer-centric, empathetic mindset with a strong focus on high-quality service delivery.
- Strong detail orientation, problem-solving skills, and ability to prioritize in a dynamic workflow.
- Excellent communication skills in English (C1+) and strong working knowledge of German (B1+ minimum).
- Experience in global mobility operations and business travel administration is considered a strong plus.

title: Junior Key-Account-Manager - Vollzeit (m/w/d) (Key-Account-Manager/in)

Analytisch-methodisches und strukturiertes Denken, Organisationsfähigkeit, Ergebnis- und Lösungsorientierung sowie ausgeprägte Teamorientierung gepaart mit sicherem Auftreten, einer selbstständigen Arbeitsweise und einem hohen Maß an Kommunikationsfähigkeit

Die Fähigkeit, bestehenden Prozessen zu folgen und diese aktiv weiterzuentwickeln
Schnelle Auffassungsgabe und hohe Disziplin
Starke kommunikative Fähigkeiten und ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Präzision
Saubere und fehlerfreie schriftliche Ausdrucksform in Deutsch
Guter Umgang mit Leistungsdruck

title: IT Project Manager (German-speaking), Matrix42, Espoo, Kuopio, Frankfurt
description:

As an IT Project Manager at Matrix42, you will be responsible for delivery projects related to Service Management (ITSM/ESM) and Identity Management (IAM/IGA) solutions. Your work will focus particularly on the German and Finnish markets and on successfully delivering projects related to public and private sector tenders. You will collaborate closely with sales, technical consultants, and clients to ensure successful project delivery and high customer satisfaction.

You can work in a hybrid model from the Espoo (Säteri), Kuopio, or Frankfurt office, and you enjoy meeting colleagues and customers face-to-face on a regular basis. The role requires occasional travel depending on project and customer needs.

You are offered:
- The opportunity to build your career in a growing international company
- A warm, low-hierarchy, people-centric work community where colleagues support each other and laughter is part of everyday life
- An agile growth company of the right size, without unnecessary bureaucracy, but with clear processes and strong development opportunities
- A working culture where humanity and well-being come first, while drive and high motivation are visible in everyday work

Work tasks

In your role as IT Project Manager, you will be fully responsible for planning, executing, and steering customer projects related to Service and Identity Management solutions. Your tasks include close collaboration with sales, technical experts, and customers, as well as managing project resources, time entries, and budget adherence.
- Lead end-to-end planning and execution of IT implementation and development projects
- Guide and coordinate technical consultants and the project team
- Monitor project resources, budgets, and schedules to ensure targets are met
- Conduct status meetings and report progress to steering groups and other stakeholders
- Ensure customer satisfaction and proactive communication throughout all project phases

We are looking for

- Strong experience leading IT projects in direct client-facing roles, ideally on the supplier side, acting as the primary point of contact between customer and delivery teams
- Fluent German and English skills, and Finnish language skills are an advantage
- Knowledge of different project management methodologies (e.g., Agile and Waterfall)
- Willingness to travel when required by projects
- Excellent collaboration and communication skills with various stakeholders

Experience with public sector tendering processes and working with public sector customers as well as delivering SaaS-based or platform solutions are seen as an addition asset.

To succeed in this role you are:
- Proactive and eager to learn – you adopt new knowledge quickly and boldly seize development opportunities
- Curious about change – you thrive in an environment where processes evolve, new people and products are introduced, and you can adapt your approach to different situations
- Natural organizer and bridge-builder – you guide both customers and project teams toward shared goals, collaborate smoothly with stakeholders, and communicate credibly even in demanding situations
- Service-minded and solution-oriented – you sense the dynamics of customer situations, identify opportunities to add value, and take responsibility for ensuring smooth progress for both the customer and your own organization

The role will later require passing a limited security clearance.

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

title: Regulatory reporting product manager (f/m/d)
description:
Regulatory reporting product manager (f/m/d)
Location: Luxembourg, LU
Company: Deutsche Börse Group

Your area of work:

Clearstream Fund Services is seeking an experienced Product Manager to lead the development and delivery of regulatory reporting solutions within the fund industry. The role focuses on key regulations such as PRIIPs, MiFID, SFDR, and the production of factsheets. The ideal candidate will act as the bridge between business and technology, ensuring compliance, accuracy, and timely delivery of data products that meet regulatory requirements.
This position requires detailed domain knowledge of the funds industry and the associated regulatory regimes, strong ability to work autonomously, a good understanding of how managed services operate, fast-decision-making skills, a thinking-outside-the-box approach and strong stakeholder management skills.

Your responsibilities:

• Own the product lifecycle for chosen regulatory reporting solutions: from identifying opportunities, gathering requirements, and writing specifications for IT development, to deployment and operational readiness as a managed service.
• Ensure compliance and accuracy: translate regulatory obligations placed on our clients (e.g. PRIIPs, MiFID, SFDR, AIFMD) into clear product requirements and maintain alignment with evolving rules.
• Bridge between business and IT: facilitate communication between clients, sales, operations, and technical teams to ensure shared understanding of goals and value to be created by our services.
• Enable technical delivery: collaborate with analysts, architects, and developers to design and implement robust data models and reporting solutions.
• Deliver full-stack reporting products: oversee both back-end processes (data ingestion, modeling) and front-end outputs (factsheets, disclosures, dashboards).
• Drive Agile practices: manage backlog, prioritize tasks based on regulatory deadlines and business needs, and contribute to sprint planning and iterative delivery.
• Document and communicate: produce clear requirements, user stories, and presentations of released solutions, and manage proactive communication with management.
• Act autonomously: make informed decisions, manage priorities, and ensure timely delivery without constant supervision.

Your profile:

• Master's degree in Economics, Finance, Business, or a related field.
• 3-6 years of experience in the funds industry, with strong exposure to regulatory reporting regimes (e,g, PRIIPs, MiFID, SFDR, AIFMD).
• Solid understanding of regulatory frameworks and their practical implications for data and reporting.
• Strong grasp of data ecosystems, software building skills and Agile methodologies.
• Knowledge of data quality, lineage, and governance practices.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to work independently and take ownership of decisions.
• Fluent in English; French is a plus.

In case you are selected for an interview, you will be asked to present a case study that will be communicated to you in advance.

title: Pädagogische/r Mitarbeiter/in (m/w/d) im Betreuten Wohnen für junge Flüchtlinge (Sozialarbeiter/in / Sozialpädagoge/-pädagogin)
description:
INSBI gGmbH / Institut für soziale und berufliche Integration gGmbH

Wir suchen:
Sozialarbeiter/in, Sozialpädagoge/in, Diplom/BA-Pädagoge/in, Erzieher/in (m/w/d)

Zu uns:
Die INSBI bietet betreutes Wohnen für unbegleitete minderjährige Flüchtlinge (UmF) ab 16 Jahren und für junge Volljährige an. Unser Ziel ist es, diesen Menschen einen sicheren und stabilen Lebensraum zu bieten, in dem sie Vertrauen, Orientierung und Perspektiven für ihre Zukunft entwickeln können.

In Zusammenarbeit mit Jugendämtern und Bildungsträgern setzen wir uns für die gesellschaftliche und berufliche Integration junger Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen ein. Unsere Arbeit basiert auf einem ressourcenorientierten Ansatz und folgt dem Prinzip des Empowerments: Wir begleiten die Jugendlichen individuell und stärken sie in ihrer persönlichen und beruflichen Entwicklung.

Besonders für junge Flüchtlinge, die oft traumatische Erlebnisse hinter sich haben, ist eine stabile und vertrauensvolle Beziehung essenziell. Durch unser Bezugsbetreuersystem bieten wir Halt, Orientierung und fördern ihre Selbstständigkeit.

Mit unserer langjährigen Erfahrung in der Jugendhilfe und Flüchtlingshilfe gestalten wir ein Umfeld, das Sicherheit, Schutz und eine realistische Zukunftsperspektive ermöglicht. Dabei legen wir Wert auf interkulturelle Sensibilität, Reflexion und eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Akteuren, um den Jugendlichen bestmögliche Chancen zu bieten.

Darum geht's - Ihre Aufgaben
Als pädagogische/r Mitarbeiter/in in der ambulanten Betreuung im Betreuten Wohnen für minderjährige und junge volljährige Flüchtlinge übernehmen Sie unter anderem folgende Aufgaben:

- Anleitung und Unterstützung der jungen Menschen im lebenspraktischen Bereich, im Besonderen der Verselbstständigung in einer eigenen Wohnung oder WG.
- Begleitung und Unterstützung bei der Abklärung asyl- und aufenthaltsrechtlicher Fragen und der Sicherstellung des Lebensunterhalts
- Einzelförderung im schulischen, beruflichen, sozial-emotionalen und gesundheitlichen Bereich sowie Freizeitgestaltung
- Krisenintervention
- Zusammenarbeit mit Jugendämtern, Behörden, Rechtsanwältinnen, Schulen, Ausbilderinnen und Ärzt*innen
- Verwaltungstätigkeiten wie Dokumentation und Aktenführung
- Teilnahme an Teamsitzungen, Teamsupervision und Weiterbildungen.

Das bringen Sie mit - Ihr Profil

- Sie verfügen über eine Ausbildung/ein Studium zum/zur Sozialpädagoge/in oder Sozialarbeiter/in, Diplom/BA Pädagoge/in oder Erzieher/in oder sind Werksstudent/in und haben Freude an der Begleitung junger Menschen.
- Erfahrung in der pädagogischen Arbeit.
- Fähigkeit zur professionellen Beziehungsarbeit und die Bereitschaft zur kultursensiblen Arbeit.
- Kreativität, Flexibilität und Kooperationsfähigkeit.
- Freude an eigenständiger Arbeitsweise.

Unser Angebot - Ihre Vorteile

- Ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag mit einer attraktiven Vergütung, die sich an der Berufsausbildung und der beruflichen Vorerfahrung orientiert.
- Attraktives Gleitzeitangebot.
- Fortlaufende Fachberatung und Supervision sowie Weiterbildungen.
- Einarbeitung durch erfahrene Kollegen.
- Ein engagiertes Team.
- Familienfreundliches Arbeitsumfeld.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Kontaktaufnahme mit den üblichen Bewerbungsunterlagen - gerne per Mail.

description:
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir zur Unterstützung der Tätigkeit des operativen Tagesgeschäfts der Geschäftsleitung eine engagierte, fachlich versierte Unterstützung. Sie übernehmen koordinative Aufgaben, sind Ansprechpartner in betrieblichen Belangen und sorgen als unverzichtbare "rechte Hand" für die notwendige Entlastung.

Unsere Unternehmen unterhalten an diversen Standorten in Südniederachsen Hilfsangebote für Menschen, die ihren Alltagsverpflichtungen aus eigener Kraft vorübergehend nicht nachkommen können. Nahrung, Kleidung, Bildung, Ausübung einer Tätigkeit, Mobilität, Freizeitgestaltung) und vermieten Wohnraum.

Zusätzliche Kenntnisse im Bereich Personal bzw. Buchhaltung wären von Vorteil.

Der zeitliche Umfang Ihrer Stelle erfolgt nach Vereinbarung. Der Stellenumfang sollte mindestens 30 Stunden/ Woche betragen. Ihre Zeiteinteilung ist, nach Absprache und zu vereinbarenden Präsenzzeiten flexibel.

- eine vielseitige Aufgabe in einer zukunftssicheren, wachsenden Unternehmensgruppe
- ein unbefristetes Beschäftigungsverhältnis in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit
- flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle
- einen angenehmen, modernen Arbeitsplatz
- die Möglichkeit eigene Ideen einzubringen und eigenständig zu arbeiten
- flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege
- eine angemessene Entlohnung, betriebliche Altersvorsorge und Jahressonderzahlungen
- nach Absprache die Übernahme von Kindesbetreuungskosten
- innerbetriebliche Entwicklungs-, Aufstiegschancen und Fortbildungsmöglichkeiten
- im Laufe des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses Boni und Leistungsanreize durch die private Nutzung eines Dienstfahrrades, Dienstwagens, Diensthandys bzw. Dienstnotebooks
- einen kollegialen Umgang in einem netten Team.

Wir erwarten:

- Leistungsbereitschaft und -fähigkeit
- Zuverlässigkeit, Flexibilität und Belastbarkeit
- eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe und positive Grundhaltung
- sicheres Deutsch in Wort und Schrift
- einen geschulten Umgang mit Word und Excel, mit PCs und sichere Kenntnisse der Internetrecherche und dem Versand von E-Mails und Kurznachrichten
- Loyalität und Verschwiegenheit.

title: Csoportkoordinátor- Külső csomagolási projektek (Leiter/in - Logistik)
description:
Bevezetés

Részt venni a változás alakításában. Egy lépéssel megelőzni a holnap kihívásait már ma. Együtt növekedni egy fejlődő iparágban. Értékeink mentén, felelősen viselkedni. TÚLLÉPNI A HATÁROKAT. Ezt jelenti a DEUFOL csapatában dolgozni.
Világszerte 3 kontinensen, 12 ország 90 telephelyén, 2400 motivált munkatársunkkal, globális szereplők vagyunk az ellátási lánc megoldások és az ipari csomagolás területén.

Milyen feladatokra számíthatsz?

- Külső (a Deufol Hungary telephelyén kívül megvalósítandó) csomagolási és logisztikai projektek megvalósításának menedzsmentje az üzleti partnereink telephelyein (Debrecenen belül, illetve kívül, több változó helyszínen a régióban), a munkavállalók és a szakmai feladatok koordinálása
- A különféle külső helyszíneken az ipari termékek szakszerű, a megrendelésben meghatározott specifikációknak megfelelő csomagolásának, valamint a lecsomagolt termékek adminisztrációs, anyagmozgatási feladatainak biztosítása, a tevékenységek koordinálása
- Az ügyfélelégedettség biztosítása a külső csomagolási projektek során: egyeztetés a helyi kapcsolattartóval a helyszínen elvégzendő feladatokról, prioritásokról, reklamációs esetek kivizsgálása és részvétel a reakciós folyamatban.
- A külső csomagolási tevékenységekhez felhasznált csomagolóanyagok helyszínre történő kiszállítása céges autóval, szükség esetén fuvarszervezés
- A csapat tevékenységéhez kapcsolódó dokumentációs, riportolási és adminisztrációs feladatok ellátása a csoportvezető felé
- Együttműködés a cégen belüli társterületekkel, illetve a külső partnerekkel

Hozzád illik a pozíció, ha:

- Magabiztos, releváns tapasztalattal rendelkezel kisebb, néhány fős csapat vezetésében és koordinálásában gyártási, termelési, raktári, logisztikai területen
- Magabiztos számítógép-felhasználói ismeretekkel rendelkezel, gyakorlottan használod a MS Office alkalmazásokat; előny, ha valamilyen logisztikai, vállalatirányítási szoftver használatában van már tapasztalatod
- Legalább középfokú végzettséggel rendelkezel; előny a szakirányú végzettség vagy tapasztalat logisztika, ellátási lánc menedzsment, ipari csomagolási, faipari, raktári területen
- Vállalod a külső helyszíneken történő munkavégzést, a rendszeres kiküldetéseket Magyarországon belül, illetve szükség esetén (várhatóan nagyon ritka esetben) külföldre is - a munkavégzésed helyszíne részben a Deufol Hungary székhelye, részben a különböző partnereink telephelyei lesznek
- Rendelkezel B kategóriás jogosítvánnyal és vezetési tapasztalattal
- Előnyt jelent, ha rendelkezel érvényes targoncavezetői vagy híddaru kezelői jogosítvánnyal
- Terhelhető, rugalmas vagy
- Önálló, felelősségteljes munkavégzés jellemez
- Jó kommunikációs, szervező- és problémamegoldó készséggel rendelkezel
- Pozitív, csapatjátékos és ügyfélközpontú hozzáállásod van
- Alapfokú aktív angol nyelvtudás előny (mindennapi munkahelyi helyzetekben tudod használni, pl. e-mailezés, egyszerű telefonhívások/helyszíni egyeztetések)

Hogyan tudunk inspirálni?

- Stabil cég vagyunk, hosszú távon számíthatsz ránk és mi is hosszú távon gondolkodunk benned
- 180 fős munkavállalói létszámunk biztosítja a közvetlen, támogató közeget, ahol a vezetők is mindig elérhetők
- Innovatív, növekvő nemzetközi vállalati környezetben dolgozhatsz
- Érdekes és felelősségteljes feladatokat végezhetsz, csapatban közösen és a saját tudásod, kreativitásod és személyiséged használva
- Piacnak megfelelő juttatási csomagga

title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description:
**Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**

Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.

Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.

Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.

Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:

- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi

- nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia

- saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun

- vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä


Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;

- toiminta uusiin maihin

- markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille

- elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin


Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.

Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.

Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiä

Yhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.

Odotan yhteydenottoasi!

title: Senior QA Analyst
description:
As a Senior Quality Assurance Analyst on an EVE Online gameplay team, you will guide testing from early design through release and live monitoring. You will work closely with design, engineering, and production to identify risks, shape test coverage, and help the team deliver reliable, engaging gameplay.

You will develop deep knowledge of your team's gameplay systems and how they interact with the wider game. As an advocate for players, you will contribute to design discussions, challenge assumptions, and provide actionable feedback on gameplay and usability. You will also coordinate outsourced testing while improving how the team builds quality into everyday development.

Your Tasks
Own the team's test approach, maintaining test plans, cases, regression coverage, and supporting documentation with input from the team.
Perform hands-on testing of gameplay features, mechanics, and interactions with existing systems, from design through release.
Assess quality risks, estimate testing effort, and partner with the producer to ensure adequate testing time and coverage. Coordinate testing across the development team and outsourced testers, providing clear priorities, instructions, and feedback.
Drive collaboration across teams and encourage shared ownership of quality.
Manage defects through triage, investigation, prioritization, and verification, helping the team make informed release decisions.
Review player bug reports, external issue lists, and relevant forum discussions to identify issues within the team's domain.
Coordinate deployment testing and post-release verification, communicating results and outstanding risks.
Ensure coverage across PC and Mac, including appropriate platform, performance, and regression testing.
Monitor relevant code, asset, and data changes, and coordinate access to working test environments, tools, and pipelines.
Improve testing practices and identify opportunities for automation, contributing to automated tests where appropriate.

Your Profile
At least five years of software or game testing experience, including coordinating and working effectively with outsourced testers.
A thorough understanding of development processes and testing throughout the project lifecycle.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to evaluate game mechanics, controls, interfaces, player feedback, rules, and rewards.
Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to reproduce, isolate, and clearly document defects.
The ability to prioritize testing based on risk and communicate quality concerns clearly.
Excellent written and spoken English, with strong collaboration skills.
An organized, methodical, and proactive approach, combined with curiosity and creative problem-solving.

Nice to Have:
Familiarity with Scripting, Python or other programming languages.
Experience with test automation.
Experience working in Agile development teams.
Knowledge of EVE Online or experience testing complex multiplayer gameplay systems.

title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description:
**Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**

Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.

Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.

Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.

Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:

- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi

- nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia

- saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun

- vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä


Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;

- toiminta uusiin maihin

- markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille

- elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin


Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.

Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.

Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiä

Yhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.

Odotan yhteydenottoasi!

title: Prentari / Printer
description:
Prentmet Oddi leitar að ábyrgðarmiklum, nákvæmum og metnaðarfullum starfsmanni til að sinna starfi prentara.
Um er að ræða fjölbreytt og krefjandi starf í öflugu framleiðsluumhverfi þar sem gæði, þjónusta og fagmennska eru í fyrirrúmi.

Helstu verkefni:
Stýra og hafa umsjón með offsetprentvél.
Úttekt og samanburður prófarka og prentarka til að tryggja gæði framleiðslu.
Umsjón með viðhaldi véla og útfylling viðhaldsbókar.
Veita svör og ráðgjöf varðandi prentun og tæknileg atriði.
Umhirða og frágangur vinnuaðstöðu.
Önnur tilfallandi verkefni tengd starfssviðinu.

Hæfniskröfur:
Reynsla af offsetprentun eða sambærilegri framleiðslu er kostur.
Góð tæknileg þekking og hæfni til að vinna sjálfstætt.
Nákvæmni, skipulagshæfni og öguð vinnubrögð.
Jákvætt viðhorf og góð samstarfshæfni.
Áhugi á gæðum og stöðugum umbótum.

Launakjör fara eftir reynslu, þekkingu og hæfni umsækjanda.
Starfið fellur undir kjarasamning Grafíu.
Vinnutími er frá 08:00 til 16:00 virka daga, en til 15:30 á föstudögum.

Um Prentmet Odda:

Prentmet Oddi er stærsti framleiðandi landsins á kartonumbúðum, almennu prentverki og bókum. Félagið vinnur jafnframt með mörgum af öflugustu umbúðaframleiðendum Evrópu til að veita fyrirtækjum heildarlausnir á sviði umbúða. title: Senior QA Analyst
description:
As a Senior Quality Assurance Analyst on an EVE Online gameplay team, you will guide testing from early design through release and live monitoring. You will work closely with design, engineering, and production to identify risks, shape test coverage, and help the team deliver reliable, engaging gameplay.

You will develop deep knowledge of your team's gameplay systems and how they interact with the wider game. As an advocate for players, you will contribute to design discussions, challenge assumptions, and provide actionable feedback on gameplay and usability. You will also coordinate outsourced testing while improving how the team builds quality into everyday development.

Your Tasks
Own the team's test approach, maintaining test plans, cases, regression coverage, and supporting documentation with input from the team.
Perform hands-on testing of gameplay features, mechanics, and interactions with existing systems, from design through release.
Assess quality risks, estimate testing effort, and partner with the producer to ensure adequate testing time and coverage. Coordinate testing across the development team and outsourced testers, providing clear priorities, instructions, and feedback.
Drive collaboration across teams and encourage shared ownership of quality.
Manage defects through triage, investigation, prioritization, and verification, helping the team make informed release decisions.
Review player bug reports, external issue lists, and relevant forum discussions to identify issues within the team's domain.
Coordinate deployment testing and post-release verification, communicating results and outstanding risks.
Ensure coverage across PC and Mac, including appropriate platform, performance, and regression testing.
Monitor relevant code, asset, and data changes, and coordinate access to working test environments, tools, and pipelines.
Improve testing practices and identify opportunities for automation, contributing to automated tests where appropriate.

Your Profile
At least five years of software or game testing experience, including coordinating and working effectively with outsourced testers.
A thorough understanding of development processes and testing throughout the project lifecycle.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to evaluate game mechanics, controls, interfaces, player feedback, rules, and rewards.
Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to reproduce, isolate, and clearly document defects.
The ability to prioritize testing based on risk and communicate quality concerns clearly.
Excellent written and spoken English, with strong collaboration skills.
An organized, methodical, and proactive approach, combined with curiosity and creative problem-solving.

Nice to Have:
Familiarity with Scripting, Python or other programming languages.
Experience with test automation.
Experience working in Agile development teams.
Knowledge of EVE Online or experience testing complex multiplayer gameplay systems.

What We Can Offer You
The challenge of working on ambitious projects with amazingly smart and creative co-workers.
A multicultural work environment that encourages growth, creativity and innovation.
Double work station setup and flexible work environment.
An active fun division that hosts regular events.
An excellent canteen that offers a weekly breakfast and lunch menu as well as drinks and snacks.
Discretionary quarterly and annual performance sharing plan.
Annual sports grant.
A mobile phone as well as a mobile usage package.
Home internet.
A conditional monthly transportation grant.
Work environment that focuses on employee well-being.
On-site doctor, free of charge as well as other on-site services at a discounted price.
Relocation Package.

Please submit your application in English.

Please apply by filling in an online application here: https://careers.fenriscreations.com/en/postings/d315eb37-715d-4657-b29d-484420749257
Application deadline 8th of october 2026

title: tecnico della gestione post vendita
description: Per azienda cliente leader nel settore impermeabilizzazione di strutture selezioniamo: TECNICO COMMERCIALE AREA EMILIA_AMBITO CIVILE/EDILE Di cosa ti occuperai? Inserito/a nella rete commerciale e lavorando a stretto contatto con Area Manager e agenti di zona, sarai un punto di riferimento tecnico per progettisti, imprese e installatori, con un ruolo dinamico tra ufficio e cantiere. In particolare, sarai specialista nel fornire soluzioni tecnico-commerciali presso clientela B2B (studi di progettazione, imprese, installatori e distributori): - supporterai il team commerciale nella definizione della proposta tecnica e tramite sopralluoghi operativi in cantiere - gestirai incontri tecnici e formativi rivolti a progettisti e installatori per diffondere competenze applicative e qualità esecutiva - implementerai nuove relazioni sul territorio e contribuirai all'inserimento delle soluzioni nei capitolati Hai queste competenze e caratteristiche? - formazione in ambito edile/civile (Ingegneria Edile/Civile, Architettura/Geometra) - esperienza in ruoli tecnico-commerciali nel settore edile (o contesti affini) - dimestichezza con AutoCAD e Office 365 - conoscenza della lingua inglese intermedia - ottime capacità comunicative e relazionali, orientamento agli obiettivi e curiosità professionale - disponibilità a trasferte sul territorio (ruolo in mobilità nell'area Emilia Romagna) Orario di lavoro: full time, dal lunedì al venerdì (attività prevalentemente sul territorio con flessibilità operativa e possibilità di smart working). Offerta Contrattuale: Inserimento con contratto di assunzione diretta a tempo indeterminato per figure middle/senior nel ruolo, mentre con risorse entry level è previsto un apprendistato professionalizzante finalizzato all'indeterminato CCNL applicato: Industria calce, cemento e gesso La retribuzione prevista è compresa tra € 35.000 e € 36.000 lordi annui, definita in base all'inquadramento contrattuale, alle mansioni previste e alle caratteristiche della posizione. Sono inoltre previsti auto ad uso promiscuo, PC e telefono aziendale, incentivi legati ai risultati. Prevista formazione iniziale con training 1-2 settimane presso l'HQ in provincia di Treviso. Luogo di lavoro: Emilia-Romagna (ruolo in mobilità: smart working + presidio presso Clienti e cantieri nell'area) - base preferibile Bologna Se pensi di avere le competenze e l'attitudine per questo ruolo, inviaci la tua candidatura! *Grafton Engineering è una specializzazione di Gi Group Spa autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. title: collaudatore di circuiti stampati/collaudatrice di circuiti stampati
description: Sei un giovane Diplomato a cui piacerebbe lavorare in un contesto dinamico e attento alla formazione delle risorse? Questa è l'opportunità giusta per TE! Gi Pro Mechanics 4.0 è la specializzazione di Gi Group dedicata a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito meccanico, meccatronico ed elettromeccanico, in partnership con Rotolito SpA, storica azienda italiana che opera nel settore della carta stampata e leader nelle arti grafiche, cerca persone motivate a iniziare un nuovo percorso formativo-lavorativo (IFTS) progettato in collaborazione con l'Istituto Formazione Operatori Aziendali (IFOA) da inserire come ADDETTA/O MANUTENZIONE MACCHINE STAMPA Il ruolo ha lo scopo di prevenire e riparare i guasti dei macchinari tipografici o industriali. Garantisce il corretto funzionamento della linea produttiva, riducendo al minimo i tempi di fermo macchina e assicurando la qualità del prodotto stampato. Di cosa si tratta? Sarai assunto/a con un Contratto di Apprendistato di 1° Livello, che ti permetterà di acquisire competenze orientate all'innovazione tecnologica in ambito: - Tecnologie dei processi di produzione (Processi grafici, materie prime, macchine, attrezzature); - Controllo qualità del prodotto; - Certificazioni di processo; - Logistica industriale; che verranno certificate attraverso il rilascio di un titolo di studio (Certificato di Specializzazione Tecnica Superiore) subito spendibile nel mercato del lavoro italiano ed europeo. Quali sono i vantaggi di questo percorso? Formazione teorica e pratica fornita da esperti del settore; Opportunità di apprendere e lavorare in un ambiente stimolante e innovativo; Possibilità di assunzione stabile presso l'azienda al completamento del percorso formativo previa valutazione positiva del percorso; La ricerca è rivolta a Candidati/e di età compresa tra 18-24 anni, in possesso di Diploma di Istruzione Secondaria Superiore Superiore o del quarto anno di IeFP di tipo Tecnico. Si offre inserimento con contratto di Apprendistato di 1° Livello in somministrazione di circa 9 mesi, in partenza a novembre, finalizzato ad una stabilizzazione a lungo termine. CCNL applicato: Grafica Industria Livello di inquadramento: D1 (€1.703, 76 lordi mensili) Retribuzione: Formazione Esterna (300 ore): Non Retribuita Formazione Interna (500 ore): 50% rispetto al Livello di inserimento previsto (€ 4,91 lordi orari) Ore Lavoro (Ca. 200 ore): 70% rispetto al Livello di inserimento previsto (€ 6,88 lordi orari) Luogo di lavoro: Cernusco sul Naviglio (MI) Se sei interessato/a a partecipare a questo percorso presenta la tua candidatura e, in presenza dei requisiti richiesti, sarai ricontattato da un nostro consulente. Cosa aspetti? Non perdere l'opportunità di partecipare al percorso e iniziare a fare la differenza nel settore della grafica! title: consulente di ricerca e selezione del personale
description: Gi Group SpA, prima Agenzia per il Lavoro Italiana ricerca per la propria divisione Gi EDU: FORMATORE / FORMATRICE SENIOR IL RUOLO Il/la professionista si occuperà della formazione dedicata ai DOCENTI di un istituto superiore di secondo grado, avrà la responsabilità di progettare e realizzare il percorso formativo, traducendo gli obiettivi didattici in contenuti, strumenti e attività immediatamente spendibili nella pratica scolastica. Svolgerà le seguenti attività: - Progettazione del percorso formativo in coerenza con gli obiettivi e i bisogni della scuola; - predisposizione dei materiali didattici e delle esercitazioni; - erogazione della formazione in presenza e/o da remoto, secondo il cronoprogramma concordato; - gestione di attività laboratoriali, casi e momenti di confronto con i docenti; - collaborazione al monitoraggio in itinere dell'andamento e degli esiti della formazione. Cerchiamo un/una professionista capace di coniugare competenza specialistica, concretezza e capacità di coinvolgere i docenti, trasformando la formazione in strumenti realmente applicabili in classe. REQUISITI RICHIESTI: - percorso di studi coerente con le tematiche della formazione; preferibile Laurea in Psicologia, Pedagogia o Sociologia; - conoscenza approfondita di BES, DSA e didattica inclusiva; - esperienza nella formazione di gruppi di adulti; costituisce titolo preferenziale l'esperienza nel mondo della scuola e nella formazione del personale docente; - capacità di progettare materiali, esercitazioni e strumenti operativi per i docenti; - ottime capacità relazionali, comunicative ed empatiche, organizzazione e attitudine al lavoro in team. CONDIZIONI DELLA COLLABORAZIONE Tipologia contrattuale: collaborazione con PARTITA IVA Compenso: 40,00 € all'ora, IVA inclusa Orario: nella fascia oraria pomeridiana, orario da definire in accordo con la disponibilità della risorsa e le esigenze della scuola. Il progetto sarà erogato in 60 ore circa da pianificare in due macro moduli. SEDE Luogo di lavoro: Anagni (FR). title: segretario/segretaria
description: On behalf of the Italian Entrepreneurial Holding of a growing international Group, we are looking for a Consolidation & Reporting Manager. Reporting directly to the Corporate Finance Manager, this is a stand-alone role. The successful candidate will actively contribute to building Group accounting processes and must possess comprehensive knowledge of IFRS principles. Key Responsibilities Preparation of monthly and annual consolidated financial statements, including adjusting and consolidation entries. Reconciliation of intercompany accounts and elimination entries, including the investigation and resolution of reconciliation variances. Translation of foreign subsidiaries' financial statements and management of foreign exchange differences. Management of changes in the consolidation scope, including acquisitions, mergers, takeovers, and corporate reorganizations. Support in accounting for Purchase Price Allocation (PPA), goodwill, and consolidation differences, where applicable. Preparation of reporting packages and accounting instructions for Group companies. Analysis of data submitted by subsidiaries, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and consistency, and managing detailed follow-up requests. Support in preparing the consolidated Notes to the Financial Statements and documentation for auditors and corporate governance bodies. Liaison with the Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team to ensure consistency between management reporting and consolidated financial data. Liaison with the administrative teams of foreign subsidiaries, providing support for accounting and administrative activities. Requirements Degree in Economics, Accounting, Finance, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in Group Consolidation, Financial Reporting, External Audit, or Corporate Accounting. Previous experience within multinational listed companies or top-tier audit and advisory firms. Strong knowledge of IAS/IFRS Proven ability to manage complex reporting activities under tight deadlines Fluent English, both written and spoken, used regularly in a professional environment. Knowledge of USGAAP and experience with Oracle are a plus Offer Permanent employment Contract RAL between €50,000 and €60,000 1 day of remote working per week #LI-AM2

Per conto di una realtà investigativa strutturata e specializzata nel contrasto alle frodi civili e penali a tutela delle compagnie assicurative, ricerchiamo una figura esperta da inserire nella Divisione Antifrode Assicurativa. Costituiscono titolo preferenziale formazione in ambito giuridico, economico o criminologico; esperienza nel settore delle indagini antifrode, compliance, audit o investigazioni; conoscenza della normativa e delle principali dinamiche relative alle frodi assicurative; esperienza nella gestione e redazione di documentazione investigativa. title: Fahrer (m/w/divers) für Showtruck gesucht (Berufskraftfahrer/in)
description:
.....gesucht wird ein "bewirtender" Berufskraftfahrer oder "kundenorientierter" Gastronom mit Lkw-Führerschein.....

Wir suchen einen zuverlässigen und erfahrenen Lkw-Fahrer mit Führerschein C/CE für unseren Showtruck, der sich um die sichere und effiziente Beförderung unserer Gastronomie-Einrichtung kümmert und nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs ist, insbesondere in Italien und Frankreich.

Als Lkw-Fahrer werden Sie für die Bedienung und Wartung des Fahrzeugs verantwortlich sein und sicherstellen, dass alle Aufgaben im Zusammenhang mit dem Auf- und Abbau der Gastronomie-Einrichtung reibungslos durchgeführt werden. Zu Ihren Hauptaufgaben gehören die Fahrt zu den Veranstaltungsorten, der Auf- und Abbau der Einrichtung, der Ausschank und die Betreuung der Gäste. Wir suchen einen Kandidaten mit ausgeprägten Fahrkenntnissen, excellenten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und einer tiefen Erfahrung im Umgang mit Lkw und Gastronomie-Einrichtungen.

Die Stelle erfordert eine hohe Flexibilität und die Bereitschaft, nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs zu sein. Wenn Sie eine Herausforderung suchen und sich für eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit begeistern, dann sind Sie bei uns richtig.

Zum Aufgabengebiet gehören voraussichtlich aber nicht ausschließlich:

- Mitreisetätigkeit an 6-10 Monaten am Stück im Jahr, ausdehnbar auf 12 Monate im Jahr, wenn erste Teilsaison stimmt
- Erfahrung im Betrieb/Mitreisen bei Schaustellerbetrieben, Eventbereich
- leichter Auf- und Abbau von Gerätschaften während der Tour
- Eventunterstützung von Organisation vor Ort
- Terminplanung Tour
- Ausschankbetrieb
- Führerschein Klasse CE

Persönliche Voraussetzungen:

- Unabhängigkeit
- Altersvorgabe 30-58
- technisches Verständnis Light&Sound und LKW-Technik
- englisch fließend, jede weitere Fremdsprache ist willkommen
- Persönlichkeit: präsent, kommunikativ, selbstbewusst

Interesse? Bitte teilen Sie uns mit, wenn Sie weitere Fragen haben oder wenn Sie sich für diese Stelle interessieren.

Ergänzende Informationen:
Anforderungen an den Bewerber:
Grundkenntnisse: Gästebetreuung, Fahrzeugführung, Getränke zubereiten und anrichten, Technisches Verständnis

Il ruolo ha una forte componente tecnico-operativa e prevede la responsabilità diretta sull'esecuzione dei controlli di sicurezza, sul monitoraggio degli eventi e sul supporto alle attività di incident management, in ambienti sia on-premise sia cloud. description: Project Manager - Cantieri navali Nuove Costruzioni L'Azienda Il nostro cliente è uno storico cantiere navale genovese con un consolidato know how nella riparazione e costruzione navale. Il ruolo Nell'ambito dello sviluppo del business delle nuove costruzioni, siamo alla ricerca di un Project Manager che segua la realizzazione delle commesse dalla fase di avvio fino alla consegna finale, garantendo il raggiungimento degli obiettivi contrattuali, tecnici, economici, temporali e qualitativi. Opererà come principale punto di riferimento verso Direzione, Cliente e funzioni interne, coordinando in modo strategico e gestionale tutte le attività necessarie alla corretta esecuzione del progetto. Principali responsabilità Gestire l'intero ciclo di vita della commessa di nuova costruzione, dall'avvio alla consegna finale dell'unità. Pianificare e monitorare il programma generale di commessa, assicurando milestone e scadenze contrattuali. Coordinare funzioni interne e stakeholder (Ufficio Tecnico, Produzione, Procurement, Qualità, HSE, AFC/Controllo di Gestione). Gestire la parte economica della commessa: predisposizione e monitoraggio di budget/forecast, controllo costi, cash flow, analisi scostamenti e azioni correttive a tutela della marginalità. Selezionare e gestire fornitori/subappaltatori/partner: valutazione offerte, controllo prestazioni e gestione criticità/ritardi. Gestire la relazione con Cliente/Armatore/Classifica/Autorità: governance, riunioni di avanzamento, comunicazioni e reporting. Governare aspetti contrattuali e tecnici (varianti, change order, extra work, claim) e assicurare commissioning/HAT/prove in mare, chiusura punch list, non conformità e documentazione finale. Il Profilo Ideale Formazione: Laurea in Ingegneria Navale (valutabili Ingegneria Meccanica/Industriale o titoli equivalenti con consolidata esperienza nel settore). Esperienza: - Consolidata esperienza (almeno 8-10 anni) nel ruolo di Project Manager nel settore navale con un focus sulla costruzione navale o in società del settore marittimo. - Preferibile esperienza presso primari cantieri navali internazionali. - Esperienza su commesse di elevato valore economico e complessità tecnica. Competenze tecniche/gestionali: - Conoscenza dei processi e delle fasi di costruzione navale. - Buona conoscenza di strutture navali, impianti di bordo e discipline tecniche. - Capacità di lettura e interpretazione di specifiche tecniche, contratti, disegni costruttivi e documentazione di commessa. Lingue - Ottimo inglese scritto e parlato (seconda lingua preferenziale). Competenze personali - Leadership su team multidisciplinari e forte orientamento al risultato. - Decision making in contesti complessi, pianificazione e gestione priorità. - Flessibilità e disponibilità a trasferte. Cosa offriamo - Inserimento in un contesto industriale dinamico, in sviluppo nel business Nuove Costruzioni Navali. - Ruolo con responsabilità diretta su commesse complesse e strategiche. - CCNL applicabile: CCNL metalmeccanico-industria - Livello di inquadramento: B3/Q - Fascia di RAL da attribuire alla posizione: 60.000€ - 75.000€ - Benefit: mensa, polizza sanitaria e welfare da CCNL. description: Hai esperienza come tecnico elettrico? Cerchi una nuova opportunità lavorativa in cui mettere in pratica le tue competenze tecniche? Cattaneo SPA, azienda che opera dal 1936 a Milano nel campo dei veicoli subacquei e dei sistemi subacquei speciali per la Marina Militare. Progetta, realizza e mantiene in efficienza i prodotti durante l'intero ciclo di vita, gestendone anche l'integrazione con nuovi sistemi per il continuo ammodernamento. Monitorare e gestire le riparazioni con 'pagamento anticipato', assicurando la preparazione per la spedizione una volta ricevuto il pagamento. OGP), strumenti da banco; Buona conoscenza software (Pacchetto Office); Esperienza di 3-5 anni in mansioni analoghe (preferenziale); Precisione e attenzione ai dettagli; Gestione delle non conformità (capacità di identificare e segnalare correttamente le anomalie); Capacità organizzativa e gestione delle priorità; Propensione alla risoluzione dei problemi. title: Database and network professionals
description: Per conto di una realtà tecnologica di grandi dimensioni, operante in un contesto internazionale, siamo alla ricerca di un/una Senior Cyber Security Engineer da inserire all'interno di un team Cyber Security strutturato. La risorsa entrerà a far parte di una funzione tecnica che opera trasversalmente a supporto delle diverse aree IT, Software e Business del Gruppo, contribuendo alla progettazione, evoluzione e miglioramento dei servizi e dei controlli di Cyber Security. Cerchiamo un professionista con una buona seniority tecnica e una visione trasversale della sicurezza, capace di andare oltre la gestione operativa degli incidenti e contribuire all'evoluzione dell'ecosistema Cyber aziendale. Principali responsabilità La persona sarà coinvolta in attività quali: supporto a nuovi progetti IT e Software secondo principi di Security by Design, attraverso security review e definizione dei requisiti di sicurezza; definizione ed evoluzione dei controlli di Cloud Security, principalmente in ambienti Microsoft Azure e AWS; presidio delle tematiche di Identity Security, con particolare riferimento a Microsoft Entra ID e Active Directory; valutazione e scouting di nuove tecnologie e servizi messi a disposizione dai principali cloud e security provider; evoluzione dei servizi di Cyber Security Monitoring, collaborando con il SOC esterno e contribuendo al tuning delle piattaforme SIEM e dei relativi controlli di detection; attività di Vulnerability Management su componenti infrastrutturali e applicative; evoluzione dei presidi di sicurezza relativi a Firewall, WAF, endpoint, infrastrutture e ambienti Cloud; supporto ad attività di Incident Response e miglioramento continuo dei relativi processi e controlli; partecipazione alla definizione di iniziative di Purple Teaming, finalizzate all'identificazione delle aree di miglioramento della postura difensiva; confronto con Software Architect, Service Manager, team IT e Business per integrare i requisiti Cyber all'interno di nuovi servizi e applicazioni; supporto, quando necessario, nel confronto con clienti enterprise sui presidi di sicurezza adottati nei servizi erogati. Profilo ricercato Cerchiamo un professionista con esperienza in ambito Cyber Security Engineering, Cloud Security, Infrastructure Security o Security Architecture, maturata in contesti aziendali strutturati o all'interno di società di consulenza tecnologica. Non è necessario aver maturato esperienza approfondita in tutte le aree indicate. Sarà particolarmente interessante una solida competenza in una o più delle seguenti: Cloud Security in ambienti Azure e/o AWS; Identity & Access Security, Entra ID / Active Directory; Security Engineering e definizione di security controls; Cyber Security Monitoring e tecnologie SIEM/XDR; Vulnerability Management; Infrastructure & Network Security; Application Security / Security by Design. Saranno considerate un plus esperienze in ambito Microsoft Security, Microsoft 365 Security, Incident Response, Purple Teaming e attività di security assessment. È richiesta una buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Offerta RAL indicativa: €50.000 - €60.000 + MBO, valutabile in funzione dell'esperienza; inserimento diretto a tempo indeterminato; modalità di lavoro ibrida con 2 giorni alla settimana in presenza a Bologna; #LI-AM2

title: consulente di ricerca e selezione del personale
description: Grafton Office è la specializzazione di Gi Group dedicata a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito Accounting, Sales, Marketing, HR, Legal, Purchasing and Office Management. Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati, lavoriamo per accompagnare i nostri candidati verso le mansioni ed i contesti aziendali più coerenti con le loro competenze e le loro aspettative. Per azienda produttiva del settore moda manifatturiero di Ferrara (FE) selezioniamo una figura di: RESPONSABILE AMMINISTRAZIONE DEL PERSONALE & PAYROLL Verrai inserito/a all'interno del dipartimento di Risorse Umane & Servizi Generali dell'azienda e coordinerai le attività di 1 HR Administration Specialist. Di cosa ti occuperai nello specifico? Gestire l'amministrazione HR, garantire l'integrità dei dati e la corretta tenuta dei fascicoli del personale, assicurando la piena conformità alle comunicazioni obbligatorie, alla gestione degli infortuni e ai requisiti di legge. Supervisionare il processo payroll in coordinamento con il provider esterno, garantendo puntualità, accuratezza, conformità normativa e una gestione efficace delle richieste dei dipendenti. Gestire presenze e assenze tramite il sistema Zucchetti, assicurando un tracciamento preciso delle ore lavorate e il rispetto delle policy aziendali. Preparare statistiche analitiche e reportistica interna e di Gruppo (headcount, report mensili/annuali, assenteismo, gestione ferie, straordinari), fornendo insight data-driven a supporto delle decisioni HR. Supervisionare i contratti di lavoro in conformità alle normative vigenti, mantenendosi aggiornati sulle evoluzioni legislative e implementando le necessarie revisioni di policy e procedure. Supportare la definizione, il monitoraggio e la revisione del budget annuale del personale in linea con le linee guida aziendali e di Gruppo, oltre all'analisi continuativa dei costi HR. Contribuire ai processi annuali di salary review e di compensazione variabile, sulla base delle valutazioni di performance e delle linee guida stabilite. Promuovere e implementare soluzioni innovative di HRIS per migliorare l'efficienza operativa dei processi HR strategici. Hai queste competenze tecniche? Laurea in Economia, Consulenza del Lavoro o similari. Esperienza di almeno 7 anni in funzione di HR Administration, con focus specifico su payroll e gestione del budget. Ottima conoscenza di tematiche di Payroll, Compensation & Benefits, legislazione del lavoro e gestione amministrativa correlata. Ottima padronanza di Microsoft Excel e esperienza con sistemi HRIS (la conoscenza di Zucchetti e SuccessFactors è considerata un plus). description: Il nostro cliente è uno dei principali System Integrator italiani specializzati in Networking, Data Center, Security e soluzioni Cloud, con una forte componente di progettazione infrastrutturale e una lunga storia nel mondo delle telecomunicazioni. Requisiti - Esperienza di almeno 8-10 anni in attività specifiche nel ruolo di cui al profilo richiesto - Esperienza nella definizione di soluzioni complesse. - Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. - Disponibilità a trasferte. title: COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2) (Kapitän/in)
description:
The MV Louise Michel is a former French Navy boat we’ve customized to perform search and rescue. Measuring 30 meters in length and capable of up to 28 knots, she was bought with proceeds from the sale of Banksy artwork - who then decorated her with a fire extinguisher. She is operated and crewed by a team of international activist rescue professionals.

title: PĒTNIEKS
description:
Latvijas Unoversitātes "Cietvielu fizikas institūta" reģ.nr. 90002124925, ZI Nr. 381016 (turpmāk LU CFI) Plāno kārtiņu laboratorija PostDoc Latvia projekta ietvaros aicina pievienoties komandai Pētnieku. Projektā “Nākamās paaudzes ultraplatzonas pusvadītāju plānu kārtiņu uzklāšana un diožu izgatavošana optoelektronikas un enerģijas ierīcēm” tiek kombinētas materiālzinātnes, pusvadītāju fizikas un elektronikas jomas, lai izstrādātu jaunas paaudzes diodes no inovatīviem pusvadītāju materiāliem. Projekta uzdevumi ir izstrādāt jaunu ultraplatzonas pusvadītāju materiālu sintēzes metodes, prototipēt ierīces ar mikroizgatavošanas metodēm, un veikt to elektrisko raksturošanu. Īpaša uzmanība tiks pievērsta jaunā pētnieka zināšanu un prasmju pilnveidošanai caur apmācībām, dalībām vasaras skolās un konferencēm.

Galvenie darba pienākumi:

1.      Veikt pētniecību un eksperimentus materiālzinātnes un pusvadītāju fizikas jomā, īpaši koncentrējoties uz ultraplatzonas pusvadītāju plānām kārtiņām.

2.      Izstrādāt inovatīvu ultraplatzonas materiālu plānu kārtiņu uzklāšanas procesus, izmantojot impulsu lāzera izputināšanu (PLD).

3.   Veikt plānu kārtiņu struktūras, sastāva, morfoloģijas, optisku un elektrisku raksturošanu (XRD, elipsometrija, XPS, SEM, Ramana spektroskopija, I-V, C-V, u.c.).

title: Mystery Shopper in Latvia
description:
Mystery Shopper in Latvia

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest,
reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

title: Mystery Shopper in Lithuania
description:
Mystery Shopper in Lithuania

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR
A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest, reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes
