title: Distriktssköterska/sjuksköterska till Primärvården
description:
Vårdcentralen Trosa

Om oss
Hos oss erbjuds du ett omväxlande, utmanande och roligt arbete med stora möjligheter att utvecklas som distriktssköterska/sjuksköterska och du erbjuds också stora möjligheter att vara med och utveckla och bidra aktivt i vårdcentralens ständiga förbättringsarbete för patientens bästa. Du blir del av ett glatt arbetslag och nu har vi en vakant tjänst på vårdcentralen att bemanna. Antalet listade är totalt ca 14 300 personer på vårdcentralen. Vi ger och tar när det gäller flexibilitet i uppdraget, i arbetsplanering och gällande ledigheter.

Dina arbetsuppgifter
Som medarbetare hos oss möter du bredden inom primärvården i form av olika åldrar och olika besöksorsaker. Telefonrådgivning, digital chatt och mottagningsbesök fyller dagarna. Ibland sker enstaka hembesök. Primärvårdsjour i Nyköping något enstaka pass under ett år. Samverkan med slutenvården, kommunens personal och patienters anhöriga är viktigt för att få en smidig resa i vården för patienter.
Hos oss blir du bl.a. en viktig lagspelare i ett litet tvärprofessionellt team för en personcentrerad, tillgänglig och nära vård. Du handleder studenter och ny personal.

Vi söker dig som
Vi söker dig som är legitimerad distriktssköterska, alternativt legitimerad sjuksköterska, gärna med tidigare erfarenhet av arbete på vårdcentral samt erfarenhet av målgruppen med KOL och arbete med spirometri. Goda språkkunskaper i svenska samt har goda IT-kunskaper. Vi dokumenterar i Cosmic.
Vi lägger stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper och ser därför att du som person uppskattar och tar ansvar för gott samarbete och har ett prestigelöst förhållningsätt. Du är flexibel, pålitlig och ansvarfull och har förmågan att jobba lösningsfokuserat även i ansträngda situationer. Du bör liksom vi, alltid vara mån om att ge våra besökare, medarbetare och samarbetspartners ett gott och professionellt bemötande. B- körkort.

Anställningsform
Vi erbjuder dig en tillsvidareanställning. Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.

Information om tjänsten lämnas av
Verksamhetschef Vårdcentralen Trosa Susanne Rehn Svensson 070-389 66 27.
Fackliga företrädare söks via kontaktcenter, 0155-24 50 00.


Välkommen med din ansökan, inklusive CV, senast 2026-10-22.
Intervjuer kan komma att ske löpande.


Se våra förmåner (http://regionsormland.se/jobb-och-utbildning/vara-formaner/)

Följ oss gärna på Facebook (http://facebook.com/regionsormlandJobbahososs/) och Instagram (http://www.instagram.com/region_sormland_jobbahososs/)

Vi har i vissa fall skyldighet att kontrollera om en person förekommer i misstanke- och eller belastningsregistret. Det kan ske på två sätt, endera begär regionen ut uppgiften själv eller också uppmanas du att begära ut utdrag för att kunna visa upp innan anställning. Vi begär i undantagsfall att du visar upp registerutdrag även vid tillsättning av andra tjänster än de som avses ovan. Blir du aktuell för anställning kommer du att informeras om vad som gäller för den tjänst du sökt.
  
Du som har skyddade personuppgifter bör vara aktsam med vilken information som du delar i din ansökan. Ta kontakt med den kontaktperson som finns angiven i annonsen innan du skickar in din ansökan.

title: Elektriker entreprenad - Eslöv
description:
Är du en elektriker som trivs att arbeta på entreprenadprojekt? Vi söker nu en elektriker för ny- och ombyggnationer - både små och stora projekt. Hos oss blir du en del av ett team där tekniskt kunnande, ritningsläsning och effektivitet värderas högt.

Om tjänsten

Som entreprenad-elektriker hos oss arbetar du med elinstallationer i allt från större nyproduktioner till komplexa ombyggnationer. Rollen kräver att du kan arbeta strukturerat och ta ansvar för din del av installationen i nära samarbete med kollegor och andra yrkesgrupper.

Som person är du noggrann, punktlig och förstår vikten av att leverera kvalitet i varje moment.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter kan bland annat vara:

    Installation av kraft, belysning och tele/data i entreprenadprojekt.
    Driftsättning av anläggningar och montage enligt tekniska handlingar.
    Tolkning och arbete utifrån elritningar och kretsscheman.
    Renovering och modernisering av befintliga elsystem.

Arbetet är på heltid, dagtid med tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Tjänsten inleds via Boost Technical Power med goda möjligheter till direktanställning hos kunden efter perioden med oss.

Krav:

    ECY-certifikat
    Dokumenterad erfarenhet av entreprenad eller liknande installationsarbete
    God vana av ritningsläsning
    Goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift

Meriterande:

    Liftkort
    Safe Construction
    SSG
    B-körkort
    

Vill du börja jobba hos oss?

Du ansöker till oss genom att skicka in ditt CV till jobb@btp.se där du också kort berättar om varför just du passar för tjänsten.

Ange referens: Entreprenad - Eslöv

Vi arbetar med löpande urval, så tveka inte – skicka in din ansökan redan idag.

Som en del av rekryteringsprocessen kan bakgrundskontroll komma att genomföras på slutkandidat.

Vem är vi och vad erbjuder vi?

Boost startade 2009 och har sedan dess byggt upp en gedigen erfarenhet och kunskap inom el- och installationsbranschen.

Hos oss är du som elektriker/tekniker i fokus. Utifrån dina erfarenheter och önskemål hjälper vi dig att hitta nästa jobb– med långsiktighet och utveckling som mål.

Som anställd hos Boost får du schyssta villkor, attraktiva förmåner och vidareutbildning. Vi är anslutna till Elektrikerförbundets kollektivavtal, vilket ger dig trygghet och ordnade villkor.

Vill du veta mer om oss eller se vilka möjligheter som finns?

Besök www.btp.se eller kontakta oss så berättar vi mer.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

title: Product Manager AnoxKaldnes MBBR
description:
Veolia – Driving Ecological Transformation

Veolia is a global leader in environmental services, operating on all five continents with nearly 218,000 employees. The company specialises in water, energy and waste management, and develops and implements innovative solutions for decarbonisation, pollution remediation and resource recovery – supporting communities and industries in their ecological transformation.

Within Water Tech, a dedicated team of experienced professionals works to address the world's most complex challenges related to water scarcity, water quality, productivity and energy. Together, we strive towards a shared goal: to create a more sustainable future.

At Veolia, diverse perspectives are encouraged and valued. Joining us means you will be part of a network that makes a real difference – for society and for the environment.

About the role

Are you passionate about driving growth and innovation in wastewater treatment technology? We're seeking an experienced Product Manager to drive accretive profitable growth of the AnoxKaldnes MBBR technology portfolio, including MBBR, Hybas, AnitaMox, eXeno, and Cella.

In this dynamic role, you'll sit at the intersection of technology, market intelligence, supply chain, and commercial strategy, working closely with the Aerobic Wastewater Technologies Leader to define and execute the technology strategy.

Strategy & Innovation

    Curate and maintain the technology roadmap for the AnoxKaldnes MBBR portfolio
    Define and drive the innovation roadmap by identifying gaps and opportunities through market intelligence, customer feedback, and competitive analysis
    Monitor and analyze market trends, regulatory developments, and competitive dynamics to anticipate future technology needs
    Work closely with the Aerobic Wastewater Technologies Leader to define technology and business strategy

Commercialization & Go-to-Market

    Lead the commercialization of new technologies and offers, from core offering definition through launch and adoption tracking
    Develop and execute go-to-market strategies and launch plans
    Develop compelling marketing messaging and positioning for the technology portfolio; collaborate with marketing and communications functions to produce impactful marketing content and campaigns
    Champion new technology introductions and represent the portfolio at industry conferences, customer events, and technical forums

Cross-Functional Collaboration

    Work transversally across the organization—engaging with sales, engineering, R&D, marketing, communications, regional teams, and other business lines (EPP, MWIS)
    Collaborate with regions to understand local market needs and ensure global relevance with local applicability
    Establish and maintain relationships with key external stakeholders including customers, industry partners, research institutions, and technology collaborators
    Enable the commercial organization through training, technical content, and thought leadership

Business Operations

    Support the development of technology training and educational programs for internal teams and external clients
    Contribute to business planning processes, including annual strategic planning and investment prioritization
    Provide timely reporting and strategic recommendations to senior management
    Maintain accurate documentation of technology roadmaps, innovation pipelines, and commercialization plans

Education

    Minimum Master's degree in Chemical Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Chemistry, or equivalent professional experience
    MBA or business-related qualification is an asset

Professional Experience

    Minimum 5 years of relevant industry experience in water/wastewater treatment, including familiarity with biological treatment technologies (MBR, MBBR, MABR, BAF, or equivalent)
    Demonstrated experience in technology management, product management, or innovation management roles
    Experience developing and executing technology or product roadmaps
    Experience with commercialization of new technologies or products, including go-to-market strategy development
    Experience working in a matrix or transversal organizational structure
    Experience engaging with regional or global teams across multiple markets
    Experience with marketing strategy and technical communication

Language Skills

    Written and oral English proficiency required
    Other languages encouraged

Key Competencies

    Strong strategic thinking and analytical skills with the ability to translate market insights into actionable plans

    Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to engage and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization

    Ability to communicate clearly and concisely on complex technical matters to both technical and non-technical audiences

    Strong customer orientation and market awareness

    Self-driven, organized, and capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously

Other Requirements

    Valid driving license (Category B)

Why join us?

Be part of a forward-thinking team focused on ecological transformation. Work with global experts in water treatment and contribute to environmental sustainability. If you join us you join a company that values knowledge sharing and personal development but most importantly you join a company where we pride ourselves on our friendly, open and collaborative atmosphere.

We can offer you freedom in return for responsibility. We are convinced that the right person for this job will have an exciting future!

Location: Based in Lund, Sweden .

Position: Full-time, Permanent

title: Electrical Operations Manager
description:
What you’ll do

Right now, we are looking for a Electrical Operations Manager for our Energy & Power Distribution team. In this role you will report to our Head of Energy & Power Distribution and sit within our Mill Services function.

Specific to this role, the day-to-day tasks will include the following but as we are a growing company with very little silos between teams, other tasks might be included as well.

    Lead and support a team of electricians, providing daily guidance, coaching, and ensuring proper training and qualifications.
    Act as the authorized supervisor of electrical installations, ensuring compliance with electrical safety legislation and internal standards.
    Oversee operations, maintenance, and inspections to guarantee safe, reliable, and continuous power supply for production.
    Drive improvements in efficiency, reliability, and maintenance processes through failure analysis, corrective actions, and cost optimization.
    Manage external service providers and stakeholders, ensuring accurate documentation, regulatory compliance, and up-to-date technical records.

What you’ll bring

Specific to this role, we would like to see that you can tick off a fair amount of the boxes below:

    Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Power Engineering or a related field.
    Valid Auktorisation A (Swedish High Voltage Authorization), or eligibility to obtain it.
    3+ years of relevant experience in a comparable role.
    Deep expertise in electrical distribution systems across low, medium, and high voltage networks.
    Strong background in electrical operations management with thorough knowledge of Swedish Electrical Safety Legislation (Elsäkerhetsverket) and EU directives.
    Proven ability to manage contractors and oversee on-site electrical safety responsibilities.
    Experience with SCADA systems, including protection, control, and measurement within electrical networks.
    Very good knowledge of English. Knowledge of Swedish is an advantage.

title: Group AP/AR Administrator
description:
We are looking for a Group AP/AR Administrator to Akind, an international group with high ambitions and a clear goal of being the best place to grow, for both people and business. Come join us!

About the role

Akind is a family of brands (Academic Work, Brights, Winona, Crowd Collective) located in six European countries. We are now looking for a Group AP/AR Administrator to join our international finance team based in Linköping.  

As part of the Group AP/AR team, you will have a primary focus on Accounts Payable (AP). You will take responsibility for the day-to-day AP process while also getting the opportunity to learn and gradually take on other processes within the team.

The team consists of six colleagues with diverse experiences, and together we manage three core processes: Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), and Credit. We handle the financial flows for approximately 35 companies across six countries. While you will have a clear area of responsibility (AP), we believe in sharing knowledge across the team and building an understanding of the full financial flow. Over time, you will therefore have the opportunity to learn more of the team's processes and broaden your expertise.

Work tasks

Your main responsibilities within Accounts Payable will include:

    Manage the AP process from invoice arrival to payment and post-control.
    Register and maintain supplier information and set up new suppliers.
    Handle supplier reminders and discrepancies.
    Communicate with suppliers and internal stakeholders to resolve questions and issues.
    Ensure accurate and timely processing of invoices and payments.
    Contribute to improving AP processes, routines, and ways of working.

As you become familiar with the AP process, you will also have the opportunity to learn more about the other areas managed by the team, for example:

    Accounts Receivable: Invoicing for our various companies and providing support throughout the process. You will act as a problem solver and guide colleagues across the organization on billing issues.
    Credit: Conduct manual credit assessments for new and existing customers, reconciling bank payments, and managing potential debt risks.
    Team support: Provide first-class support in AP/AR and credit to colleagues across the organization, as well as to our clients and suppliers.
    Continuous improvement: Contribute to best practices that increase quality and efficiency. You will work daily in systems such as Workday, Basware, and Google Sheets, and we encourage you to challenge our current ways of working as we evolve.

You will be part of a larger finance department in Linköping consisting of approximately 30 employees. Our culture is defined by ambitious and kind people; we are convinced that our employees are the foundation of our growth. That is why we invest in both individual development and strong leadership.

We are looking for

    Experience: At least 2 years of experience working with Accounts Payable, experience from working with Accounts Receivable is a plus.
    Experience from delivering great service to customers or colleagues.
    Language: Fluency in Swedish and English is required for daily international contact with clients and colleagues.
    You are comfortable working in various systems. Experience with Workday or Basware is a plus.

We are looking for a highly responsible and orderly individual who handles sensitive data with the highest level of accuracy. You have a supportive mindset and build trust easily with both internal and external partners. You are comfortable taking ownership of your work, while also knowing when to ask for support or involve others. You manage to stay calm and professional even when explaining complex financial matters to a stressed colleague.

You are also curious and enjoy learning. While AP will be your main area of responsibility, you are interested in understanding how the different parts of the financial flow connect and in gradually broadening your knowledge within the team. You enjoy an international, fast-changing environment where continuous improvement is the norm.

Recruitment Process

    Logic and personality tests (Alva Labs)
    Phone interview with Talent Acquisition
    Digital interview with Talent Acquisition
    Final interview with the Hiring Manager and a chance to meet the team.

The final date to apply is October 10th but the recruitment process is ongoing so we may proceed with candidates to the next stage before the final date to apply.

Why join us?

    Community: We are a team that truly enjoys working together. We have a policy of being in the office at least three days a week (Tuesdays and Fridays are our fixed team days).
    Benefits: You’ll receive a comprehensive benefits package, including a generous wellness allowance, occupational pension, and health insurance. Plus, we enjoy "Akind Breakfast" on Tuesdays and "Finance Breakfast" on Fridays!
    Development: You will receive a warm onboarding where we train you with care. While you will have a clear focus on AP, you will also have the opportunity to learn other processes within the team and continuously broaden your financial expertise. As part of a company aiming to lead the way in digital innovation, you will have great opportunities to grow alongside us and within the team.

title: Critical Environment Operations Manager
description:
Overview

Microsoft’s Cloud Infrastructure and Operations (MCIO) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a Critical Environment Operations Manager, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's over 200 online businesses including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive and the Microsoft Azure platform.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

    Empower a culture of safety, security, and compliance in all aspects of our Datacenter operations
    Lead a team of Mechanical, Electrical and Control System professionals supporting Microsoft's online services  
    Oversee the day-to-day operations and maintenance of mechanical and electrical equipment in our Datacenters  
    Maximize Critical Environment (CE) availability to ensure optimal operational efficiency  
    Reduce high-impact and human-error Critical Environment (CE) incidents year over year
    Deliver on cost/energy efficiency initiatives  
    Ensure routine reporting to effectively manage and analyze our Power/Temperature/Relative Humidity, and SLA monitoring  
    Establish and enhance working relationships and engagement with our Engineering Groups (EGs), and business partners

Work with regional and global peers to share and build practices across the entire datacenter portfolio  

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

    Proven experience of mission-critical service management (e.g., providing IT services, manufacturing, warehouse, retail, military, or managing physical operations in an IT and/or critical environment infrastructure).
    Strong people management experience, including hiring, mentoring and team development
    You will be required to travel between sites as part of this role so a valid driver’s license will be required.
    *This role requires you to be on-site, and the location has limited public transport. Your own form of transport is advised.

Background Check Requirements:

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

    Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

While not required, we also look for the following Preferred Qualifications:

    Relevant experience in Critical Environment infrastructures (e.g., UPS, Generator, AHU) AND xperience working in physical IT infrastructures (e.g., Servers, SANs, Networking, Capacity, DC Rack/Enclosures, structured cabling) AND Experience managing budget $500k+
    Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Math, Telecommunications, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, Supply Chain Management or related field.
    Experience in leading a diverse, technical team.
    Applicable certifications: ASICS/Inventory Control, CompTIA, Microsoft, Network Certifications, CCNA Certifications, ITIL v3 Foundation, Microsoft Operations Framework (MOF) Certifications, Leadership Development Certifications, PMP, CDCP.
    Bachelor’s Degree or Technical College certification in mechanical or electrical engineering and/or services
    Experience working on large scale CE projects  
    Experience with the operation of IT infrastructure (Servers, SANs, Networking, etc.)

title: Head of Applied Innovation
description:
We are looking for a Head of Applied Innovation to lead and shape AAK's global Applied Innovation function,

driving the development of differentiated, science-based solutions that support our long-term growth

ambitions. Reporting to the President Commercial Development & Innovation, this strategic leadership role is

responsible for defining and delivering AAK's global innovation pipeline across key industry segments,

ensuring innovation activities are aligned with customer needs, market opportunities, and business strategy.

Leading a global team across our Centres of Excellence and innovation hubs, you will oversee the full

innovation lifecycle—from ideation and product development through to commercialization—while

strengthening innovation governance, application excellence, intellectual property, and portfolio

management. Working closely with senior leaders across Commercial, Marketing, Operations, Customer

Innovation, and R&D, you will play a pivotal role in delivering market-leading solutions and positioning AAK as

a trusted innovation partner worldwide.

​Innovation Strategy & Portfolio Management

- Define and execute AAK's global innovation strategy across key industry segments, ensuring

alignment with business objectives and market opportunities.

- Lead the end-to-end innovation process, from ideation and product development through pilot,

scale-up, and commercialization.

- Manage and prioritise the global innovation portfolio, ensuring transparency, strategic alignment, and

effective resource allocation.

- Drive continuous improvement of AAK's StageGate innovation process to strengthen governance,

decision-making, and execution.

- Deliver differentiated lipid-based solutions by translating scientific insights into commercially

successful products.

Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Lead, develop, and inspire the global Applied Innovation organisation, including Centres of

Excellence and cross-functional innovation teams.

- Foster a high-performance culture focused on collaboration, accountability, innovation, and

continuous learning.

- Partner with Industry Business Leaders, regional teams, Marketing, Customer Innovation, Insights,

Commercial, R&D, and Operations to align innovation priorities globally.

- Build and maintain strong external partnerships with customers, universities, start-ups, and strategic

innovation partners.

​

Innovation Excellence & Commercialisation

- Drive Application Excellence globally, ensuring consistent technical standards, methodologies, and

scientific rigour.

- Ensure successful technology transfer from innovation into manufacturing, supporting efficient

industrialisation and product launches.

- Lead innovation-related digitalisation initiatives, including portfolio management and Product

Lifecycle Management (PLM) capabilities.

- Oversee innovation budgets and ensure effective investment across strategic innovation priorities.

Intellectual Property & Governance

- Develop and implement AAK's innovation intellectual property strategy, driving proactive IP creation

and protection.

- Collaborate with Legal and external partners to manage IP risks, freedom-to-operate assessments,

and competitive intelligence.

- Ensure robust governance, compliance, and continuous improvement across innovation processes

and systems.

​

Executive Leadership

- Present innovation strategy, portfolio progress, and key initiatives to the Executive Committee and

Board.

- Provide strategic insight and recommendations that support long-term business growth and

competitive advantage.

- Act as a visible innovation leader across the organisation, championing customer-centric and

science-led innovation.

About you

- Degree in Food Science, Chemistry, Engineering, or a related scientific discipline.

- 10+ years of leadership experience within innovation, product development, or R&D in the food,

ingredients, or related industry.

- Proven experience leading global or regional innovation teams within a complex matrix organisation.

- Strong knowledge of StageGate processes, New Product Development (NPD), portfolio

management, and Product Lifecycle Management (PLM).

- Demonstrated ability to translate business strategy into successful innovation pipelines and

commercial outcomes.

- Strong commercial acumen with the ability to identify growth opportunities through customer and

market insights.

- Experience developing intellectual property strategies and innovation governance frameworks.

- Exceptional leadership skills with a track record of developing high-performing global teams.

- Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills, with experience engaging Executive

Committee and Board-level audiences.

- Outstanding communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex scientific concepts into clear

business messages.

- Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, global, decentralised environment with multiple stakeholders

and competing priorities.

- Fluent in English; additional languages such as Spanish, Mandarin, or Portuguese would be

advantageous.

- Willingness to travel regularly within Europe and occasionally internationally.

​

title: Engagement Manager
description:
Sana is an AI lab building superintelligence for work.

We believe organizations can accomplish their missions faster when humans can effortlessly access knowledge, automate repetitive work, and learn anything with the help of agentic AI.

As part of Workday, we are committed to building AI that augments humans.

If that’s a mission that excites you, you’re in the right place.

About the Role

We believe that everything starts with learning. And that by changing the way the world learns, we can change the world for the better. If that’s a mission that excites you, you’ll be in great company as part of the Sana team in Workday.

The Sana team is known for its adaptability, entrepreneurial spirit, and relentless pursuit of excellence, embodying our core belief that learning is the foundation of all meaningful change.

We work very closely with the companies who choose Sana. Together we problem solve, design solutions and implement them to drive change. Ultimately we measure ourselves through the impact we achieve through rolling out and adopting Sana. Our challenges are to continually learn and adapt to meet the unique needs of each company and team, and implement the creative solutions that make us proud of what we have achieved. While doing so we define what the future Sana's customer success, solution engineering and deployments teams will look like. By scaling this team, we create a significant impact on how people learn, across every industry, and across the globe.

In this role, you will:

Own end-to-end customer engagements

    Serve as the overall engagement owner for assigned accounts, accountable for successful implementation and ongoing value realisation.
    Lead complex deployments of Sana for medium and large enterprise customers, from discovery and design through go-live and post-launch optimisation.

Lead project and program delivery

    Define and manage project scope, plan, timelines, risks, and dependencies across multiple work streams.
    Ensure delivery within the budget and scope outlined in the Statement of Work, proactively managing changes and trade-offs.
    Coordinate internal Sana resources and external partners to deliver against project objectives.

Engage senior customer stakeholders

    Build and maintain trusted advisor relationships with executive sponsors and key decision makers.
    Facilitate steering committees and executive readouts, clearly articulating progress, risks, and business impact.
    Align Sana’s roadmap and capabilities with the customer’s strategic priorities and success metrics.

Drive adoption and measurable impact

    Define, track, and report on success metrics and KPIs for each engagement.
    Work closely with customer project managers and business owners to promote adoption, ensure change readiness, and drive continuous improvement.
    Identify optimisation and expansion opportunities that increase the value customers realise from Sana.

Provide strategic and solution guidance

    Translate business requirements into solution designs and implementation plans in collaboration with Solution Engineering and Product.
    Advise customers on best practices for learning, change management, and digital adoption, leveraging Sana’s capabilities.
    Challenge and refine customer requirements where needed to ensure viable, scalable, and high-impact solutions.

Collaborate cross-functionally and with partners

    Work effectively with Sales to scope new engagements, shape proposals, and ensure a smooth transition from pre‑sales to delivery.
    Manage third-party partners or vendors as part of the overall project team, maintaining accountability for overall outcomes.
    Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering based on customer needs and deployment learnings.

About You

Basic Qualifications (P3 Engagement Manager)

    At least 5 years of progressively responsible experience in Enterprise software implementation, management consulting, or customer success / professional services roles.
    Direct experience leading complex implementation projects in medium or large enterprises, with responsibility for scope, timeline, budget, stakeholder management, and outcomes

Basic Qualifications (P4 Senior Engagement Manager)

    At least 8 years of progressively responsible experience in Enterprise software implementation, management consulting, or customer success / professional services roles.
    Direct experience leading complex implementation projects in medium or large enterprises, with responsibility for scope, timeline, budget, stakeholder management, and outcomes

Other Qualifications:

You will thrive in this role if you:

    Are naturally curious, always seeking to learn, and view every challenge as a growth opportunity.
    Have strong project and program management skills, with a solid track record leading complex implementations in a Professional Services or Customer Success environment.
    Are comfortable engaging with C‑level and senior stakeholders, with excellent communication and presentation skills.
    Possess grit and determination, allowing you to weather setbacks and persist towards ambitious goals.
    Are driven by excellence and high standards in planning, execution, and stakeholder management.
    Embody humbleness and a collaborative mindset, always ready to learn from others and co‑create solutions.
    Are deeply committed to our mission of changing the way the world learns and have a genuine passion for driving customer impact.
    Are strong at building relationships, working cross-functionally, and influencing internal and external stakeholders.

title: Materialhanterare - farligt gods
description:
Company description:

Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. With cutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and construction equipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm, Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries. Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.

Job description:

Har du erfarenhet från materialhantering och har kunskap samt erfarenhet inom farligt gods? Är du ansvarstagande och har lätt för att samarbeta med andra? Bra! Då kan du vara den vi söker för rekrytering till Epirocs DC på Holmen.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Shared Distribution Center (SDC) är en global logistikleverantör inom Epiroc. Vi har till uppgift att förvalta och utveckla en högkvalitativ och kostnadseffektiv leverantörskedja för kunder, att hantera distributionen av reservdelar samt beställningar och leverans av utrustning för bergborrning. Det primära målet är att hjälpa säljbolagen att nå framgång genom högkvalitativa leveranser i rätt tid. Vårt DC är placerat på Holmen i Örebro.

ArbetsbeskrivningHär kommer du arbeta i team tillsammans med dina kolleger på Epirocs distributionscenter på Holmen. För att passa i rollen krävs att du är en bra lagspelare med gott ordningssinne och är kreativ i tanken. I rollen kommer du att ta emot gods, plocka, packa och distribuera till hela världen.

Placering och arbetstidDenna tjänst är placerad på SDC Holmen i Örebro, Sverige. Arbetstiden är förlagd till dagtid men kan komma att ändras i framtiden.

Ansökan och kontaktVälkommen med din ansökan innehållande CV och personligt brev. Du ansöker online via vår hemsida, gärna så snart som möjligt men senast den 15 oktober 2026. För frågor angående tjänsten vänligen kontakta rekryterande chefer: Anders Gustavsson anders.gustavsson@epiroc.com. För frågor angående rekryteringsprocessen eller ansökan vänligen kontakta: Maria Tedsjö, Rekryteringsspecialist, maria.tedsjo@external.epiroc.com

Livet på Epiroc När du blir en del av Epiroc kan du förvänta dig en atmosfär av kreativitet, innovation och mångfald. Du kommer att vara en del av en grupp skickliga och hjälpsamma kollegor som alla lever efter våra kärnvärden: samarbete, engagemang och innovation. Vi arbetar i en global miljö med över 113 nationaliteter.Förutom att vi har en kultur som kännetecknas av utveckling i kombination med en bra balans mellan arbete och fritid, finns det några saker som gör oss lite extra stolta över att arbeta på Epiroc: •    Globala karriärmöjligheter.•    Epiroc University, för din egen kompetensutveckling.•    Samhällsengagemang.•    Förmånspaket, som bland annat inkluderar flexibel arbetstid och bonus.

Profile description:

Din profilDu som söker tjänsten har några års erfarenhet från att arbeta på lager, gärna med orderplock och truckkörning. Du  har giltig utbildning och behörighet för att klassificera, packa, märka och dokumentera farligt gods för transport enligt gällande regelverk för:



•    Vägtransport (ADR)•    Sjötransport (IMDG-koden)•    Flygtransport (IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations)



Du har god kunskap om transportregelverk för farligt gods och säkerställer att försändelser hanteras, packas och dokumenteras i enlighet med lagkrav och interna rutiner. Vidare har du goda kunskaper i engelska, eftersom delar av regelverken, internationella vägledningar och teknisk dokumentation inom området endast finns tillgängliga på engelska.



Personliga egenskaper



För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du:•    Är noggrann och kvalitetsmedveten med ett starkt säkerhetsfokus.•    Har god analytisk förmåga och kan tolka komplexa regelverk.•    Tar ansvar för att säkerställa regelefterlevnad och hög kvalitet i leveranserna.•    Är kommunikativ och pedagogisk, med förmåga att stödja och vägleda kollegor i frågor som rör farligt gods.•    Har en hög integritet och vågar uppmärksamma avvikelser eller risker när de uppstår.



Du ska även kunna hantera tunga lyft då det kan förekomma i arbetet. Har du gått en säkra lyft alternativt traversutbildning är detta meriterande. För rollen behöver du truckkort A1-4 & B1-B4 enligt TLP10 - inte äldre än 3 år.

title: IT Administrator
description:
The U.S. Mission in Sweden is seeking eligible and qualified applicants for the IT Administrator in the Diplomatic Technology (DT) office.

Duties:

The Information Technology (IT) Administrator is a member of the Diplomatic Technology (DT) team and is responsible for administering and supporting mission IT systems to ensure the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information technology resources. The position provides Tier 1 and Tier 2 technical support to customers, manages user accounts and system access, maintains network and communications infrastructure, and supports enterprise applications, cloud services, and endpoint devices. The incumbent performs system administration, troubleshooting, configuration management, and cybersecurity-related activities while ensuring compliance with Department standards and policies. The role also provides IT support for official events, conference technologies, and visiting VIPs, while contributing to technology projects, knowledge management initiatives, contingency planning, and mission-wide cybersecurity efforts. Collaboration with customers, service providers, and cross-functional teams is essential to delivering reliable, secure, and innovative technology services across the Mission.

Requirements:

Experience and Education:

For the experience and education requirements applicants must meet either option 1 or option 2:

Option 1: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical Engineering, Library and Data Science/Analytics, Audio/Visual Communications and Technology or related major is required.

Experience: A minimum of 2 years of experience in computer networking operations, network management or utilization of computer systems.

OR

Option 2: Education: At least 2 years college or university studies (no specific field required).

Experience: A minimum of 4 years of experience in computer networking operations, network management or utilization of computer systems.

Language:

English - Fluent; speaking/reading/writing

Swedish - Rudimentary knowledge; speaking/reading/writing

title: Engagement Manager
description:
Sana is an AI lab building superintelligence for work.

We believe organizations can accomplish their missions faster when humans can effortlessly access knowledge, automate repetitive work, and learn anything with the help of agentic AI.

As part of Workday, we are committed to building AI that augments humans.

If that’s a mission that excites you, you’re in the right place.

About the role:

We believe that everything starts with learning. And that by changing the way the world learns, we can change the world for the better. If that’s a mission that excites you, you’ll be in great company as part of the Sana team in Workday.

The Sana team is known for its adaptability, entrepreneurial spirit, and relentless pursuit of excellence, embodying our core belief that learning is the foundation of all meaningful change.

We work very closely with the companies who choose Sana. Together we problem solve, design solutions and implement them to drive change. Ultimately we measure ourselves through the impact we achieve through rolling out and adopting Sana. Our challenges are to continually learn and adapt to meet the unique needs of each company and team, and implement the creative solutions that make us proud of what we have achieved. While doing so we define what the future Sana's customer success, solution engineering and deployments teams will look like. By scaling this team, we create a significant impact on how people learn, across every industry, and across the globe.

In this role, you will:

Own end-to-end customer engagements

    Serve as the overall engagement owner for assigned accounts, accountable for successful implementation and ongoing value realisation.
    

    Lead complex deployments of Sana for medium and large enterprise customers, from discovery and design through go-live and post-launch optimisation.

Lead project and program delivery

    Define and manage project scope, plan, timelines, risks, and dependencies across multiple work streams.
    

    Ensure delivery within the budget and scope outlined in the Statement of Work, proactively managing changes and trade-offs.
    

    Coordinate internal Sana resources and external partners to deliver against project objectives.

Engage senior customer stakeholders

    Build and maintain trusted advisor relationships with executive sponsors and key decision makers.
    

    Facilitate steering committees and executive readouts, clearly articulating progress, risks, and business impact.
    

    Align Sana’s roadmap and capabilities with the customer’s strategic priorities and success metrics.

Drive adoption and measurable impact

    Define, track, and report on success metrics and KPIs for each engagement.
    

    Work closely with customer project managers and business owners to promote adoption, ensure change readiness, and drive continuous improvement.
    

    Identify optimisation and expansion opportunities that increase the value customers realise from Sana.

Provide strategic and solution guidance

    Translate business requirements into solution designs and implementation plans in collaboration with Solution Engineering and Product.
    

    Advise customers on best practices for learning, change management, and digital adoption, leveraging Sana’s capabilities.
    

    Challenge and refine customer requirements where needed to ensure viable, scalable, and high-impact solutions.

Collaborate cross-functionally and with partners

    Work effectively with Sales to scope new engagements, shape proposals, and ensure a smooth transition from pre‑sales to delivery.
    

    Manage third-party partners or vendors as part of the overall project team, maintaining accountability for overall outcomes.
    

    Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering based on customer needs and deployment learnings.

About you:

Basic Qualifications

    Minimum 5+ years of experience in customer success, consulting, or similar roles
    Experience working with enterprise customers and senior stakeholders
    Proven ability to drive adoption and measurable customer outcomes

Other qualifications:

    Enterprise Customer Success: High-performing CSMs who have driven adoption, value, and expansion in complex B2B SaaS environments
    Consulting or Strategy: Experience solving ambiguous problems and working directly with senior stakeholders
    Implementation or Transformation: Experience driving large-scale change, adoption, or system rollouts within enterprise organizations
    A builder who improves systems, not just follows them
    Comfortable operating with ownership and autonomy
    Able to move from strategy to execution
    Focused on outcomes and impact, not just activity

Your duties will include building and maintaining various digital projects and products, as well as providing general IT support. The Digital Factory & Automation department is seeking highly skilled and motivated individuals to join our team and help us achieve these goals. title: Bartender (Deltid 75%)
description:
Dream Big - Join Basta New Opening in Västerås! 🍕

About Basta

Basta is more than a restaurant—it's a place where people connect. Inspired by the warmth and spirit of Italy, we bring together great food, genuine hospitality and passionate teams to create memorable experiences for every guest. Whether you're in the kitchen or on the floor, you'll be part of a team that brings energy, personality and pride to everything it does.

Part of Urban Italian Group

Urban Italian Group is one of Europe's fastest-growing hospitality groups, bringing together distinctive restaurant brands, passionate people and memorable guest experiences. As we continue to grow, so do the opportunities for those who want to build their careers with us.

The Role

As Bartender, you will prepare drinks with consistency, confidence and care while helping create the lively, generous atmosphere Basta is known for. You will work closely with the floor and management teams to keep service smooth, organised and full of personality.

What you'll be doing

    

Preparing cocktails, wines and drinks according to Basta standards.

    

Delivering friendly, confident and engaging bar service.

    

Keeping the bar clean, organised and ready for busy service.

    

Supporting the floor team when needed to create a seamless guest experience.

    

Managing stock, garnishes and bar preparation before and during service.

    

Following hygiene, alcohol service and safety standards at all times.

You'll thrive in this role if you

We’re looking for someone with energy, personality and a real passion for hospitality.

    

Has previous bar or restaurant experience.

    

Enjoys working in a busy, high-energy environment.

    

Brings a positive attitude and confidence with guests.

    

Works well as part of a team and communicates clearly.

    

Takes pride in consistency, presentation and details.

    

Is reliable, organised and willing to learn.

Our culture and values

We believe we work with people, not food. Guided by our values of Trust, Inclusion, Passion and Entrepreneurship, we’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels welcome, valued and empowered to grow.

What do we offer?

    

Be part of one of Europe’s fastest-growing hospitality groups.

    

Build your career across multiple brands and countries.

    

Work alongside talented people who genuinely love hospitality.

    

International career opportunities.

    

Referral bonus scheme.

    

Shared accommodation (where applicable).

    

Friends for life.

Sound like your kind of place?

If you are excited by joining us, we would love to hear from you. Bring your energy, personality and passion for Italian food to Basta.

Urban Italian Group is committed to fair and inclusive recruitment. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. If you need a reasonable adjustment at any stage of the selection process, please tell our Talent Acquisition Team.

title: Sales Support Specialist
description:
På ABB hjälper vi industrier att bli mer resurseffektiva och renare – och varje person här bidrar till resultaten. Du kommer att få möjlighet att leda, få stöd att växa och kunna vara stolt över den påverkan vi skapar tillsammans. Gå med oss och hjälp till att driva det som driver världen.

Denna position rapporterar till:

Sales Support Manager

__

You will be part of ABB Process Automation business area and work within the Energy Industry division and our exciting market.

We are one of the world’s richest regions in terms of natural resources, and by applying our knowledge and innovative engineering we help to utilize those resources in safer, smarter and more sustainable ways. We collaborate with customers to deliver products, projects and services worldwide leveraging our unique competence in automation, electrification, digital and integrated solutions to enhance productivity, resilience and business value for the energy segments.

We are seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented Sales Support Specialist to join our Energy Industries Sales and Tendering team. In this role you will provide critical support to our sales team while managing complex tender processes from bid preparation to contract close. You will be instrumental in ensuring successful project execution and customer satisfaction.

You will work closely together with our sales team who has the sales responsibility to our customers, but you will be the significant “value adder” in giving our customers an overwhelming experience of ABB´s capabilities and offerings.

Your role and responsibilities

    Work in close collaboration with our Sales team with the aim to develop business opportunities to actual projects and to give the customer a unique experience of ABB´s capabilities and offerings.
    Manage end-to-end tender processes, including bid preparation, documentation, and submission
    Coordinate with internal teams (engineering, project management, finance, legal) to develop competitive proposals.
      Prepare and maintain tender documentation, schedules and timelines.
    Track tender status, manage follow-ups, and communicate updates to stakeholders.
    Ensure compliance with customer requirements and ABB standards in all tender submissions.
    Assist in contract negotiations and maintain accurate project records.
    Identify opportunities for process improvement and cost optimization.
    Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers and internal teams.

Qualifications for the role

    A Master of Science or Bachelor’s degree in relevant engineering field.
    Knowledge in energy industries, electrical and automation projects.
    Being quality conscious and appreciating the work processes being in continuous improvement and innovation.
    Self-independent as well as a team player.
    Minimum 3-5 years of experience in sales support, tender management, or similar role.
    Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
    Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and CRM systems.
    Strong organizational and project management capabilities.
    Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
    Detail-oriented with excellent attention to accuracy and timelines.

The role could be based in any of our offices, Malmö, Gothenburg, Stockholm, Västerås or Umeå.

ABB Energy Industries is enabling safe, smart and sustainable projects and operations for businesses across the oil, gas, chemicals, life sciences, power generation and water sectors. Driving integrated solutions that automate, digitalize and electrify industry we connect our people and technology to help our customers adapt and succeed. With over 50 years domain expertise, we continue to innovate and reshape traditional approaches across the energy sector with our technologies designed to improve operational efficiency, reduce risk, reduce energy consumption and waste.

All other questions can be directed to Recruiting Consultant Sara Vestin, +46 724 64 46 88.

We kindly decline direct contact with staffing and recruitment agencies as well as sellers of additional job advertisements.

Please note that, to be eligible for employment at ABB AB, you will need to pass our pre-employment screening steps. This includes a reference check, a drug test, and could also include an extended background check. Welcome to apply the latest by Oct16th, 2026. Please note that selection will be done on an ongoing basis and the position may be filled before last day of application.

We look forward to receiving your application (PDF documents submitted in English are appreciated). If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.

description:
På ABB hjälper vi industrier att bli mer resurseffektiva och renare – och varje person här bidrar till resultaten. Du kommer att få möjlighet att leda, få stöd att växa och kunna vara stolt över den påverkan vi skapar tillsammans. Gå med oss och hjälp till att driva det som driver världen.

Denna position rapporterar till:

Sales Support Manager

__

You will be part of ABB Process Automation business area and work within the Energy Industry division and our exciting market.

We are one of the world’s richest regions in terms of natural resources, and by applying our knowledge and innovative engineering we help to utilize those resources in safer, smarter and more sustainable ways. We collaborate with customers to deliver products, projects and services worldwide leveraging our unique competence in automation, electrification, digital and integrated solutions to enhance productivity, resilience and business value for the energy segments.

We are seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented Sales Support Specialist to join our Energy Industries Sales and Tendering team. In this role you will provide critical support to our sales team while managing complex tender processes from bid preparation to contract close. You will be instrumental in ensuring successful project execution and customer satisfaction.

You will work closely together with our sales team who has the sales responsibility to our customers, but you will be the significant “value adder” in giving our customers an overwhelming experience of ABB´s capabilities and offerings.

Your role and responsibilities

    Work in close collaboration with our Sales team with the aim to develop business opportunities to actual projects and to give the customer a unique experience of ABB´s capabilities and offerings.
    Manage end-to-end tender processes, including bid preparation, documentation, and submission
    Coordinate with internal teams (engineering, project management, finance, legal) to develop competitive proposals.
      Prepare and maintain tender documentation, schedules and timelines.
    Track tender status, manage follow-ups, and communicate updates to stakeholders.
    Ensure compliance with customer requirements and ABB standards in all tender submissions.
    Assist in contract negotiations and maintain accurate project records.
    Identify opportunities for process improvement and cost optimization.
    Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers and internal teams.

Qualifications for the role

    A Master of Science or Bachelor’s degree in relevant engineering field.
    Knowledge in energy industries, electrical and automation projects.
    Being quality conscious and appreciating the work processes being in continuous improvement and innovation.
    Self-independent as well as a team player.
    Minimum 3-5 years of experience in sales support, tender management, or similar role.
    Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
    Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and CRM systems.
    Strong organizational and project management capabilities.
    Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
    Detail-oriented with excellent attention to accuracy and timelines.

The role could be based in any of our offices, Malmö, Gothenburg, Stockholm, Västerås or Umeå.

ABB Energy Industries is enabling safe, smart and sustainable projects and operations for businesses across the oil, gas, chemicals, life sciences, power generation and water sectors. Driving integrated solutions that automate, digitalize and electrify industry we connect our people and technology to help our customers adapt and succeed. With over 50 years domain expertise, we continue to innovate and reshape traditional approaches across the energy sector with our technologies designed to improve operational efficiency, reduce risk, reduce energy consumption and waste.
